vocabulary.example_sentence: I felt the brush of her hand against me.

vocabulary.english_definition: A swinging or sliding barrier that will close the entrance to a room or building or vehicle
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 部屋または建物または車の入り口を閉鎖するだろう揺れるかまたは滑っている柵。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Please will you close the door when you go out.

vocabulary.english_definition: Metal device shaped in such a way that when it is inserted into the appropriate lock the lock's mechanism can be rotated
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 錠に差し込んだとき錠前のメカニズムが回転するように型取られた金属器具。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I must have lost my key along the way.

vocabulary.english_definition: A recording of both the visual and audible components (especially one containing a recording of a movie or television program)
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 映像部分と音声部分の両方の記録媒体（特に映画またはテレビ番組の記録媒体を含んでいるもの）。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I like that video game. And only that video game.

vocabulary.english_definition: a large container that you fill with water to wash your body
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 体を洗ったり温めたりするための浴槽。
vocabulary.example_sentence: There is a large bath in the hotel room.

vocabulary.english_definition: A framework of wood or metal that contains a glass windowpane and is built into a wall or roof to admit light or air
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 壁や天井に採光や通風のために作られた、ガラスのはまった木や金属の枠組み。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I opened the window to let in some fresh air.

vocabulary.english_definition: Being of use or service
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 役に立つことまたは奉仕。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I feel very useful in my own job position.

vocabulary.english_definition: very pleasant to taste
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 食べ物や飲み物の味がとてもよいこと。
vocabulary.example_sentence: This soup is delicious. Can I have some more?

vocabulary.english_definition: Creating or arousing excitement
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 興奮を生み出すこと、または喚起するさま。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I had never seen such an exciting baseball game before.

vocabulary.english_definition: Belonging to or on behalf of a specified person (especially yourself); preceded by a possessive
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 特定の人（とくにあなた自身）のために、またはそれに属する。所有格によって先行される。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Do you make your own clothes?

vocabulary.english_definition: Characterized by an absence or near absence of agitation or activity
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 困惑または行動の欠如またはほぼ欠如することによって特徴づけられる。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I came out here to enjoy some peace and quiet.

vocabulary.english_definition: The sport of traveling on a bicycle or motorcycle
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 自転車かオートバイで移動するスポーツ。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You may go cycling if it doesn't rain.

vocabulary.english_definition: A game resembling ice hockey that is played on an open field; two opposing teams use curved sticks try to drive a ball into the opponents' net
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: フィールドで行われるアイスホッケーに類似しているゲーム。2つの相対するチームが曲がったスティックを使って相手側のネットにボールをたたき込む。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I heard that you bought a hockey team.

vocabulary.english_definition: Running at a jog trot as a form of cardiopulmonary exercise
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 心肺運動の形のようなジョッグトロットのランニング。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I go jogging every morning before I go to school.

vocabulary.english_definition: Place of business where professional or clerical duties are performed
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 職業上であるか事務員の義務が実行される勤務地。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I have important business to take care of in my office.

vocabulary.english_definition: A commercial document showing that the holder is entitled to something (as to ride on public transportation or to enter a public entertainment)
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 保有者が何らかの（公共輸送機関に乗るか、一般向けの娯楽｛ごらくのような）権利があることを示している商業的な文書。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Please give me a ticket for the seven o'clock show.

vocabulary.english_definition: The general activity of selling
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 販売の一般的な活動。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I got it for half price at a sale.

vocabulary.english_definition: The side that is seen or that goes first
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 最初に見られる、または最初に行く側。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I like to sit in the front of the bus.

vocabulary.english_definition: An area that is approximately central within some larger region
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: より大きなものの内部の、ほぼ真ん中にある領域。
vocabulary.example_sentence: What train goes to the center of town?

vocabulary.english_definition: A formation of people or things one behind another
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 順々に後ろに並ぶ人や物の編成。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You must stand in a line to buy a ticket.

vocabulary.english_definition: A card for sending messages by post without an envelope
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 封筒に入れずに郵便でメッセージを送るためのカード。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I forgot to send the kids a postcard from Algeria.

vocabulary.english_definition: A ceremonial procession including people marching
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 行進する人々を含む儀式的な行列。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I couldn't see the parade well from where I was.

vocabulary.english_definition: A document issued by a country to a citizen allowing that person to travel abroad and re-enter the home country
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 国から市民に発行される文書で、外国を旅行し自国に戻ることを許可する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You absolutely need a passport to travel to a foreign country.

vocabulary.english_definition: A sign posted in a public place as an advertisement
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 広告として公共の場所に貼られた掲示。
vocabulary.example_sentence: What does that poster mean?

vocabulary.english_definition: The property of having material worth (often indicated by the amount of money something would bring if sold)
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 物質的な価値をもつという特質（しばしば、何かが売られたときにもたらす金額によって表される）。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I wonder if this is worth the price they're asking.

vocabulary.english_definition: The top or extreme point of something (usually a mountain or hill)
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 何かの頂点または極点（通常山または丘）。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We could not see the top of the mountain.

vocabulary.english_definition: The distance covered by a step
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 1歩で行く距離。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You need to take a step back and check yourself.

vocabulary.english_definition: Something done (usually as opposed to something said)
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: なされた事柄（通常、言われた事柄に対して言う）。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I invited Gustavo to watch an action movie with me.

vocabulary.english_definition: The style in which hair has been cut
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 髪を切ったスタイル。
vocabulary.example_sentence: My hair is too long already, so I'm going for a haircut.

vocabulary.english_definition: The arrangement of the hair (especially a woman's hair)
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 髪（特に女性の髪）のアレンジメント。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I wanted to change things up with my hairstyle.

vocabulary.english_definition: Your overall circumstances or condition in life (including everything that happens to you)
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 人生（あなたに起こるすべてを含んでいる）におけるあなたの総合的な事情か状態。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I wish you all the luck in the world.

vocabulary.english_definition: Make an effort or attempt
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 努力する、または試みる。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I told Tom he should try to do it by himself.

vocabulary.english_definition: Cause to be directed or transmitted to another place
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 案内される、または別の場所に送信される。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Please send me a letter as soon as you arrive.

vocabulary.english_definition: Be asleep
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 眠っている。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I wish I could sleep better and fall asleep faster.

vocabulary.english_definition: Expect and wish
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 予期し期待する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I hope you will come up with a better plan.

vocabulary.english_definition: Be worried, concerned, anxious, troubled, or uneasy
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 胸を痛める、憂慮している、案じている、問題を抱えている、または不安である。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I don't think it's anything we need to worry about.

vocabulary.english_definition: a book or magazine that tells stories through pictures
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 絵とせりふで物語を伝える漫画や漫画本。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I borrowed a comic from my friend yesterday.

vocabulary.english_definition: An artifact designed to be played with
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 遊ぶために考案された人工品。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You should ask for help if a toy is broken.

vocabulary.english_definition: Any solid substance (as opposed to liquid) that is used as a source of nourishment
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 栄養物として用いられる固形物質（液体に対するものとして）。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I still have to buy some food for the party.

vocabulary.english_definition: Any of various small flat sweet cakes ('biscuit' is the British term)
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 小型で平らな甘い菓子。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Do you want a cookie or something?

vocabulary.english_definition: Italian open pie made of thin bread dough spread with a spiced mixture of e.g. tomato sauce and cheese
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 薄いパンの練り粉に香料入りトマトソース・チーズを混ぜたものを塗って焼いたイタリアのオープンパイ。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I thought that pizza was what you wanted to eat.

vocabulary.english_definition: Two (or more) slices of bread with a filling between them
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 2枚（またはそれ以上）の薄切りのパンの間に詰め物をしたもの。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I forgot my lunch and bought a sandwich at school.

vocabulary.english_definition: the part of a plant, such as an apple, that people often eat
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: リンゴなどの果物。一般的な総称では不可算名詞。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I usually eat some fruit with my breakfast.

vocabulary.english_definition: The liquid part that can be extracted from plant or animal tissue by squeezing or cooking
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: しぼれるか、料理することによって設備または動物性組織から引き抜かれることができる液体の一部。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You can drink the juice that's on the table.

vocabulary.english_definition: A piece of dishware normally used as a container for holding or serving food
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 通常食べ物を乗せたり出したりするのに用いる食器の1つ。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We might as well eat dog food as eat such a dish.

vocabulary.english_definition: A beverage consisting of an infusion of ground coffee beans
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 挽いたコーヒー豆の浸出液から成る飲料。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I always drink my coffee from the same cup.

vocabulary.english_definition: Ready to fall asleep
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 今にも眠りそうな。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I feel sleepy as soon as I finish eating dinner.

vocabulary.english_definition: every person or thing considered separately
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 集団の一人一人、一つ一つを個別に表す。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Each student needs a pencil and a notebook.

vocabulary.english_definition: (of persons) excessively affected by emotion
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: （人について）過度に感情に影響される。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I think we're all really excited about this.

vocabulary.english_definition: the two people or things together
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 二人または二つの両方を表す。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Both of my parents enjoy cooking at home.

vocabulary.english_definition: Devoid of or deficient in light or brightness; shadowed or black
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 光または明るさが欠けている、または、光または明るさが不十分な。陰になる、または黒い。
vocabulary.example_sentence: What happens in the dark always comes to light.

vocabulary.english_definition: An imaginary creature usually having various human and animal parts
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 想像上の生き物で、普通は人間や動物の様々な部位からできている。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I didn't know that you were a monster.

vocabulary.english_definition: A space reserved for sitting (as in a theater or on a train or airplane)
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: （劇場、電車、飛行機などで）座るために確保された場所。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I found myself a seat and sat down.

vocabulary.english_definition: A small adhesive token stuck on a letter or package to indicate that that postal fees have been paid
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 郵便の料金が払われたそれを示すために手紙か小包に貼り付けられる小さな粘着性の印。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I need to get a stamp.

vocabulary.english_definition: The name of a work of art or literary composition etc.
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 芸術作品または文学作品などの名前。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I don't remember the title of that movie.

vocabulary.english_definition: Move in a graceful and rhythmical way
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 優美でリズミカルに動く。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I remember the way you used to dance.

vocabulary.english_definition: Liquid food especially of meat or fish or vegetable stock often containing pieces of solid food
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 固形食物を入れた肉、魚、または野菜の煮出し汁からなる液状の食物。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I like my soup to be warm, not hot.

vocabulary.english_definition: A red fruit with a single hard stone
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 硬い種がひとつ入った赤い果物。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I cut down a cherry tree.

vocabulary.english_definition: Slices of bread that have been toasted
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: トーストされたパンのスライス。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I can make some toast if you want.

vocabulary.english_definition: Food made from dough of flour or meal and usually raised with yeast or baking powder and then baked
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 小麦粉またはミールの生地で作られ、通常はイーストまたはベーキングパウダーでふくらまされ、それから焼かれる食物。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I bought some bread on the way home from work.

vocabulary.english_definition: The flesh of animals (including fishes and birds and snails) used as food
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 食料として使われる動物（魚と鳥とカタツムリを含む）の肉。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You should cut up your meat before you eat it.

vocabulary.english_definition: A ribbonlike strip of pasta
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 細いリボン状のパスタ。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I wish he'd use his noodle every once in a while.

vocabulary.english_definition: Grains used as food either unpolished or more often polished
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 食用穀類で、精白しないものや何回か精白するものがある。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I eat bread more often than I eat rice.

vocabulary.english_definition: A living organism characterized by voluntary movement
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 自発的な運動に特徴付けられる、生命を持つ有機体。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Can you think of an animal that's black and white?

vocabulary.english_definition: The atmospheric conditions that comprise the state of the atmosphere in terms of temperature and wind and clouds and precipitation
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 温度、風、雲、および降水量の観点から、大気状態を形成する大気条件。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I played outside with everybody because the weather was good today.

vocabulary.english_definition: Water falling in drops from vapor condensed in the atmosphere
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 大気中で凝縮された水蒸気から成る滴という形での水の落下。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We have been waiting for the rain to fall.

vocabulary.english_definition: Located at a great distance in time or space or degree
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 時間、スペース、程度において非常に距離がある。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We have far better things to do with our time.

vocabulary.english_definition: Having or showing interest; especially curiosity or fascination or concern
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 興味を持つ、または、興味を見せている。特に好奇心または魅惑または懸念。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I know someone who may be interested in your project.

vocabulary.english_definition: Being definitely out of the ordinary and unexpected; slightly odd or even a bit weird
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 明らかに並外れていて予想外であるさま。わずかに奇妙で、若干不思議なほどの。
vocabulary.example_sentence: What a strange girl she is.

vocabulary.english_definition: Of so extreme a degree or extent
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 程度や範囲が非常に極端な。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I really dream of such a tree in my garden.

vocabulary.english_definition: The syllable naming the fifth (dominant) note of any musical scale in solmization
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 階名唱法における、音階の5番目（第5度）の音符を指して呼ぶ音節。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I love her so much that I can't leave her.

vocabulary.english_definition: Succeed in catching or seizing, especially after a chase
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 追跡した後に捕獲または捕まえることに成功する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We got to the station in time to catch the bus.

vocabulary.english_definition: Move fast by using one's feet, with one foot off the ground at any given time
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 自分の足を使って、常時地面から片足を上げ、速く動く。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I was driving too fast and ran off the road.

vocabulary.english_definition: Descend in free fall under the influence of gravity
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 重力の影響を受けている時、歯止めなく落下する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I could fall in love with you all over again.

vocabulary.english_definition: Be seated
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 着席する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I got up so an old man could sit in my seat.

vocabulary.japanese_meaning: チェックする、点検する
vocabulary.english_definition: Examine so as to determine accuracy, quality, or condition
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 正確さ、質、または状態を確かめるために吟味する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I think you might want to check this out.
vocabulary.raw_japanese_extraction: チェックする、点検する
vocabulary.source_japanese_meaning: チェックする、点検する

vocabulary.english_definition: Reproductive organ of angiosperm plants especially one having showy or colorful parts
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 被子植物の生殖器官で特に目立ったり、あるいはカラフルな部分を持つもの。
vocabulary.example_sentence: My sister used to take care of the flower bed.

vocabulary.english_definition: Precipitation falling from clouds in the form of ice crystals
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 氷晶という形で雲から落下する降水。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I walked through the snow to my place of work.

vocabulary.english_definition: Binary compound that occurs at room temperature as a clear colorless odorless tasteless liquid; freezes into ice below 0 degrees centigrade and boils above 100 degrees centigrade; widely used as a solvent
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 透明で無色、無臭、無味の液体として室温にて起きる二元化合物。摂氏0度未満で氷になり、摂氏100度より上で沸騰する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Please give me some ice for the water.

vocabulary.english_definition: A period of the year marked by special events or activities in some field
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: ある分野で特別の行事または活動が行われる1年の1時期。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You don't seem to be dressed for the season.

vocabulary.english_definition: A body of (usually fresh) water surrounded by land
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 陸地に囲まれた（通常塩分を含まない）水域。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We went through the woods and came to a lake.

vocabulary.english_definition: A large natural stream of water (larger than a creek)
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 広い自然の水流（クリークより広い）。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We went fishing, before the river water became big.

vocabulary.english_definition: A division of an ocean or a large body of salt water partially enclosed by land
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 部分的に陸に囲まれた大洋や広い海水域の一部分。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Do you still want to drink water while in the sea?

vocabulary.english_definition: (astronomy) a celestial body of hot gases that radiates energy derived from thermonuclear reactions in the interior
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 内部の熱核反応により生じたエネルギーを放射する、高温のガスでできた天体。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I want to make you a star here in Algeria.

vocabulary.english_definition: A lump or mass of hard consolidated mineral matter
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 固い統合鉱物質の塊か固まり。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We found ourselves between a rock and a hard place.

vocabulary.english_definition: The atmosphere and outer space as viewed from the earth
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 地球から見られる大気と宇宙。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Do you know the reason why the sky looks blue?

vocabulary.english_definition: In accordance with truth or fact or reality
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 真実、事実または現実に従って。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I really don't have time to listen to you right now.

vocabulary.english_definition: close to someone or something
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 距離や時間が近いことを表す。
vocabulary.example_sentence: There is a small park near my house.

vocabulary.english_definition: Many times at short intervals
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 短い間隔で、何回も。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I often think of the place where we met each other.

vocabulary.english_definition: At or to or toward the back or rear
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 後ろあるいは後部で、あるいは、のほうに向かって。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I went back to the window and looked out.

vocabulary.english_definition: in a good or skillful way
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 動作が上手にできることを表す副詞。
vocabulary.example_sentence: My sister plays the piano very well.

vocabulary.english_definition: Dismiss from the mind; stop remembering
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 心から棄却する。覚えることを止める。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I wouldn't be able to forget you even if I tried.

vocabulary.english_definition: Come into the company of
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: その仲間に加わる。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We were thinking of asking you to join our company.

vocabulary.english_definition: Recall knowledge from memory; have a recollection
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 記憶から知識を思い浮かべる。回顧する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I ask you to remember this once and for all.

vocabulary.english_definition: Cause someone or something to move by driving
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 運転することにより誰かまたは何かを引き起こさせる。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You will be able to drive a car some day.

vocabulary.english_definition: Cause to change; make different; cause a transformation
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 変化させる。変える。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I think that that's about to change.

vocabulary.english_definition: Large gregarious predatory feline of Africa and India having a tawny coat with a shaggy mane in the male
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 雄には毛深い鬣のある黄褐色の毛並みを有するアフリカとインドの大きな群生している捕食性の猫科の動物。
vocabulary.example_sentence: What would you do if you met a lion here?

vocabulary.english_definition: Any of several fleet black-and-white striped African equines
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 駿足で黒と白の縞模様を持つ、アフリカ産の各種の馬。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I had a dream about a zebra.

vocabulary.english_definition: Systematic training by multiple repetitions
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 何度も繰り返すことによる体系的な訓練。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We make it a practice to take a walk every morning.

vocabulary.english_definition: An artistic form of auditory communication incorporating instrumental or vocal tones in a structured and continuous manner
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 構造化され、かつ連続的な楽器あるいは音声から成る聴覚コミュニケーションの芸術的形態。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We stopped talking so that we could hear the music.

vocabulary.english_definition: A stringed instrument usually having six strings; played by strumming or plucking
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 通例6本の弦を持つ弦楽器。かき鳴らすことあるいは爪弾くことで演奏される。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Do you usually use a pick when you play the guitar?

vocabulary.english_definition: The particular auditory effect produced by a given cause
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: ある原因によって生み出された特定の聴覚的効果。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I love the sound of rain on the roof.

vocabulary.english_definition: A high-pitched woodwind instrument; a slender tube closed at one end with finger holes on one end and an opening near the closed end across which the breath is blown
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 高音の木管楽器。指穴が一つの端にあり、息を吹き込む開口部が閉じた端の近くにある、交差している一端が閉じている細長い筒。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I played the flute when I was in high school.

vocabulary.japanese_meaning: 音楽家、ミュージシャン
vocabulary.english_definition: Artist who composes or conducts music as a profession
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 職業として曲を作ったり指揮をしたりする人。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Do you know when the musician will come here?
vocabulary.raw_japanese_extraction: 音楽家、ミュージシャン
vocabulary.source_japanese_meaning: 音楽家、ミュージシャン

vocabulary.english_definition: A small portable timepiece
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 小型の携帯用の時計。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I bought this watch at a small shop in Boston.

vocabulary.english_definition: A lightweight handheld collapsible canopy
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 軽い手持ちの折り畳める天蓋。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You do not have to take your umbrella with you.

vocabulary.english_definition: In the past
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 昔は。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I came to Boston a little over three years ago.

vocabulary.english_definition: with another person or other people
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: ほかの人と同じ場所で、または協力して行うこと。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Let's work together to finish this project.

vocabulary.english_definition: In the near future
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 近い将来に。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We should get out of here as soon as possible.

vocabulary.english_definition: Under normal conditions
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 通常の状態で。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I don't usually wait for people who show up late.

vocabulary.english_definition: Indicating exactness or preciseness
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 正確さまたは精密度を示すこと。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I just did what my boss told me to do.

vocabulary.english_definition: Change location; move, travel, or proceed, also metaphorically
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 場所を変える。また比喩的にも移動する、旅をするまたは前進する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We travel not to move, but to change our mind.

vocabulary.english_definition: (botany) a living organism lacking the power of locomotion
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 移動力のない、生命を持つ有機体。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Can you water the plants in the living room, please?

vocabulary.english_definition: Move very fast
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 非常に速く動く。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We have very little time, so please hurry.

vocabulary.english_definition: Change one's facial expression by spreading the lips, often to signal pleasure
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: しばしば喜びを示すために、唇を広げて表情を変える。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You ought to smile more often.

vocabulary.english_definition: Be the winner in a contest or competition; be victorious
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: コンテストまたは競争の勝者である。勝利している。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Our team is likely to win the game.

vocabulary.english_definition: A garment worn on the upper half of the body
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 体の上半分に着る衣服。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I think it's time for me to wash this shirt.

vocabulary.english_definition: Clothing in general
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 一般的に衣服。
vocabulary.example_sentence: My father does not care about his clothes at all.

vocabulary.english_definition: A visual attribute of things that results from the light they emit or transmit or reflect
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: それらが放つ、伝導する、あるいは反射する光によって生じる、物の目で見ることのできる属性。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I like the color white.

vocabulary.english_definition: A constitutional monarchy occupying the Japanese Archipelago; a world leader in electronics and automobile manufacture and ship building
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 日本列島を占める立憲君主国。エレクトロニクス、自動車、工業、造船では世界的な牽引国。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I think that Japan is a very safe country.

vocabulary.english_definition: A nation in northern North America; the French were the first Europeans to settle in mainland Canada
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 北アメリカ大陸北部の国。フランス人が本土カナダに定住した最初のヨーロッパ人だった。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I have been living in Canada for almost five years.

vocabulary.english_definition: North American republic containing 50 states - 48 conterminous states in North America plus Alaska in northwest North America and the Hawaiian Islands in the Pacific Ocean; achieved independence in 1776
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 50の州を含むノース・アメリカン共和国−−太平洋の北西の北アメリカとハワイ諸島の北アメリカとアラスカの48の隣接の州。米国には50の州がある。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I want to stay in America for a few years.

vocabulary.english_definition: A nation occupying the whole of the Australian continent; Aboriginal tribes are thought to have migrated from southeastern Asia 20,000 years ago; first Europeans were British convicts sent there as a penal colony
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: オーストラリア大陸全体を占める国。20,000年前に東南アジアから移住したと考えられているアボリジニ。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I visited Australia for the first time three years ago.

vocabulary.english_definition: High quality porcelain originally made only in China
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 高品質の磁器で、もともとは中国だけで作られた。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I used it when I was in China last summer.

vocabulary.english_definition: A politically organized body of people under a single government
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 単一の政府の下に政治的に組織された人々の集まり。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I had a dream I went back to my country.

vocabulary.english_definition: People in general; especially a distinctive group of people with some shared interest
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 一般の人々。特に何らかの共通の利害のある人々の特徴的なグループ。
vocabulary.example_sentence: How in the world did you do such a thing?

vocabulary.english_definition: Anew
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 改めて。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I tried to get up, but I fell down again.

vocabulary.english_definition: On one occasion
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: ある時。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I get a call from her once in a while.

vocabulary.english_definition: Happening at a time subsequent to a reference time
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 言及時の後に起こること。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You knew that sooner or later it would happen, didn't you?

vocabulary.english_definition: In addition
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: さらに。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I also found every letter he had ever written to my mother.

vocabulary.english_definition: On certain occasions or in certain cases but not always
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 特定の機会、あるいは特定の場合においてしかし、常にではない。
vocabulary.example_sentence: My little sister sometimes wished she was a boy.

vocabulary.english_definition: Undergo a transformation or a change of position or action
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 変形または位置または行動の変化を受ける。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We cannot allow them to turn us against each other.

vocabulary.english_definition: Take the first step or steps in carrying out an action
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 行動を行うことで、第一歩、一歩以上を踏み出す。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We will begin the party when he comes.

vocabulary.english_definition: Move while supporting, either in a vehicle or in one's hands or on one's body
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 車両で、人手で、または、身に付けて、維持している間に移動する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You must carry the keys with you at all times.

vocabulary.english_definition: Undergo an emotional sensation or be in a particular state of mind
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 感情的な気持ちを経験する、または特定の心理状態になる。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I want them to feel what I felt.

vocabulary.english_definition: Keep in a certain state, position, or activity; e.g., "keep clean"
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 特定の状態、位置または活動を維持する。例えば、。
vocabulary.example_sentence: My father often tells me to keep things clean.

vocabulary.english_definition: The capital and largest city of England; located on the Thames in southeastern England; financial and industrial and cultural center
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: イングランドの首都で最大の都市。イングランド南東部のテムズ川沿岸に位置する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I made friends with her during my stay in London.

vocabulary.english_definition: A football game in which two teams of 11 players try to kick or head a ball into the opponents' goal
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 11人の選手2チームがキックやヘッドでボールを相手ゴールに入れるフットボールの試合。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Our soccer team won every game last season.

vocabulary.english_definition: A game played on a court by two opposing teams of 5 players; points are scored by throwing the ball through an elevated horizontal hoop
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 5人で成る2つのチームによるコート上で行われる試合。高い位置にある水平のリングを通じてボールを投げることで、得点がされる。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I play in the basketball team.

vocabulary.english_definition: A game in which two teams hit an inflated ball over a high net using their hands
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 2チームがふくらんだボールを、手を使って高いネットの向こうに打ち飛ばすゲーム。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I forgot you were on the volleyball team.

vocabulary.english_definition: Any of various games played with a ball (round or oval) in which two teams try to kick or carry or propel the ball into each other's goal
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: ボール（丸または楕円）を用いる様々なゲームで、2つの相対するチームが互いのゴールにそのボールを蹴り込んだり、運び込んだり、押し込んだりする。
vocabulary.example_sentence: How many times a week does the football team practice?

vocabulary.english_definition: A sports implement (usually consisting of a handle and an oval frame with a tightly interlaced network of strings) used to strike a ball (or shuttlecock) in various games
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 様々なゲームにおいてボール（またはシャトル）を打つのに用いられるスポーツ用具（柄とストリングをきつく網状にからみ合せた卵形の枠とでできた）。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I can't sleep with all this racket going on.

vocabulary.english_definition: A category of things distinguished by some common characteristic or quality
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 共通の特徴や質で区別されるものの範疇。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I think there has been some kind of mistake.

vocabulary.english_definition: The basic monetary unit in many countries; equal to 100 cents
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 多くの国で使われている通貨の基本単位。100セントと同価。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Can you help me out by giving me a dollar?

vocabulary.english_definition: A state of difficulty that needs to be resolved
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 解決する必要のある困難な状況。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Our problem is how to get in touch with him.

vocabulary.english_definition: Activities that are enjoyable or amusing
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 楽しい、おもしろい活動。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I do this for the fun of it.

vocabulary.english_definition: At all times; all the time and on every occasion
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: いつも、常に。いつもそしてあらゆる機会に。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I will always love you no matter what you do.

vocabulary.english_definition: From a particular thing or place or position ('forth' is obsolete)
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 特定のもの、場所または位置から。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I don't want to talk to you anymore. Go away.

vocabulary.english_definition: possibly; perhaps
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 確実ではない可能性を表す「たぶん」「もしかすると」。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Maybe we can go to the beach tomorrow.

vocabulary.english_definition: With ease ('easy' is sometimes used informally for 'easily')
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 容易さをもって。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I hope that he will find his way easily.

vocabulary.english_definition: From a particular thing or place or position ('forth' is obsolete)
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 特定のもの、場所または位置から。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I want to get off at the next stop.

vocabulary.english_definition: Know and comprehend the nature or meaning of
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 本来の姿、あるいは意味を知り、理解する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I can understand what she is saying.

vocabulary.english_definition: The content of cognition; the main thing you are thinking about
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 認知の内容。その人が考えている主要な事柄。
vocabulary.example_sentence: What do you think about this idea?

vocabulary.english_definition: The time yet to come
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: まだ到来していない時間。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I never think about the future. It comes soon enough.

vocabulary.english_definition: A special situation
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 特殊状況。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I got half the things you asked me to get.

vocabulary.english_definition: The most common medium of exchange; functions as legal tender
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 最も普通に使われている交換手段。法定貨幣として機能している。
vocabulary.example_sentence: What makes us free is the money, not the law.

vocabulary.english_definition: A message that tells the particulars of an act or occurrence or course of events; presented in writing or drama or cinema or as a radio or television program
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 出来事の行為、発生、詳細、進行を伝えるメッセージ。文書、劇、映画の中で、あるいはラジオまたはテレビの番組として示さた。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You didn't tell the story very well.

vocabulary.english_definition: A formally arranged gathering
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 公式に準備された集まり。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I will tell her what to say at the meeting.

vocabulary.english_definition: A course of conduct
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 行動の方針。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We understood that it was much better for us this way.

vocabulary.english_definition: A unit of language that native speakers can identify
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: ネイティブスピーカーが同定できる言語の単位。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I took him on his word when he said he'd never seen her before.

vocabulary.english_definition: The point in time at which something ends
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 何かが終わる時期。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I won't wait for you until the end of time.

vocabulary.english_definition: The physical magnitude of something (how big it is)
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 何かの物理的大きさ（どれほど大きいか）。
vocabulary.example_sentence: My dog is almost half the size of yours.

vocabulary.english_definition: A systematic means of communicating by the use of sounds or conventional symbols
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 音または慣習的記号を用いたコミュニケーションの体系的な手段。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I wish I could speak all the languages of the world.

vocabulary.english_definition: One of a set of small pieces of stiff paper marked in various ways and used for playing games or for telling fortunes
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 堅い紙の小片のセットの１つで、色々な印がつけられていて、ゲームをしたり、運勢を占ったりするのに使用される。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You will need a video card to play this game.

vocabulary.english_definition: The work of providing treatment for or attending to someone or something
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 誰かまたは何かに処遇を施したり、または注意を払うこと。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I don't care what happens to my old car.

vocabulary.english_definition: A series of mental images and emotions occurring during sleep
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 睡眠中に起こる一連の精神的イメージと感情。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I saw it all in a dream last night.

vocabulary.english_definition: (baseball) a failure by a batter or runner to reach a base safely in baseball
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 野球で打者かランナーが無事に塁に到着することの失敗。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I hope you get that out of your system.

vocabulary.english_definition: as much or as many as needed
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 必要な量や程度を満たしていること。enough time、old enough の語順に注意。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We have enough time to finish the game.

vocabulary.english_definition: A static photograph (especially one taken from a movie and used for advertising purposes)
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: （特に映画からとったもので宣伝目的に使われる）静止写真。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Do you think he still wants to live with me?

vocabulary.english_definition: Up to the present time
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 現在今に至るまで。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I haven't yet had time to see about a hotel for the night.

vocabulary.english_definition: used to identify a point in place or time
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 場所や時刻などの一点を示す前置詞。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Let's meet at the station at ten.

vocabulary.english_definition: Persist for a specified period of time
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 特定の期間やり通す。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I wonder how long this cold weather will last.

vocabulary.english_definition: in a good or skillful way
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 動作が上手にできることを表す副詞。
vocabulary.example_sentence: My sister plays the piano very well.

vocabulary.english_definition: Able to act at will; not hampered; not under compulsion or restraint
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 意のままに行動することができる。妨げられない。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Please feel free to stay as long as you like.

vocabulary.english_definition: Increase in size by natural process
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 自然なプロセスによるサイズの増加。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I don't want our child to grow up here.

vocabulary.english_definition: Regarded with great favor, approval, or affection especially by the general public
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 特に一般大衆によってとても好かれ、受け入れられ、愛されている。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I am a popular girl at school.

vocabulary.english_definition: liked more than others
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: ほかのものより特に好きなこと。
vocabulary.example_sentence: What is your favorite food to cook at home?

vocabulary.english_definition: Take something or somebody with oneself somewhere
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 自らで、何かまたは誰かをどこかへ連れて行く。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Please bring me a chair from the next room.

vocabulary.english_definition: A period of time equal to 1/24th of a day
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 時間の周期、1日の1/24と等しい。
vocabulary.example_sentence: How many more hours do you think this will take?

vocabulary.english_definition: as much or as many as needed
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 必要な量や程度を満たしていること。enough time、old enough の語順に注意。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We have enough time to finish the game.

vocabulary.english_definition: Become part of; become a member of a group or organization
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 一部になる。グループか組織のメンバーになる。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I think I should join a study group.

vocabulary.english_definition: a place where trains stop for passengers
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 列車に乗ったり降りたりする駅。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I'll meet you outside the station at nine.

vocabulary.english_definition: Not easy; requiring great physical or mental effort to accomplish or comprehend or endure
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 簡単でない。完成させ、理解しまたは我慢する物理的または精神的努力を必要とする。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I realize this is a difficult time for you.

vocabulary.english_definition: The particular auditory effect produced by a given cause
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: ある原因によって生み出された特定の聴覚的効果。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I love the sound of rain on the roof.

vocabulary.english_definition: The child of your aunt or uncle
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: おじやおばの子供。
vocabulary.example_sentence: My cousin is the last person to break his promise.

vocabulary.english_definition: Any of various alternatives; some other
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 様々な選択肢の総称。他の何かの。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I want to put off the lesson until another day.

vocabulary.english_definition: Recall knowledge from memory; have a recollection
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 記憶から知識を思い浮かべる。回顧する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I ask you to remember this once and for all.

vocabulary.english_definition: Place of business where professional or clerical duties are performed
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 職業上であるか事務員の義務が実行される勤務地。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I have important business to take care of in my office.

vocabulary.english_definition: Easily agitated
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 興奮しやすい。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I didn't know that you were going to be nervous.

vocabulary.english_definition: Save from ruin, destruction, or harm
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 荒廃、破壊または損害から救う。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You are the only one who can save the world.

vocabulary.english_definition: The organization that is the governing authority of a political unit
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 政治体の行政部門である組織。
vocabulary.example_sentence: What do you do for the government?

vocabulary.english_definition: A health facility where patients receive treatment
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 患者が治療を受ける健康設備。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I went to the hospital to ask about his health.

vocabulary.english_definition: Reach a destination; arrive by movement or progress
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 目的地に着く。動くことまたは前進によって到着する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We won't be able to arrive home in time.

vocabulary.english_definition: Many times at short intervals
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 短い間隔で、何回も。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I often think of the place where we met each other.

vocabulary.english_definition: Not ever; at no time in the past or future
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: かつてないさま。過去または未来にすることのないさま。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I had never felt more alone than at that time.

vocabulary.english_definition: Render inoperable or ineffective
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 実行できなくする、または効果をなくす。
vocabulary.example_sentence: How old were you when the war broke out?

vocabulary.english_definition: Any mechanical or electrical device that transmits or modifies energy to perform or assist in the performance of human tasks
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: エネルギーを伝送あるいは変形して、人間の仕事をさせたり助けさせたりする機械的あるいは電気的装置一般。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I can't seem to get him to fix this machine.

vocabulary.english_definition: Prior to a specified or implied time
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 指定されたか意味された時間の前に。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I must have told you that a hundred times already.

vocabulary.english_definition: Get something; come into possession of
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 何かを得る。所有物として手に入れる。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I hope to receive a letter from you soon.

vocabulary.english_definition: to make a picture using a pencil or pen
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 鉛筆やペンなどで絵や図を描くこと。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Can you draw a map of your neighborhood?

vocabulary.english_definition: during the time that; in contrast with
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 「〜している間に」や「一方で」を表す接続詞。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I listened to music while I cleaned my room.

vocabulary.english_definition: to take something to the person or place that needs it
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 荷物などを相手や目的地まで届けること。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Can you deliver this package to our office tomorrow?

vocabulary.english_definition: A set of questions or exercises evaluating skill or knowledge
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 技術あるいは知識を評価するための、一連の質問や問題。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We heard the news that you had passed the exam.

vocabulary.english_definition: from a time in the past; because
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 時点を示すと「〜以来」。理由を示すと「〜なので」。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I have lived in this town since April.

vocabulary.english_definition: Descend in free fall under the influence of gravity
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 重力の影響を受けている時、歯止めなく落下する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I could fall in love with you all over again.

vocabulary.english_definition: A building where theatrical performances or motion-picture shows can be presented
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 演劇や映画が上演される建物。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Could you show me the way to the theater?

vocabulary.english_definition: Of or relating to or belonging to a nation or country
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 国または国家に属する、またはそれに関係するまたはそれの。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We took a trip to a national park.

vocabulary.english_definition: The accumulation of knowledge or skill that results from direct participation in events or activities
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 行事や活動に直接かかわることで得た技術や知識の蓄積。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I have some experience in that area as well.

vocabulary.english_definition: Capable of happening or existing
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 起きるまたは存在できる。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I want to read as many English books as possible this year.

vocabulary.english_definition: Of so extreme a degree or extent
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 程度や範囲が非常に極端な。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I really dream of such a tree in my garden.

vocabulary.english_definition: Regard something as probable or likely
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 何かに対して、起こり得る、または見込まれると見なす。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You can expect me tomorrow.

vocabulary.english_definition: High in price or charging high prices
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 値段が高い、または高い値段で請求する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I can't afford to shop at such an expensive store.

vocabulary.english_definition: weighing a lot
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 重さが大きく、持つのに力が必要なこと。
vocabulary.example_sentence: This bag is too heavy for me to carry.

vocabulary.english_definition: Move very fast
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 非常に速く動く。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We have very little time, so please hurry.

vocabulary.english_definition: Come up with (an idea, plan, explanation, theory, or principle) after a mental effort
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 思考錯誤の後で思いつく（考え、計画、説明理論または主義）。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We should invent a secret language.

vocabulary.english_definition: Marked by absence of sound
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 音の欠如で、マークされます。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I kept silent because I didn't know what to say.

vocabulary.english_definition: Attack someone physically or emotionally
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 物理的または感情的にだれかを攻撃する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We didn't intend to attack him.

vocabulary.english_definition: Do away with, cause the destruction or undoing of
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 処分する、破壊あるいは破滅を引き起こす。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Do you think that you need to destroy my things?

vocabulary.english_definition: The totality of surrounding conditions
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 総体的な周囲の状況。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We do not respect the environment as much as we should.

vocabulary.english_definition: Form a mental image of something that is not present or that is not the case
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 存在しない、あるいは、事実と異なる心像を形成する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I can imagine why you don't want to talk to her.

vocabulary.english_definition: Pain in the head caused by dilation of cerebral arteries or muscle contractions or a reaction to drugs
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 脳動脈の拡張、筋肉収縮、薬反応による頭痛。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Do you have something to make this headache go away?

vocabulary.english_definition: Not private; open to or concerning the people as a whole
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 個人的でない。全体の人に対してまたはそれに関して。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I went to a public garden to rest.

vocabulary.english_definition: Traverse or travel on (a body of water)
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: （水域の上を）渡るまたは行く。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Do you know how to sail a boat?

vocabulary.english_definition: a planned piece of work with a particular purpose
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 目的を達成するために計画して進める仕事や課題。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Our class is working on a project about recycling.

vocabulary.english_definition: At the present or from now on; usually used with a negative
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 現在において、または今から。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Our children don't live here anymore.

vocabulary.english_definition: Propel through the air
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 空気中で推進する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: My wife asked me to throw this old hat away.

vocabulary.english_definition: To a distinctly greater extent or degree than is common
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 通常よりも目立って大きな程度にまたは範囲に。
vocabulary.example_sentence: My wife makes me happy, especially when she isn't home.

vocabulary.english_definition: On the inside
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 内から。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I wasn't able to see who was inside the car.

vocabulary.english_definition: Sleep longer than intended
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 意図するより長い睡眠。
vocabulary.example_sentence: How did I oversleep even though I went to bed early?!

vocabulary.english_definition: Make ready or suitable or equip in advance for a particular purpose or for some use, event, etc
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 特定の目的、使用、あるいは出来事のためにあらかじめ準備しておく、整える、備える。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I have to prepare to go to school.

vocabulary.english_definition: At or in the front
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 前面のまたは前面で。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I can see so much light ahead of me.

vocabulary.english_definition: Move upward
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 上方に動く。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We are waiting for the sun to rise.

vocabulary.english_definition: next to someone or something
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 人や物のすぐ横にある位置を表す。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Please put your bag beside the desk.

vocabulary.english_definition: in opposition to; touching and supported by
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 「〜に反対して」「〜に接して」などを表す前置詞。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Our team is playing against theirs on Saturday.

vocabulary.english_definition: not anything
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 「何も〜ない」を表す否定の代名詞。
vocabulary.example_sentence: There is nothing in this box.

vocabulary.english_definition: A diagram or picture illustrating textual material
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 本文を説明する図表や写真。
vocabulary.example_sentence: How do you eat like that and keep your figure?

vocabulary.english_definition: Take into custody
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 保護する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I doubt that the police are going to arrest Tom.

vocabulary.english_definition: Get lost, as without warning or explanation
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 道に迷う、警告あるいは説明なしで。
vocabulary.example_sentence: My money seems to disappear by the end of the month.

vocabulary.english_definition: The line at which the sky and Earth appear to meet
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 空と大地が接しているように見える線。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Do you see a ship on the horizon?

vocabulary.japanese_meaning: 親しみやすい、友好的な
vocabulary.english_definition: Characteristic of or befitting a friend
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 友人の特徴または、に適するさま。
vocabulary.example_sentence: My uncle gave me a friendly piece of advice.
vocabulary.raw_japanese_extraction: 親しみやすい、友好的な
vocabulary.source_japanese_meaning: 親しみやすい、友好的な

vocabulary.english_definition: Run away from confinement
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 監禁から逃げる。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You won't be able to escape from this prison.

vocabulary.english_definition: Make plain and comprehensible
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 平易で理解可能にする。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I found it impossible to explain what he is really like.

vocabulary.english_definition: Absolutely essential
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 必要不可欠な。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Do you really believe that doing that is absolutely necessary?

vocabulary.english_definition: Impress positively
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 明らかに印象づける。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You don't have to try so hard to impress me.

vocabulary.english_definition: the number one thousand million
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 現在の一般的な英語では十億を表す。
vocabulary.example_sentence: More than a billion people live in India.

vocabulary.english_definition: feeling that you need a drink
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 水分が欲しくて、のどが渇いていること。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I'm thirsty. Can I have some water?

vocabulary.english_definition: Produce laughter
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 笑いを引き起こす。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I didn't know whether to get angry or to laugh.

vocabulary.english_definition: A set of questions or exercises evaluating skill or knowledge
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 技術あるいは知識を評価するための、一連の質問や問題。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We felt happy when the examination was over.

vocabulary.english_definition: Afflicted with or marked by anxious uneasiness or trouble or grief
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 気がかりな不安、トラブルまたは悲しみに苦しめられるまたは、それらに特徴付けられる。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I used to get upset about everything, too.

vocabulary.english_definition: Cultivate by growing, often involving improvements by means of agricultural techniques
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 育成して栽培する、しばしは農業技術の方法の改良を含む。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We don't produce anything any more.

vocabulary.english_definition: The quality of being important and worthy of note
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 重要で、注目に値するという特質。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Do you understand the importance of what you are saying?

vocabulary.english_definition: Not capable of occurring or being accomplished or dealt with
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 生じることができない、達成されない、または対処されることができない。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We find ourselves in an impossible situation.

vocabulary.english_definition: A time period usually extending from Friday night through Sunday; more loosely defined as any period of successive days including one and only one Sunday
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 通常、金曜日の夜から日曜日までの期間。日曜日、あるいは一度のみの日曜日を含む連続した日付期間のいずれかであると緩く定義された。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I want to spend time with my children this weekend.

vocabulary.english_definition: Leisure time away from work devoted to rest or pleasure
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 労働を離れた余暇時間で、休息または娯楽に用いられる。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I can't remember the last time I took a vacation.

vocabulary.english_definition: Systematic training by multiple repetitions
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 何度も繰り返すことによる体系的な訓練。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We make it a practice to take a walk every morning.

vocabulary.english_definition: (medicine) something that treats or prevents or alleviates the symptoms of disease
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 病気の症状を治療する、予防する、または緩和する物。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I don't feel well. Could you give me some medicine?

vocabulary.english_definition: Behave as expected during of holidays or rites
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 休日または儀式で予想通りに振舞う。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I want to celebrate Christmas with you.

vocabulary.english_definition: An announcement containing information about an event
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: イベントについての情報を含んでいる発表。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Do you notice anything different about me?

vocabulary.english_definition: Be worried, concerned, anxious, troubled, or uneasy
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 胸を痛める、憂慮している、案じている、問題を抱えている、または不安である。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I don't think it's anything we need to worry about.

vocabulary.english_definition: The state of being suitable or opportune
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 適当で好都合な状態。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You pay for the convenience of living near a station.

vocabulary.english_definition: for the reason that
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 理由を説明する語。後ろに主語と動詞を置く。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I took the bus because it was raining.

vocabulary.english_definition: to create or produce something
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 材料や考えを使って何かを作り出すこと。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Let's make a birthday card for our teacher.

vocabulary.english_definition: Take something or somebody with oneself somewhere
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 自らで、何かまたは誰かをどこかへ連れて行く。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You need somebody like me to take care of your kids.

vocabulary.english_definition: to notice with your eyes; to meet someone
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 目で見ることや、人に会うこと。文脈で意味が変わる。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I can see the mountains from my window.

vocabulary.english_definition: Exert oneself by doing mental or physical work for a purpose or out of necessity
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 目的のためにまたは必要に迫られて、精神的、物理的な行動をすることによって尽力する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I must work hard to make up for lost time.

vocabulary.english_definition: Perceive with attention; direct one's gaze towards
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 注意して知覚する。その人の視線を向ける。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I will look after your child this evening.

vocabulary.english_definition: to contact someone by telephone; to ask someone to come
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 電話をかけたり、誰かを呼んだりすること。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I'll call you when I get to the station.

vocabulary.english_definition: Persist for a specified period of time
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 特定の期間やり通す。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I wonder how long this cold weather will last.

vocabulary.english_definition: between noon and midnight
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 午後を表す時刻の表記。午後三時は three p.m.。
vocabulary.example_sentence: The library closes at six p.m. on Fridays.

vocabulary.english_definition: The facility where wild animals are housed for exhibition
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 野生動物が展示のために飼われている設備。
vocabulary.example_sentence: How many animals do you think are in this zoo?

vocabulary.english_definition: A living organism characterized by voluntary movement
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 自発的な運動に特徴付けられる、生命を持つ有機体。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Can you think of an animal that's black and white?

vocabulary.english_definition: A day or period of time set aside for feasting and celebration
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 祝宴と祝賀のためにとっておいた日または時間。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I hope that people will come to our festival.

vocabulary.english_definition: a very large animal with a long trunk
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 長い鼻と大きな体を持つ動物のゾウ。
vocabulary.example_sentence: The elephant picked up some food with its trunk.

vocabulary.english_definition: The specified day of the month
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 月の特定の日。
vocabulary.example_sentence: What is the date today?

vocabulary.english_definition: A branch of knowledge
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 知識の分野。
vocabulary.example_sentence: What more is there to say on this subject?

vocabulary.english_definition: A mercantile establishment for the retail sale of goods or services
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 商品またはサービスの小売販売のための商業の施設。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I bought eggs at the store on the way home.

vocabulary.english_definition: between midnight and noon
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 午前を表す時刻の表記。午前九時は nine a.m.。
vocabulary.example_sentence: My first class starts at nine a.m. tomorrow.

vocabulary.english_definition: An artifact designed to be played with
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 遊ぶために考案された人工品。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You should ask for help if a toy is broken.

vocabulary.english_definition: a story shown in moving pictures
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 映像で物語などを見せる映画。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Would you like to watch a movie tonight?

vocabulary.english_definition: A time period usually extending from Friday night through Sunday; more loosely defined as any period of successive days including one and only one Sunday
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 通常、金曜日の夜から日曜日までの期間。日曜日、あるいは一度のみの日曜日を含む連続した日付期間のいずれかであると緩く定義された。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I want to spend time with my children this weekend.

vocabulary.english_definition: An occasion on which a winner is selected from among two or more contestants
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 2人以上の競争者から勝者が選ばれる機会。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I thought that you were going to win the contest.

vocabulary.english_definition: The most common medium of exchange; functions as legal tender
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 最も普通に使われている交換手段。法定貨幣として機能している。
vocabulary.example_sentence: What makes us free is the money, not the law.

vocabulary.english_definition: a place where you pay to eat a meal
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 代金を払って食事をする店。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Let's try the new restaurant near the station.

vocabulary.english_definition: Not the same one or ones already mentioned or implied
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 既に述べた、または示したのと同じものではない。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I still haven't eaten the chocolate that you gave me the other day.

vocabulary.english_definition: Dearly loved
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 心から愛されている。
vocabulary.example_sentence: My mother has sold everything that is dear to her.

vocabulary.english_definition: in a good or skillful way
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 動作が上手にできることを表す副詞。
vocabulary.example_sentence: My sister plays the piano very well.

vocabulary.english_definition: Able to act at will; not hampered; not under compulsion or restraint
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 意のままに行動することができる。妨げられない。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Please feel free to stay as long as you like.

vocabulary.english_definition: (superlative of 'good') having the most positive qualities
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: もっとも肯定的な特質がある。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We tried our best to have a good time.

vocabulary.english_definition: Widely known and esteemed
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 広く知られ、尊重される。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I wonder what it would be like to be famous.

vocabulary.english_definition: Unique or specific to a person or thing or category
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 人、物またはカテゴリーに特有または限られた。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Do you have anyone special in mind for the job?

vocabulary.english_definition: Limited or below average in number or quantity or magnitude or extent
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 数、量、大きさまたは範囲が制限された、あるいは平均以下の。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I think that car is a little too small for you.

vocabulary.english_definition: Gain knowledge or skills
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 知識または能力を獲得する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I wish I could learn every language in the world.

vocabulary.english_definition: Express in words
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 言葉で表現する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Can you please tell me what time the train leaves?

vocabulary.english_definition: Have need of
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 必要性を有する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You will need much more money than you do now.

vocabulary.english_definition: Derive or receive pleasure from; get enjoyment from; take pleasure in
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 喜びを引き出す、または受ける。悦楽を得る。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I never thought I would enjoy living in the country.

vocabulary.english_definition: Increase in size by natural process
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 自然なプロセスによるサイズの増加。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I don't want our child to grow up here.

vocabulary.english_definition: Be the cause or source of
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 何かの原因または源となる。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Could you please give me a piece of information?

vocabulary.english_definition: Come or bring to a finish or an end
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 仕上げるあるうは終わりにくるあるいはそれをもたらす。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I will finish it by the time he comes back.

vocabulary.english_definition: A hallucinatory experience induced by drugs
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 麻薬によって生じる幻覚的経験。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We have just returned from a trip around the world.

vocabulary.english_definition: A message received and understood
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 受け取られて、理解されるメッセージ。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Do you really want this information to be made public?

vocabulary.english_definition: A category of things distinguished by some common characteristic or quality
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 共通の特徴や質で区別されるものの範疇。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I think there has been some kind of mistake.

vocabulary.english_definition: A reference book containing an alphabetical list of words with information about them
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 単語に関する情報が載っている単語のアルファベット順のリストを含む参考図書。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I can't understand this word. Do you have a dictionary?

vocabulary.english_definition: Any solid substance (as opposed to liquid) that is used as a source of nourishment
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 栄養物として用いられる固形物質（液体に対するものとして）。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I still have to buy some food for the party.

vocabulary.english_definition: A licensed medical practitioner
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 認可された医者。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I feel very bad, I must see a doctor.

vocabulary.english_definition: The principal activity in your life that you do to earn money
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 金銭を稼ぐために行う生活の中での主要な活動。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Do you think he did the job on his own?

vocabulary.english_definition: Young domestic cat
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: イエネコの子。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I have a kitten in the next room.

vocabulary.english_definition: Establishment where a seat of higher learning is housed, including administrative and living quarters as well as facilities for research and teaching
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 研究と教育のための施設だけでなく管理局、住居区を含む高等教育の中枢が収容されている施設。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I think Tom is a student at the university where I used to teach.

vocabulary.english_definition: Something determined in relation to something that includes it
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: ある物を含む物に関連して決定される物。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I just don't want to be a part of it.

vocabulary.english_definition: A point located with respect to surface features of some region
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: ある地域の表面の特徴に関して見つけられたポイント。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I know a place where we can get some money.

vocabulary.english_definition: Activities that are enjoyable or amusing
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 楽しい、おもしろい活動。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I do this for the fun of it.

vocabulary.english_definition: a mother or father
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 母親または父親を表す。parents なら両親などの複数。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Each child must come with a parent.

vocabulary.english_definition: Leisure time away from work devoted to rest or pleasure
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 労働を離れた余暇時間で、休息または娯楽に用いられる。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I can't remember the last time I took a vacation.

vocabulary.english_definition: A person who performs voluntary work
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: ボランティア労働に従事する人。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I have a friend who works as a volunteer.

vocabulary.english_definition: Feeling or expressing regret or sorrow or a sense of loss over something done or undone
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 何かをした、あるいはしなかったことについて後悔、悲しみ、あるいは喪失感を感じること、あるいは表すさま。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We feel sorry about what happened between you.

vocabulary.english_definition: (comparative of 'good') superior to another (of the same class or set or kind) in excellence or quality or desirability or suitability; more highly skilled than another
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 素晴らしさ、品質、好ましさあるいは適合性のもう一つ（同じ部類、組、種類の）より優れている。別の人よりさらに高い技術を示す。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Do you think you're a better cook than I am?

vocabulary.english_definition: Regarded with great favor, approval, or affection especially by the general public
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 特に一般大衆によってとても好かれ、受け入れられ、愛されている。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I am a popular girl at school.

vocabulary.english_definition: Free from error; especially conforming to fact or truth
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: エラーがない。特に事実や真実に従う。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You took the words right out of my mouth.

vocabulary.english_definition: liked more than others
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: ほかのものより特に好きなこと。
vocabulary.example_sentence: What is your favorite food to cook at home?

vocabulary.english_definition: Affected by an impairment of normal physical or mental function
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 通常の身体的であるか精神的な機能の減退に影響を受ける。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I have never been sick since I was a child.

vocabulary.english_definition: Actively or fully engaged or occupied
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 活発に、完全に、占められた、独占された。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I was too busy to eat lunch.

vocabulary.english_definition: after the expected or usual time
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 予定や普段の時刻より遅いこと。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Sorry I'm late. I missed the bus.

vocabulary.english_definition: Come upon, as if by accident; meet with
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: まるで偶然かのように、出会う。会う。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I don't want to find you here when I come back.

vocabulary.english_definition: Change location; move, travel, or proceed, also metaphorically
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 場所を変える。また比喩的にも移動する、旅をするまたは前進する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We travel not to move, but to change our mind.

vocabulary.english_definition: Cause to be directed or transmitted to another place
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 案内される、または別の場所に送信される。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Please send me a letter as soon as you arrive.

vocabulary.english_definition: Take something or somebody with oneself somewhere
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 自らで、何かまたは誰かをどこかへ連れて行く。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Please bring me a chair from the next room.

vocabulary.english_definition: Make an effort or attempt
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 努力する、または試みる。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I told Tom he should try to do it by himself.

vocabulary.english_definition: Reach, make, or come to a decision about something
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 何かについての決定に達する、実行する、に至る。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We finally decided to give him over to the police.

vocabulary.english_definition: Expect and wish
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 予期し期待する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I hope you will come up with a better plan.

vocabulary.english_definition: Instrumentalists not including string players
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 弦楽器奏者を含まない器楽家達。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I liked that band better before they became popular.

vocabulary.english_definition: Intelligent somewhat arboreal ape of equatorial African forests
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 赤道付近のアフリカの森林の知的な多少樹上棲息に適する類人猿。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Tom had never seen a chimpanzee before.

vocabulary.english_definition: A depository built to contain books and other materials for reading and study
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 本と研究のために、本と他の資料を保存するために建設される保管所。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I like to go to the library and read books.

vocabulary.english_definition: A series of steps to be carried out or goals to be accomplished
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 実行するための一連の段階あるいは達成するべきゴール。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I didn't just make the plan, I carried it out.

vocabulary.english_definition: a message sent electronically over the internet
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: インターネットを使って送る電子メール。email とも書く。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Please send me an e-mail with the meeting details.

vocabulary.english_definition: A period of time equal to 1/24th of a day
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 時間の周期、1日の1/24と等しい。
vocabulary.example_sentence: How many more hours do you think this will take?

vocabulary.english_definition: Systematic training by multiple repetitions
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 何度も繰り返すことによる体系的な訓練。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We make it a practice to take a walk every morning.

vocabulary.english_definition: A male human offspring
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 人間の男の子。
vocabulary.example_sentence: My son is not at home, he is at school.

vocabulary.english_definition: A politically organized body of people under a single government
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 単一の政府の下に政治的に組織された人々の集まり。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I had a dream I went back to my country.

vocabulary.english_definition: A formally arranged gathering
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 公式に準備された集まり。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I will tell her what to say at the meeting.

vocabulary.english_definition: A daily or weekly publication on folded sheets; contains news and articles and advertisements
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 折り畳まれた紙に書かれた日刊または週刊の出版物。ニュース、記事、広告を含む。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I think he doesn't want you to read the newspaper.

vocabulary.english_definition: A person with advanced knowledge of one or more sciences
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 一分野以上の科学の高度な知識を持つ人。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You know, I'm something of a scientist myself.

vocabulary.english_definition: A spot where something halts or pauses
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 何かが停止あるいは立ち止まる場所。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I missed my stop. How long does it take to reach the next stop?

vocabulary.english_definition: A particular geographical region of indefinite boundary (usually serving some special purpose or distinguished by its people or culture or geography)
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 境界が不確かな特定の地理的地域（通常いくつかの特別な目的にかなうか、その住民、文化または地理学によって特徴付けられる）。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I think I could use some help in this area.

vocabulary.english_definition: The sister of your father or mother; the wife of your uncle
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 父や母の姉妹。おじの妻。
vocabulary.example_sentence: My aunt was like a real mother to me.

vocabulary.english_definition: the largest part or number
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 全体の大部分、または最も多い数を表す。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Most of my friends walk to school.

vocabulary.english_definition: Delighting the senses or exciting intellectual or emotional admiration
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 感覚を活気づけ、知的情緒的賞賛を喚起する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: What is more beautiful than the smile of a child?

vocabulary.english_definition: At or within a short distance in space or time or having elements near each other
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 空間にせよ時間にせよ短い距離か短い距離内にある、あるいは要素が互いに近くにある。
vocabulary.example_sentence: How close to each other were you standing?

vocabulary.english_definition: Unlike in nature or quality or form or degree
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 本質、性質、形体または程度において同様でない。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I need to move to a different country.

vocabulary.english_definition: as much or as many as needed
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 必要な量や程度を満たしていること。enough time、old enough の語順に注意。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We have enough time to finish the game.

vocabulary.english_definition: Exercising or taking care great enough to bring assurance
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 保証をもたらすのに十分な運動をする、あるいは世話を行うさま。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Could you please check the door to make sure that it's locked?

vocabulary.english_definition: prepared to do something
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 必要な準備ができていること。ready to の後ろは動詞の原形。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Are you ready to leave for school?

vocabulary.english_definition: Showing or causing joy and pleasure; especially made happy
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 喜びを示す、または引き起こす。特に幸せにされる。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I didn't think you'd be here, but I'm glad you are.

vocabulary.english_definition: Travel from place to place, as for the purpose of finding work, preaching, or acting as a judge
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 仕事を見つける、説教をする、裁判官の働く目的であちこちを旅行する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I need to work for a year in order to have enough money to travel.

vocabulary.english_definition: Invite someone to one's house
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 家に人を招待する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I would like to invite you to dinner.

vocabulary.english_definition: Become part of; become a member of a group or organization
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 一部になる。グループか組織のメンバーになる。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I think I should join a study group.

vocabulary.english_definition: (botany) a living organism lacking the power of locomotion
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 移動力のない、生命を持つ有機体。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Can you water the plants in the living room, please?

vocabulary.english_definition: Make visible or noticeable
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 見えるか、または目立たせる。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Please show me that one in the window over there.

vocabulary.english_definition: to start to be something
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: ある状態や立場になること。後ろに名詞や形容詞を置く。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I want to become a teacher in the future.

vocabulary.english_definition: Have or hold in one's hands or grip
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: その人の手または掴むことで持つ、あるいは固定する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Please hold for a moment while I check on that.

vocabulary.english_definition: An institution created to conduct business
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 事業を行うために創設された機関。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I wanted to start a company, but I never got started.

vocabulary.english_definition: Any of various small flat sweet cakes ('biscuit' is the British term)
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 小型で平らな甘い菓子。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Do you want a cookie or something?

vocabulary.english_definition: A person who operates a farm
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 農場を経営する人。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I should have become a farmer like my father wanted.

vocabulary.english_definition: A plot of ground where plants are cultivated
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 植物を耕す小区画地。
vocabulary.example_sentence: What did you plant in your garden this year?

vocabulary.english_definition: The content of cognition; the main thing you are thinking about
