vocabulary.example_sentence: It was cloudy this morning, but now it's sunny.

vocabulary.english_definition: Involving or causing danger or risk; liable to hurt or harm
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 危機または危険を起こすまたはそれらを伴う。苦痛または危害を招きやすい。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I don't want to do anything that might be dangerous.

vocabulary.english_definition: Relatively deep or strong; affecting one deeply
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 比較的深い、または強いさま。深く影響するさま。
vocabulary.example_sentence: My sleep at night is not very deep.

vocabulary.english_definition: Easy and not involved or complicated
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 簡単である、そして、かかわっていない、または複雑ではない。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I read this book when I was in elementary school.

vocabulary.english_definition: Affording satisfaction or pleasure
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 満足または喜びを与えるさま。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I wanted my life to be more enjoyable.

vocabulary.japanese_meaning: よく知っている、なじみのある
vocabulary.english_definition: Well known or easily recognized
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: よく知られているか、または容易に認識される。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I was not familiar with this song.
vocabulary.raw_japanese_extraction: よく知っている、なじみのある
vocabulary.source_japanese_meaning: よく知っている、なじみのある

vocabulary.english_definition: Recently made, produced, or harvested
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 最近作られた、生産された、または収穫された。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I bought some fresh bread on the way home.

vocabulary.english_definition: Arousing or provoking laughter
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 笑いを起こすか、誘うさま。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You look funny in the hat.

vocabulary.english_definition: Be agreeable or acceptable to
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 好ましいか、許容できる。

vocabulary.english_definition: Guess correctly; solve by guessing
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 正しく推量する。推測することによって、解決する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I will guess the number.

vocabulary.english_definition: Form a mental image of something that is not present or that is not the case
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 存在しない、あるいは、事実と異なる心像を形成する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I can imagine why you don't want to talk to her.

vocabulary.english_definition: Bring before the public for the first time, as of an actor, song, etc.
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 最初に公の場に俳優、歌などを紹介する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I didn't get a chance to introduce myself to her.

vocabulary.english_definition: Move forward by leaps and bounds
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 飛躍的に前進する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I was about to jump over the wall.

vocabulary.english_definition: Mean or intend to express or convey
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 表現することまたは伝達することを意味するあるいは意図する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: What do you mean, why don't I ever say it?

vocabulary.english_definition: Make a request for something
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 何かのために要求する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Please let me know when you are ready to order.

vocabulary.english_definition: A piece of information about circumstances that exist or events that have occurred
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 実存する状況、または発生した出来事についての情報。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You must state the fact as it is.

vocabulary.english_definition: the part of a plant, such as an apple, that people often eat
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: リンゴなどの果物。一般的な総称では不可算名詞。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I usually eat some fruit with my breakfast.

vocabulary.english_definition: A movable barrier in a fence or wall
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: フェンスや壁についている移動可能の障害。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I got out of my car and opened the gate.

vocabulary.english_definition: Something acquired without compensation
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 保証なしで得られる何か。
vocabulary.example_sentence: My gift is in the car. I'll get it now.

vocabulary.english_definition: The state of affairs that a plan is intended to achieve and that (when achieved) terminates behavior intended to achieve it
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 計画が達成することを目的とし、それを達成するために意図される行動を終わらせる出来事の状態。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We won't give up when we've almost reached the goal.

vocabulary.english_definition: Small golden or orange-red freshwater fishes of Eurasia used as pond or aquarium fishes
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 池か観賞魚として使用されるユーラシアの小さい金色の、または、オレンジ赤の淡水魚。
vocabulary.example_sentence: My goldfish looks sick. I wonder what's wrong with it.

vocabulary.english_definition: Pain in the head caused by dilation of cerebral arteries or muscle contractions or a reaction to drugs
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 脳動脈の拡張、筋肉収縮、薬反応による頭痛。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Do you have something to make this headache go away?

vocabulary.english_definition: A healthy state of wellbeing free from disease
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 病気をしない幸せな健康な状態。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You should take care of your health and well-being.

vocabulary.english_definition: A local and well-defined elevation of the land
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 土地の部分的な、はっきりした隆起。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Our house is at the very top of the hill.

vocabulary.english_definition: an activity you enjoy doing in your free time
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 自由な時間に楽しむ趣味。
vocabulary.example_sentence: My favorite hobby is taking photos of birds.

vocabulary.english_definition: a stay in a local family's home, often while studying abroad
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 留学などで現地の家庭に滞在すること。
vocabulary.example_sentence: My homestay family helped me practice English every day.

vocabulary.english_definition: trousers made from strong cotton cloth called denim
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: デニム地のズボン。a pair of jeans で一本。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I bought a new pair of jeans yesterday.

vocabulary.english_definition: Metal device shaped in such a way that when it is inserted into the appropriate lock the lock's mechanism can be rotated
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 錠に差し込んだとき錠前のメカニズムが回転するように型取られた金属器具。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I must have lost my key along the way.

vocabulary.english_definition: A young person of either sex
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 両方の性別の若者。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I just want to go home and see my wife and the kids.

vocabulary.english_definition: One thousand grams; the basic unit of mass adopted under the Systeme International d'Unites
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 1,000グラム。国際単位系で採用されている質量の基本単位。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I want to buy a kilogram of that.

vocabulary.english_definition: Any living or extinct member of the family Hominidae characterized by superior intelligence, articulate speech, and erect carriage
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 優れた知性、明晰に聞き取れる言葉と垂直の歩行で特徴づけられるヒト科の生きているか絶滅した一部のいずれか。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I want you to live more like a human being.

vocabulary.english_definition: a smaller amount or degree
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 量や程度がより少ないこと。主に数えられない名詞と使う。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I want to spend less time on my phone.

vocabulary.english_definition: Not wide
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 広くない。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We have to find a way to narrow down the list.

vocabulary.english_definition: Being complete of its kind and without defect or blemish
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: その種で完全な、または欠陥または傷のない。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You don't fall in love with somebody because he's perfect.

vocabulary.english_definition: Having little money or few possessions
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: お金または所有物がほとんどないさま。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I gave the poor boy what little money I had with me.

vocabulary.english_definition: Not private; open to or concerning the people as a whole
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 個人的でない。全体の人に対してまたはそれに関して。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I went to a public garden to rest.

vocabulary.english_definition: Showing mental alertness and calculation and resourcefulness
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 精神的な機敏さと計算と臨機応変さを示すさま。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I thought that you were smart enough to know better.

vocabulary.english_definition: Occurring or encountered or experienced or observed frequently or in accordance with regular practice or procedure
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 通常の習慣または手順に従って起こる、遭遇する、経験する、あるいはしばしば観察されるさま。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I arrived late because I didn't get up at my usual time.

vocabulary.english_definition: Move with force, "He pushed the table into a corner"
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 力による動き、。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Please push the table over this way.

vocabulary.english_definition: Become less tense, rest, or take one's ease
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 緊張がほぐれ、休止し安らかになる。
vocabulary.example_sentence: How do you like to relax after a long day?

vocabulary.english_definition: Traverse or travel on (a body of water)
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: （水域の上を）渡るまたは行く。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Do you know how to sail a boat?

vocabulary.english_definition: Help to some food; help with food or drink
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 食物を手にとる。食べモノと飲物をとる。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I used to serve food at the soup kitchen around the corner.

vocabulary.english_definition: Shake (a body part) to communicate a greeting, feeling, or cognitive state
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: （体の一部）を揺らして、挨拶、感情、または認識状態を伝える。

vocabulary.english_definition: Utter in a loud voice; talk in a loud voice (usually denoting characteristic manner of speaking)
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 大声で話す。大きな声で話す（通常、特徴的な話し方を示して）。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You don't have to shout. I can hear you.

vocabulary.english_definition: Glide down a snow-covered slope while standing on a board
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: ボードの上に立った状態で、雪で覆われた斜面を滑り下りる。

vocabulary.english_definition: A room equipped for preparing meals
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 食事を用意するための部屋。

vocabulary.english_definition: The land on which real estate is located

vocabulary.english_definition: A systematic means of communicating by the use of sounds or conventional symbols
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 音または慣習的記号を用いたコミュニケーションの体系的な手段。

vocabulary.english_definition: A professional person trained in library science and engaged in library services

vocabulary.english_definition: The head of a city government

vocabulary.english_definition: The flesh of animals (including fishes and birds and snails) used as food

vocabulary.japanese_explanation: （法的占有者である）企業を所有する人。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I went inside the house and talked to the owner.

vocabulary.english_definition: The remains (or an impression) of a plant or animal that existed in a past geological age and that has been excavated from the soil
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 昔の地質時代に存在し、土から発掘された、植物または動物の遺体（または痕跡）。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I suspect this fossil would be around a hundred grand.

vocabulary.english_definition: A married man; a woman's partner in marriage
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 結婚した男性。結婚によってある女性の配偶者となった人。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I am a man and my husband is also a man.

vocabulary.english_definition: The food served and eaten at one time
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 1回に出されて、食べる食事。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We eat a meal three times a day.

vocabulary.english_definition: A defense of some offensive behavior or some failure to keep a promise etc.
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 無礼な振舞いや約束などの不履行の弁護。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I had to come up with an excuse that could pass as true.

vocabulary.english_definition: The quality of having a superior or more favorable position
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: より優った、あるいはより好ましい位置を保つという特質。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You have an advantage over him.

vocabulary.english_definition: Not the same one or ones already mentioned or implied
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 既に述べた、または示したのと同じものではない。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I still haven't eaten the chocolate that you gave me the other day.

vocabulary.english_definition: Any of various alternatives; some other
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 様々な選択肢の総称。他の何かの。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I want to put off the lesson until another day.

vocabulary.english_definition: Differing from all others; not ordinary
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: すべての他のものと異なるさま。普通でない。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I really like talking to people in different languages.

vocabulary.english_definition: High in price or charging high prices
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 値段が高い、または高い値段で請求する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I can't afford to shop at such an expensive store.

vocabulary.english_definition: as much or as many as needed
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 必要な量や程度を満たしていること。enough time、old enough の語順に注意。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We have enough time to finish the game.

vocabulary.english_definition: Not easy; requiring great physical or mental effort to accomplish or comprehend or endure
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 簡単でない。完成させ、理解しまたは我慢する物理的または精神的努力を必要とする。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I realize this is a difficult time for you.

vocabulary.english_definition: At or within a short distance in space or time or having elements near each other
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 空間にせよ時間にせよ短い距離か短い距離内にある、あるいは要素が互いに近くにある。
vocabulary.example_sentence: How close to each other were you standing?

vocabulary.english_definition: Relating to or applicable to or concerned with the administration of a city or town or district rather than a larger area
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 関係しているか適切であるか、より大きいというよりむしろ管理に都市、町または地区について関係がある領域。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I left my local area for the first time in a few days.

vocabulary.english_definition: Belonging to or on behalf of a specified person (especially yourself); preceded by a possessive
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 特定の人（とくにあなた自身）のために、またはそれに属する。所有格によって先行される。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Do you make your own clothes?

vocabulary.english_definition: Unable to see
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 見ることができない。
vocabulary.example_sentence: What would you do if you went blind?

vocabulary.english_definition: Limited to or in the interests of a particular nation
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 特定の国に限られる、または、特定の国のための。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We took a trip to a national park.

vocabulary.english_definition: Immediately following in time or order
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 直ちに時間あるいは命令に続くさま。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I would like to place an order for the following.

vocabulary.english_definition: Concerning or belonging to all or at least two or more nations
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: すべての国、あるいは少なくとも2カ国以上の国に関係があるか、または属しているさま。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I would like to learn English for international travel.

vocabulary.english_definition: Hold back, as of a danger or an enemy; check the expansion or influence of
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 制止する、の危険のようなあるいは敵のように。それの拡張または影響を確認する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I decided to go back to check whether I'd locked the door.

vocabulary.english_definition: Dismiss from the mind; stop remembering
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 心から棄却する。覚えることを止める。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I wouldn't be able to forget you even if I tried.

vocabulary.english_definition: Be a guiding or motivating force or drive
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 案内する、強く動機するあるいは駆り立てる。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I don't know who should guide me.

vocabulary.english_definition: Have or hold in one's hands or grip
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: その人の手または掴むことで持つ、あるいは固定する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Please hold for a moment while I check on that.

vocabulary.english_definition: Be responsible for reporting the details of, as in journalism
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: ジャーナリズムのように、詳細を報告する役割を果たす。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I don't have anything new to report.

vocabulary.english_definition: Go or come back to place, condition, or activity where one has been before
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 以前いた場所、状況または活動へ向かうまたは戻る。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You must return the ring to where it came from.

vocabulary.english_definition: Give a certain impression or have a certain outward aspect
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: ある印象を与える、またはある外観を持つ。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You don't seem to like to do that very much.

vocabulary.english_definition: to teach or practice skills for a task
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 必要な技術や能力が身につくよう練習・指導すること。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We train together every Saturday before the tournament.

vocabulary.english_definition: Stay in one place and anticipate or expect something
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 1つの場所にとどまり、何かを予想する、または期待する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I had to wait for him for five hours!

vocabulary.english_definition: Invite someone to one's house
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 家に人を招待する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I would like to invite you to dinner.

vocabulary.english_definition: Appear in a certain way
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: ある方法で、現れる。
vocabulary.example_sentence: What would you say to sound like a man?

vocabulary.english_definition: Perceive by the sense of taste
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 味の感覚によって知覚する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Do you want to taste my ice cream?

vocabulary.english_definition: Be worried, concerned, anxious, troubled, or uneasy
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 胸を痛める、憂慮している、案じている、問題を抱えている、または不安である。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I don't think it's anything we need to worry about.

vocabulary.english_definition: The organization that is the governing authority of a political unit
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 政治体の行政部門である組織。
vocabulary.example_sentence: What do you do for the government?

vocabulary.english_definition: A message received and understood
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 受け取られて、理解されるメッセージ。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Do you really want this information to be made public?

vocabulary.english_definition: A medical procedure involving an incision with instruments; performed to repair damage or arrest disease in a living body
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 器具を使用しての切開を伴う医療行為。生体の損傷を修復する、または疾病を食い止めるために行われる。
vocabulary.example_sentence: How long will the operation take?

vocabulary.english_definition: A phenomenon that follows and is caused by some previous phenomenon
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: ある先行する現象に続く現象、またはある先行する現象を原因とする現象。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Can you tell me when I can have the results of the test?

vocabulary.english_definition: A possibility due to a favorable combination of circumstances
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 状況の好ましい組み合わせによる可能性。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You never gave us a chance.

vocabulary.english_definition: Clothing in general
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 一般的に衣服。
vocabulary.example_sentence: My father does not care about his clothes at all.

vocabulary.english_definition: two people or things together
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 二人や二つの組。a couple of は「二つの」「二、三の」。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I'll be ready in a couple of minutes.

vocabulary.english_definition: The accumulation of knowledge or skill that results from direct participation in events or activities
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 行事や活動に直接かかわることで得た技術や知識の蓄積。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I have some experience in that area as well.

vocabulary.english_definition: A piece of information about circumstances that exist or events that have occurred
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 実存する状況、または発生した出来事についての情報。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You must state the fact as it is.

vocabulary.english_definition: The time yet to come
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: まだ到来していない時間。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I never think about the future. It comes soon enough.

vocabulary.english_definition: A computer network consisting of a worldwide network of computer networks that use the TCP/IP network protocols to facilitate data transmission and exchange
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: データの通信や交換を容易にするためにTCP/IPネットワークプロトコルを用いた、世界的に広がったネットワークから成るコンピュータネットワーク。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You can make a computer-to-computer call on the internet for free!

vocabulary.japanese_meaning: 女性への丁寧な呼びかけ
vocabulary.english_definition: a polite way of addressing a woman
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 女性に丁寧に呼びかけるときの語。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Excuse me, ma'am. Is this your bag?
vocabulary.raw_japanese_extraction: 女性への丁寧な呼びかけ
vocabulary.source_japanese_meaning: 女性への丁寧な呼びかけ

vocabulary.english_definition: A small figure of a person operated from above with strings by a puppeteer
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 人形師によって糸で上から操作される人の小さな人形。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Do you happen to think that I'm your puppet?

vocabulary.english_definition: Unique or specific to a person or thing or category
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 人、物またはカテゴリーに特有または限られた。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Do you have anyone special in mind for the job?

vocabulary.english_definition: Capable of being perceived by the senses; not abstract or imaginary
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 感覚によって感知されることができる。抽象的でないまたは非実在的でない。
vocabulary.example_sentence: What do you intend to do with the concrete?

vocabulary.english_definition: Involving or causing danger or risk; liable to hurt or harm
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 危機または危険を起こすまたはそれらを伴う。苦痛または危害を招きやすい。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I don't want to do anything that might be dangerous.

vocabulary.english_definition: Consistent with fact or reality; not false
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 事実か現実と一致している。間違っていない。
vocabulary.example_sentence: What he said was by no means true.

vocabulary.english_definition: Functioning or occurring in a normal way; lacking abnormalities or deficiencies
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 普通に機能すること、または、発生するさま。異常または欠陥がないこと。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I guess it's only natural.

vocabulary.english_definition: Full of or characterized by loud and nonmusical sounds
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 大きくて音楽的でないな音で満ちている、または、大きくて音楽的でないな音に特徴づけられる。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I can't study anywhere in my house. It's too noisy.

vocabulary.english_definition: Free from danger or the risk of harm
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 危険や危害のリスクがない。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I will take you to a safe place.

vocabulary.english_definition: (used with count nouns) of an indefinite number more than 2 or 3 but not many
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 2または3よりも大きいが多くはない不定数の数。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I read the word several times, but couldn't remember it.

vocabulary.english_definition: Not commonly encountered
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 一般的に出会わない。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I saw something very unusual on my way here.

vocabulary.english_definition: Of or associated with the great masses of people
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 人々の大きな集団に関するまたはそれの。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I have a lot in common with him.

vocabulary.japanese_meaning: 親しみやすい、友好的な
vocabulary.english_definition: Characteristic of or befitting a friend
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 友人の特徴または、に適するさま。
vocabulary.example_sentence: My uncle gave me a friendly piece of advice.
vocabulary.raw_japanese_extraction: 親しみやすい、友好的な
vocabulary.source_japanese_meaning: 親しみやすい、友好的な

vocabulary.english_definition: Capable of happening or existing
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 起きるまたは存在できる。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I want to read as many English books as possible this year.

vocabulary.english_definition: Emitting or reflecting light readily or in large amounts
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 光をすぐに、あるいは大量に発する、または反射するさま。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Do you have a bright light for reading?

vocabulary.english_definition: Come into the company of
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: その仲間に加わる。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We were thinking of asking you to join our company.

vocabulary.english_definition: Fail to keep or to maintain; cease to have, either physically or in an abstract sense
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 保つこと、または維持することができない。物理的または抽象的に持つことをやめる。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I wish I could lose weight and keep it off.

vocabulary.english_definition: Keep in mind for attention or consideration
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 注意か考慮を念頭に置く。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Do you think you can remember the way home?

vocabulary.english_definition: Move with difficulty, by grasping
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 掴むことで、どうにか移動する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I loved to climb trees when I was a kid.

vocabulary.english_definition: Exchange or replace with another, usually of the same kind or category
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 別のものと交換する、取り替える、通常同じ種類またはカテゴリーのものと。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Could you please exchange some small change with me?

vocabulary.english_definition: Present for acceptance or rejection
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 承諾または拒絶を示す。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I was going to offer to buy you a drink.

vocabulary.japanese_meaning: 演じる、上演する、実行する
vocabulary.english_definition: Give a performance (of something)
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: （何かの）公演をする。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I do not like to perform in front of others.
vocabulary.raw_japanese_extraction: 演じる、上演する、実行する
vocabulary.source_japanese_meaning: 演じる、上演する、実行する

vocabulary.english_definition: Select carefully from a group
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: グループから注意深く選択する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I could pick you up on my way to work.

vocabulary.english_definition: Restore by replacing a part or putting together what is torn or broken
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 部分を取り替えるまたは裂けているか、壊れているものを組み立てることにより修復する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: What would it cost to repair this chair?

vocabulary.english_definition: Discuss formally with (somebody) for the purpose of an evaluation
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: （誰か）に対する評価の目的で正式に討議する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We found someone else to interview for our school project.

vocabulary.english_definition: Travel from place to place, as for the purpose of finding work, preaching, or acting as a judge
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 仕事を見つける、説教をする、裁判官の働く目的であちこちを旅行する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I need to work for a year in order to have enough money to travel.

vocabulary.english_definition: Consider obligatory; request and expect
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 義務的であると考える。要求し、期待する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: How much help do you think we can expect to get?

vocabulary.japanese_meaning: 逃す、乗り損なう、寂しく思う
vocabulary.english_definition: Fail to attend an event or activity
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 行事や活動に参加しそこなう。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I wouldn't want to miss your concert.
vocabulary.raw_japanese_extraction: 逃す、乗り損なう、寂しく思う
vocabulary.source_japanese_meaning: 逃す、乗り損なう、寂しく思う

vocabulary.english_definition: An unfortunate mishap; especially one causing damage or injury
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 不運な災難。特に損害か負傷をもたらすもの。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I want to know what caused the accident.

vocabulary.english_definition: A period of 100 years
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 100年の期間。
vocabulary.example_sentence: How many years are there in a century?

vocabulary.english_definition: The side that is forward or prominent
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 前方あるいは目立つ面。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I like to sit in the front of the bus.

vocabulary.english_definition: A visitor to whom hospitality is extended
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: もてなしを受ける訪問者。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Can you tell me where I can find a guest house?

vocabulary.english_definition: Someone who is a member of the faculty at a college or university
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 大学または大学の学部のメンバーである誰か。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I ran into my professor at a restaurant last night.

vocabulary.english_definition: The general activity of selling
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 販売の一般的な活動。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I got it for half price at a sale.

vocabulary.english_definition: The aggregation of things (pedestrians or vehicles) coming and going in a particular locality during a specified period of time
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: ある特殊の時間内に特殊の場所で物が行き来する寄り合い状態。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We made good time since the traffic was light.

vocabulary.english_definition: A conveyance that transports people or objects
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 人や物を運ぶ乗物。
vocabulary.example_sentence: How did that vehicle end up here?

vocabulary.english_definition: A characteristic property that defines the apparent individual nature of something
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 何かの見た目の個々の性質を定める特徴のある性質。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We are looking for a house with some character.

vocabulary.english_definition: Natural abilities or qualities
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 天賦の才または特性。
vocabulary.example_sentence: My gift is in the car. I'll get it now.

vocabulary.english_definition: A wrong action attributable to bad judgment or ignorance or inattention
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: まずい判断や怠慢、不注意を原因とする誤った行動。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I don't understand how I could've made such a mistake.

vocabulary.english_definition: A traveler riding in a vehicle (a boat or bus or car or plane or train etc) who is not operating it
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 乗り物（船、バス、車、飛行機、列車等）で旅をし、その運転・操縦をしていない人。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I feel nervous when I am a passenger on a bus.

vocabulary.english_definition: A structure that provides privacy and protection from danger
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 危険からプライバシーと保護を提供する構造物。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We were using it as a shelter.

vocabulary.english_definition: Providing or experiencing physical well-being or relief ('comfy' is informal)
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 身体的な幸福または安心を提供するか、経験するさま。
vocabulary.example_sentence: What can I do to make you feel more comfortable?

vocabulary.english_definition: very pleasant to taste
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 食べ物や飲み物の味がとてもよいこと。
vocabulary.example_sentence: This soup is delicious. Can I have some more?

vocabulary.english_definition: Has a good chance of being the case or of coming about
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 実状となる、または起こる十分な可能性を有するさま。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I don't think that it's likely to rain tomorrow.

vocabulary.english_definition: Earlier than the present time; no longer current
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 現在より早い。もはや電流でない。
vocabulary.example_sentence: How many times have you been ill in the past year?

vocabulary.english_definition: In a natural state; not tamed or domesticated or cultivated
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 自然な状態で。抑えられない、家畜化されていない、耕作されない。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I saw the girls pick the wild flowers.

vocabulary.english_definition: Exercising caution or showing care or attention
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 警戒する、留意または注意を示すさま。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You must be very careful when you do that.

vocabulary.english_definition: Relatively low in price or charging low prices
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 価格が比較的低い、または安値で課金しているさま。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I don't think it would be cheap to do that.

vocabulary.english_definition: Holding or containing nothing
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 何も持たないか、含まないさま。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I found her cat in an empty room.

vocabulary.english_definition: More than is needed, desired, or required
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 必要である、希望される、あるいは必要であるより多いもの。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We might need the extra room.

vocabulary.english_definition: Well known or easily recognized
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: よく知られているか、または容易に認識される。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I was not familiar with this song.

vocabulary.english_definition: Marked by dejection from being alone
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 一人であることからの落胆により特徴づけられる。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I felt sad and lonely.

vocabulary.english_definition: Characterized by or producing sound of great volume or intensity
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 大音量、または激しい音により特徴づけられる、またはそれを生じる。
vocabulary.example_sentence: My father always speaks in a very loud voice.

vocabulary.english_definition: Most important element
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 最も重要な要素。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We tried with might and main to break open the door.

vocabulary.english_definition: Make ready or suitable or equip in advance for a particular purpose or for some use, event, etc
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 特定の目的、使用、あるいは出来事のためにあらかじめ準備しておく、整える、備える。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I have to prepare to go to school.

vocabulary.english_definition: Be the winner in a contest or competition; be victorious
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: コンテストまたは競争の勝者である。勝利している。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Our team is likely to win the game.

vocabulary.english_definition: Move while supporting, either in a vehicle or in one's hands or on one's body
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 車両で、人手で、または、身に付けて、維持している間に移動する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You must carry the keys with you at all times.

vocabulary.english_definition: Make by combining materials and parts
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 材料および部品を合成して作る。
vocabulary.example_sentence: How long did it take you to build your house?

vocabulary.japanese_meaning: 気にかける、世話をする
vocabulary.english_definition: Provide care for
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 世話をする。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Do you think anyone would care if I did that?
vocabulary.raw_japanese_extraction: 気にかける、世話をする
vocabulary.source_japanese_meaning: 気にかける、世話をする

vocabulary.english_definition: Be priced at
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 値段がつく。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I do not know how much it can cost now.

vocabulary.english_definition: Bring into existence
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 存在する状態まで導く。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We don't want to create any new problems.

vocabulary.english_definition: Plan something for a specific role or purpose or effect
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 特殊の役割、目的または効果のために何かを計画する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I am looking for friends who can design immediately.

vocabulary.english_definition: Become bigger or greater in amount
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 量がより大きくなる。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I would like to increase the price.

vocabulary.english_definition: Bring before the public for the first time, as of an actor, song, etc.
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 最初に公の場に俳優、歌などを紹介する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I didn't get a chance to introduce myself to her.

vocabulary.english_definition: Like better; value more highly
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: より好む。より高く評価する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I would prefer to stay home rather than go out.

vocabulary.english_definition: Become less tense, rest, or take one's ease
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 緊張がほぐれ、休止し安らかになる。
vocabulary.example_sentence: How do you like to relax after a long day?

vocabulary.english_definition: Move fast by using one's feet, with one foot off the ground at any given time
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 自分の足を使って、常時地面から片足を上げ、速く動く。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I was driving too fast and ran off the road.

vocabulary.english_definition: The rays of the sun
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 太陽の光線。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We need to get outside of this office if we want some sunlight.

vocabulary.english_definition: A source of difficulty
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 困難のもと。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I am having trouble with one thing after another.

vocabulary.english_definition: The place where a person or organization can be found or communicated with
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 個人や組織が所在し、連絡をとれる場所。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I can't for the life of me remember her address.

vocabulary.english_definition: A gathering of spectators or listeners at a (usually public) performance
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: （通常は公共の場で）公演を観たり聴いたりする人々の集まり。
vocabulary.example_sentence: How many people do you think are in the audience?

vocabulary.english_definition: someone who works with you
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 同じ職場で働く同僚。coworker とも書く。
vocabulary.example_sentence: My co-worker helped me prepare for the meeting.

vocabulary.english_definition: Any of numerous extinct terrestrial reptiles of the Mesozoic era
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 絶滅した多くの中生代の陸生爬虫類の総称。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I failed as a person. I'm a dinosaur now.

vocabulary.english_definition: A person with special knowledge or ability who performs skillfully
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 特別な知識や能力を持ち、巧みに遂行する人。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I don't need to be an expert. I just know.

vocabulary.japanese_meaning: はちみつ、（呼びかけ）あなた
vocabulary.english_definition: a sweet food made by bees; an affectionate form of address
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 蜂が作る甘い蜜。親しい相手への呼びかけにも使う。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Would you like some honey in your tea?
vocabulary.raw_japanese_extraction: はちみつ、（呼びかけ）あなた
vocabulary.source_japanese_meaning: はちみつ、（呼びかけ）あなた

vocabulary.english_definition: A way of doing something, especially a systematic way; implies an orderly logical arrangement (usually in steps)
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 何かを行う方法、特に体系的なもの。秩序だって理論的な（通常、段階を進んでいく）方法を意味する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I can say from experience that this method works.

vocabulary.english_definition: The number that is represented as a one followed by 6 zeros
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 6つのゼロの続く数として表現される数。
vocabulary.example_sentence: What would you do if you had a million dollars?

vocabulary.english_definition: Wild and domesticated birds having a heavy body and short legs
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 重い体と短い足がある野生や家畜の鳥。
vocabulary.example_sentence: My pigeon returned in the evening, seriously injured.

vocabulary.english_definition: A lump or mass of hard consolidated mineral matter
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 固い統合鉱物質の塊か固まり。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We found ourselves between a rock and a hard place.

vocabulary.english_definition: Work done by one person or group that benefits another
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 1人やグループで他の人のためにする仕事。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You have done me a service that I cannot forget.

vocabulary.english_definition: Close at hand
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: すぐ近くに。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We have prepared ourselves to leave for the nearby area.

vocabulary.english_definition: Absolutely essential
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 必要不可欠な。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Do you really believe that doing that is absolutely necessary?

vocabulary.english_definition: (of a church) given official status as a national or state institution
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: （教会について）国家または州の機関として公式の地位を与えられた。
vocabulary.example_sentence: What is the official language of your country?

vocabulary.english_definition: Not exceptional in any way especially in quality or ability or size or degree
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 特に質、能力、大きさまたは度合において例外的ではない。
vocabulary.example_sentence: How many times do you laugh in an ordinary day?

vocabulary.english_definition: Confined to particular persons or groups or providing privacy
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 特定の人、グループに制限された、あるいはプライバシーを提供するさま。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I didn't want to talk about my private life.

vocabulary.english_definition: Characterized by an absence or near absence of agitation or activity
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 困惑または行動の欠如またはほぼ欠如することによって特徴づけられる。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I came out here to enjoy some peace and quiet.

vocabulary.english_definition: Marked by correspondence or resemblance
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 一致または類似を特徴とする。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I had a similar problem when I lived in Boston.

vocabulary.english_definition: Feeling worry or concern or insecurity
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 心配、関心または不安定を感じる。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I am afraid we ran out of time for this.

vocabulary.english_definition: Belonging to times long past especially of the historical period before the fall of the Western Roman Empire
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 特に西のローマ帝国の没落の前の歴史の期間の遠い過去時間に属するさま。
vocabulary.example_sentence: What was life like for children back in ancient history?

vocabulary.english_definition: Definite but not specified or identified
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 明確だが、指定されていないあるいは特定されていない。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I do not know for certain when he will come.

vocabulary.english_definition: Occurring at or forming an end or termination
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 終わりまたは末端に生じる、あるいは形成するさま。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I spent the final days of the year together with my family.

vocabulary.english_definition: Not disposed to cheat or defraud; not deceptive or fraudulent
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 騙すまたは詐欺をする意図のない。騙すまたは詐欺的でない。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I had to look it up myself, to be honest.

vocabulary.english_definition: Easily agitated
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 興奮しやすい。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I didn't know that you were going to be nervous.

vocabulary.english_definition: To keep up and reserve for personal or special use
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 私的または特別の使用のために続けるまたは取っておく。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I will save up money for when I'm old.

vocabulary.english_definition: Make an addition (to); join or combine or unite with others; increase the quality, quantity, size or scope of
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 追加する（に対して）。加わるか、組み合わさるか、または他と結合する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We didn't need to add flowers to the car to make it beautiful.

vocabulary.english_definition: Consent or assent to a condition, or agree to do something
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 状態の承諾または同意、または、何かすることに同意する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Do you think he will agree to come with us?

vocabulary.japanese_meaning: 現れる、〜のように見える
vocabulary.english_definition: Come into sight or view
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 見えてくるかあるいは見える。
vocabulary.example_sentence: My father is to appear on TV tonight.
vocabulary.raw_japanese_extraction: 現れる、〜のように見える
vocabulary.source_japanese_meaning: 現れる、〜のように見える

vocabulary.english_definition: Get temporarily
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 一時的に得る。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I ran all over town trying to borrow some money.

vocabulary.english_definition: to stop being alive
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 命が終わること。過去形と過去分詞は died。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Plants can die if they do not get enough water.

vocabulary.english_definition: To make better
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: よりよくする。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I just want to improve as much as I can.

vocabulary.english_definition: Mean or intend to express or convey
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 表現することまたは伝達することを意味するあるいは意図する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: What do you mean, why don't I ever say it?

vocabulary.english_definition: Be offended or bothered by; take offense with, be bothered by
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: おこらせているか、または迷惑を掛けられる。に対して腹を立てる、あるいは、に悩んでいる。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I don't think he would mind.

vocabulary.english_definition: Put or set (seeds, seedlings, or plants) into the ground
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: （種子、苗、または植物）を地面に埋める、または植えつける。
vocabulary.example_sentence: What kind of flowers do you want to plant in your garden?

vocabulary.english_definition: Get something; come into possession of
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 何かを得る。所有物として手に入れる。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I hope to receive a letter from you soon.

vocabulary.english_definition: Engage for service under a term of contract
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 契約条件によりサービスを請け負う。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We want to rent an apartment in the city.

vocabulary.english_definition: React verbally
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 言葉で反応する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I don't know how to reply to that question.

vocabulary.english_definition: Clothing of distinctive design worn by members of a particular group as a means of identification
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 特定のグループの構成員が所属を明確にするために着る、特有のデザインの服。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You weren't wearing your uniform the last time I saw you.

vocabulary.english_definition: The waging of armed conflict against an enemy
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 敵に対する武力紛争の行い。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I am against the war, of course.

vocabulary.english_definition: A proposal for an appropriate course of action
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 適切な方針の提案。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I need your advice on what I should do next.

vocabulary.english_definition: Nonfictional prose forming an independent part of a publication
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 出版物の独立した部分を成すノンフィクションの散文。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You didn't tell them what you wrote in that article.

vocabulary.english_definition: The act of discovering something
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 何かを発見する行為。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I was surprised at the discovery.

vocabulary.english_definition: Something that happens at a given place and time
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 所定の場所・時刻で起こる事。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Do you know when the event took place?

vocabulary.english_definition: An instance of traveling by air
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 飛行機で旅をすること。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I had to book a flight for him.

vocabulary.english_definition: The natural physical world including plants and animals and landscapes etc.
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 動植物、風景などを含む自然な物質的世界。
vocabulary.example_sentence: What is the nature of time?

vocabulary.english_definition: An organization of military vessels belonging to a country and available for sea warfare
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 国に属し、海戦のためにある軍艦の編成。
vocabulary.example_sentence: My father was in the navy.

vocabulary.english_definition: The property of having material worth (often indicated by the amount of money something would bring if sold)
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 物質的な価値をもつという特質（しばしば、何かが売られたときにもたらす金額によって表される）。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I wonder if this is worth the price they're asking.

vocabulary.english_definition: Something given for victory or superiority in a contest or competition or for winning a lottery
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: コンテストまたは競争の勝利または優勢のために、または、宝くじに勝つと与えられる何か。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I did everything I could to win this prize.

vocabulary.english_definition: An anticipated outcome that is intended or that guides your planned actions
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 意図している、または計画した行動を導く、予期された結果。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You need to find a purpose to your life.

vocabulary.english_definition: Personnel who assist their superior in carrying out an assigned task
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 上司が課された任務を遂行するのを補助する職員。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Do you think she can keep the staff together?

vocabulary.english_definition: In accordance with scientific laws
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 科学的な法則に従って。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I speak in my normal voice when I'm working the phone.

vocabulary.english_definition: Easily or conveniently transported
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 簡単に便利に輸送される。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I bought a portable music player.

vocabulary.english_definition: Not private; open to or concerning the people as a whole
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 個人的でない。全体の人に対してまたはそれに関して。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I went to a public garden to rest.

vocabulary.english_definition: Of the immediate past or just previous to the present time
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: すぐ最近の過去の、あるいは、現在よりちょうど少し前の時間。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We got to know each other rather well on our recent trip.

vocabulary.japanese_meaning: 成功した、うまくいった
vocabulary.english_definition: Having succeeded or being marked by a favorable outcome
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 成功したか、または良好な結果によって特徴づけられる。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I hope that your business trip to France was successful.
vocabulary.raw_japanese_extraction: 成功した、うまくいった
vocabulary.source_japanese_meaning: 成功した、うまくいった

vocabulary.english_definition: Of or relating to the Arctic
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 北極の、または、北極に関する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: The arctic summer is short, but intense.

vocabulary.english_definition: In a state of sleep
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 睡眠状態で。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We talked all night and then we fell asleep.

vocabulary.english_definition: So lacking in interest as to cause mental weariness
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: そのため原因精神的な疲労に関しての関心を欠くさま。
vocabulary.example_sentence: What can I do to make my life less boring?

vocabulary.english_definition: Not agitated; without losing self-possession
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 扇動されない。冷静さを失うことなく。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I tried to keep my voice calm.

vocabulary.english_definition: Readily apparent to the mind
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 心を見ればすぐにわかる。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I don't have a clear idea of what you mean.

vocabulary.english_definition: Suited to your comfort or purpose or needs
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 快適さまたは目的またはニーズに適している。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Please come to meet me some time when it's convenient.

vocabulary.english_definition: Socially right or correct
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 社会的に正しい。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I think what you just told me isn't correct.

vocabulary.english_definition: Obviously contrived to charm
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 明らかにうまく魅了する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I wish there were some cute guys in my class.

vocabulary.english_definition: Make it possible through a specific action or lack of action for something to happen
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 何かを起こすことを行動の特定の動きまたは、動かないことより可能にする。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I hope that your parents will allow us to marry.

vocabulary.english_definition: Massive plantigrade carnivorous or omnivorous mammals with long shaggy coats and strong claws
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 巨大な蹠行性の肉食性、または雑食性の哺乳動物で、長くて毛むくじゃらの毛と強い鉤爪を持つ。
vocabulary.example_sentence: How long does a bear sleep?

vocabulary.english_definition: Give rise to; cause to happen or occur, not always intentionally
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 引き起こす。常に意図的というわけではなく、生起させるまたは生じさせる。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I don't want to cause an accident.

vocabulary.english_definition: Continue a certain state, condition, or activity
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 特定の状態、条件または活動を続ける。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We have to continue doing this until it gets done.

vocabulary.english_definition: Provide with clothes or put clothes on
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 服を供給する、あるいは服をつけさせる。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Do you have to dress up every day for work?

vocabulary.english_definition: Act in accordance with someone's rules, commands, or wishes
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 人の支配、命令または要望の見合って行動する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You must follow the rules of the game.

vocabulary.english_definition: Receive an academic degree upon completion of one's studies
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 勉強の完了で学位を受ける。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I want my children to graduate from high school.

vocabulary.english_definition: Guess correctly; solve by guessing
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 正しく推量する。推測することによって、解決する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I will guess the number.

vocabulary.english_definition: Take in marriage
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 嫁にもらう。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I hope that your parents will allow us to marry.

vocabulary.english_definition: Shield from danger, injury, destruction, or damage
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 危険、けが、破壊または損害からの防御。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We must protect the rain forest.

vocabulary.english_definition: Try to locate or discover, or try to establish the existence of
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 見つけ、発見し、またはその存在を確定しようとする。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We don't have time to search the whole area.

vocabulary.english_definition: Put into a certain place or abstract location
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: ある一定の場所または抽象的な場所に置く。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We have to pick a place to set up the tent.

vocabulary.japanese_meaning: 〜のにおいがする、においを嗅ぐ
vocabulary.english_definition: to have or produce a particular smell
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 物から特定のにおいがすること。smell good で「よいにおいがする」。
vocabulary.example_sentence: The bread in the oven smells wonderful.
vocabulary.raw_japanese_extraction: 〜のにおいがする、においを嗅ぐ
vocabulary.source_japanese_meaning: 〜のにおいがする、においを嗅ぐ

vocabulary.english_definition: Someone who visits
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 訪問する人。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We had a visitor while you were taking a shower.

vocabulary.english_definition: A permanent organization of the military land forces of a nation or state
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 陸上の軍隊組織。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You aren't really going to join the army, are you?

vocabulary.english_definition: An itemized statement of money owed for goods shipped or services rendered
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 商品またはサービスに対して支払いの義務があるお金の明細書。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I don't think I have enough money to pay the bill.

vocabulary.english_definition: An area that is approximately central within some larger region
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: より大きなものの内部の、ほぼ真ん中にある領域。
vocabulary.example_sentence: What train goes to the center of town?

vocabulary.english_definition: The person or thing chosen or selected
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 選挙、あるいは選抜された物や人。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You have a choice of black tea, coffee, or milk.

vocabulary.english_definition: (sports) someone in charge of training an athlete or a team
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 選手やチームの指導責任者。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Do you have what it takes to be a coach?

vocabulary.english_definition: A group of people living in a particular local area
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 共通の民族、文化、宗教的な特徴を持つ人々の集団。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We consider you all a part of the community.

vocabulary.english_definition: A state at a particular time
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 一定の時の状況。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I will run under the condition that it's not raining.

vocabulary.english_definition: A specialized division of a large organization
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 大きな組織の専門化された部門。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I got a new hat at the department store.

vocabulary.english_definition: Arid land with little or no vegetation
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 植物がほとんど、あるいはまったくない不毛の地域。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We got lost in the desert with no water or food.

vocabulary.english_definition: A dish served as the last course of a meal
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 食事の最後として出される一品。
vocabulary.example_sentence: My son didn't finish the dessert, so I ate it.

vocabulary.english_definition: An isolated fact that is considered separately from the whole
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 全体から分離して考えられる独立した事実。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I guess we should go over the details at some point.

vocabulary.english_definition: Member of a board of directors
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 理事会の一員。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I want to see the director of the company.

vocabulary.english_definition: By contrast; on the other hand
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: それに反して。他方では。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I took the 10:30 train. However, it was ten minutes late.

vocabulary.english_definition: To a greater degree or extent; used with comparisons
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: より大きく、またはより広く。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We must look after her children this evening.

vocabulary.english_definition: Happening at a time subsequent to a reference time
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 言及時の後に起こること。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You knew that sooner or later it would happen, didn't you?

vocabulary.english_definition: In place of, or as an alternative to
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 代理でまたは代替手段で。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You know, maybe we should buy a computer instead.

vocabulary.english_definition: With rapid movements
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 急速な動きで。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I quickly ate my lunch and then got back to work.

vocabulary.english_definition: Up to the present time
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 現在今に至るまで。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I haven't yet had time to see about a hotel for the night.

vocabulary.english_definition: Used to imply that one would expect the fact to be the opposite of that stated; surprisingly
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 人が述べられた事実に対してその正反対であると予想するのを含意するために用いられる。意外にも。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Do you have any idea who actually wrote this letter?

vocabulary.english_definition: In the recent past
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 最近において。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I get the feeling I'm sleeping too much recently.

vocabulary.english_definition: although; despite the fact that
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 「〜だけれども」と、予想と違う事実をつなぐ。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Though it was raining, we still enjoyed the trip.

vocabulary.english_definition: At or to or from a great distance in space
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 空間において遠くで、遠くへ、または遠くから。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We live far away from each other.

vocabulary.english_definition: in or to a place that is not inside
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 建物などの外側にいることや、外へ移動すること。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Let's play outside after we finish our homework.

vocabulary.english_definition: (of actions or states) slightly short of or not quite accomplished; all but
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: （行動または状態について）少し足りない、または、完全に終わっていない。ほとんど。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I have a car, but I almost never use it.

vocabulary.english_definition: in addition to or different from what was mentioned
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 疑問詞や someone などの後で「ほかに」を表す。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Would you like anything else with your lunch?

vocabulary.english_definition: Pass to the other side of
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: その他の側面に移り変わる。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You need to turn around and go the other way.

vocabulary.english_definition: Hope for; have a wish
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 期待する。願望を持つ。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I wish I could go to the party with you.

vocabulary.english_definition: Reach a destination; arrive by movement or progress
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 目的地に着く。動くことまたは前進によって到着する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We won't be able to arrive home in time.

vocabulary.english_definition: Postpone indefinitely or annul something that was scheduled
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 予定されていたものを、無期限に延期する、または取り消す。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We had to cancel the meeting.

vocabulary.english_definition: Copy down as is
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 現状のままでコピーする。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We were made to copy some English words.

vocabulary.english_definition: Provide with a covering or cause to be covered
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: カバーを供給するか、カバーされるようにする。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You have to cover your mouth when you're sick.

vocabulary.english_definition: To come or go into
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 来るまたは中に入る。
vocabulary.example_sentence: What is the reason you want to enter this college?

vocabulary.english_definition: Come to pass
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 起こる。
vocabulary.example_sentence: What if he should happen to come late?

vocabulary.english_definition: Push for something
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 何かを要求する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I would recommend this book even more than the first.

vocabulary.english_definition: Take without the owner's consent
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 持ち主の同意なしに取る。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We always knew he would steal from the store.

vocabulary.english_definition: Propel through the air
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 空気中で推進する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: My wife asked me to throw this old hat away.

vocabulary.english_definition: Have a wish or desire to know something
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 何かを知ろうとする願望または欲望を持つ。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I had to wonder what the future held for the two of us.

vocabulary.english_definition: Stay clear from; keep away from; keep out of the way of someone or something
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 接触がないままでいる。離れた状態を維持する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We took a back road to avoid the heavy traffic.

vocabulary.english_definition: The property created by the space between two objects or points
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 2つの物や点の間の空間によって作り出される特質。
vocabulary.example_sentence: What is the distance between here and there?

vocabulary.english_definition: A worker who is hired to perform a job
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 仕事をするために雇われた労働者。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I am an employee at a company.

vocabulary.english_definition: a year or level in school
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 学校での学年を表す。成績の意味でも使う。
vocabulary.example_sentence: My brother is in the fifth grade this year.

vocabulary.english_definition: A healthy state of wellbeing free from disease
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 病気をしない幸せな健康な状態。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You should take care of your health and well-being.

vocabulary.english_definition: A formal contest in which two or more persons or teams compete
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 2人以上の人またはチームが競争する正式なコンテスト。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I am glad that your team won the match.

vocabulary.english_definition: A person who lives (or is located) near another
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 誰か他人の近くに住んでいる人。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You have a phone call from a man who says he's your neighbor.

vocabulary.english_definition: An extended fictional work in prose; usually in the form of a story
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 散文で書かれた長い虚構の作品。普通物語の形である。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I was in Algeria, working on a novel.

vocabulary.english_definition: The act of presenting a play or a piece of music or other entertainment
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 演劇や音楽作品や他の演芸を上演すること。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I don't think that his performance was any good.

vocabulary.english_definition: A search for knowledge
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 知識を得るための調査。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Our company wants to take part in that research project.

vocabulary.english_definition: A statement that limits or restricts some claim
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: ある主張を制限または限定する言明。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I would like to make a reservation for one person.

vocabulary.english_definition: A toilet that is available to the public
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 公衆に利用できるトイレ。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I think I shall go to the restroom for a moment.

vocabulary.english_definition: An established line of travel or access
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 往来や出入りのために作られた進路。
vocabulary.example_sentence: How long did it take you to do the route?

vocabulary.english_definition: Something that should remain hidden from others (especially information that is not to be passed on)
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 他者から隠されたままでいるもの（特に伝えられてはならない情報）。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I think we should keep this a secret.

vocabulary.english_definition: With considerable certainty; without much doubt
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: かなりの確信を持って。あまり疑いなく。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We probably won't be able to move this without some help.

vocabulary.english_definition: As the end result of a succession or process
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 継承か過程の結末として。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We finally decided to give him over to the police.

vocabulary.english_definition: By good fortune
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 幸運にも、運よく。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I could have been injured, but luckily I wasn't.

vocabulary.english_definition: (of actions or states) slightly short of or not quite accomplished; all but
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: （行動または状態について）少し足りない、または、完全に終わっていない。ほとんど。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I was nearly run over by a car.

vocabulary.english_definition: At some indefinite or unstated time
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: いくつかの不明確であるか述べられていない時刻に。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We must get together for a drink sometime.

vocabulary.english_definition: On the inside
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 内から。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I wasn't able to see who was inside the car.

vocabulary.english_definition: On one occasion
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: ある時。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I get a call from her once in a while.

vocabulary.english_definition: To a moderately sufficient extent or degree
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 適度に十分な範囲、または程度。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I went to a pretty big school.

vocabulary.english_definition: Happening at a time subsequent to a reference time
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 言及時の後に起こること。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I didn't remember his name until afterward.

vocabulary.english_definition: At the present or from now on; usually used with a negative
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 現在において、または今から。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Our children don't live here anymore.

vocabulary.english_definition: With ease ('easy' is sometimes used informally for 'easily')
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 容易さをもって。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I hope that he will find his way easily.

vocabulary.english_definition: In addition
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 加えて。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I woke up next to an unknown girl again. Moreover, she isn't ugly at all this time.

vocabulary.english_definition: To a degree (not used with a negative)
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: かなり（否定的には使用されない）。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I think that's going to happen quite soon.

vocabulary.english_definition: Cook and make edible by putting in a hot oven
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 熱いオーブンに入れて調理し、食べられるようにする。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I took a cooking class last spring and learned to bake bread.

vocabulary.english_definition: Include or contain; have as a component
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 包含するか、含む。構成要素として持つ。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I couldn't contain myself any longer.

vocabulary.japanese_meaning: 損害を与える、傷つける
vocabulary.english_definition: Inflict damage upon
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 損害を与える。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I have the power to damage him.
vocabulary.raw_japanese_extraction: 損害を与える、傷つける
vocabulary.source_japanese_meaning: 損害を与える、傷つける

vocabulary.english_definition: Be unsuccessful
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 失敗する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Do you want our business to fail?

vocabulary.japanese_meaning: 食べ物を与える、餌をやる
vocabulary.english_definition: Give food to
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 食物を与える。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I don't think we have enough food to feed everyone.
vocabulary.raw_japanese_extraction: 食べ物を与える、餌をやる
vocabulary.source_japanese_meaning: 食べ物を与える、餌をやる

vocabulary.english_definition: Be agreeable or acceptable to
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 好ましいか、許容できる。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I think that you're going to fit in just fine.

vocabulary.english_definition: Decide upon or fix definitely
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 決めるか、確実に固定する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We have to fix the date for our trip quickly.

vocabulary.english_definition: Cause emotional anguish or make miserable
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 感情的な苦悶を引き起こすか、惨めにする。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I thought that you were going to hurt me.

vocabulary.english_definition: Take somebody somewhere
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 誰かをどこかに連れて行く。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You can lead a horse to water, but you can't make him drink.

vocabulary.english_definition: Raise the level or amount of something
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 何かの水準を上げるか、または量を増やす。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Do you really want to raise these children by yourself?

vocabulary.english_definition: Settle, as of a debt
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 負債のようなものを解決する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I tried to solve the problem, which I found impossible.

vocabulary.english_definition: Cause to become awake or conscious
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 目が覚める、意識がある。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Please wake me at six am.

vocabulary.english_definition: Spend thoughtlessly; throw away
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 軽率に費やす。浪費する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You must be careful not to waste time.

vocabulary.english_definition: A message that is stated or declared; a communication (oral or written) setting forth particulars or facts etc
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 述べられたまたは言い切られたメッセージ。詳細や事実などについて述べる（口頭、または書面の）コミュニケーション。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I don't think that anyone would agree with that statement.

vocabulary.english_definition: An arbitrary sign (written or printed) that has acquired a conventional significance
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 慣習的な意味を獲得した任意の（書かれたまたは印刷された）記号。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I give you this ring as a symbol of my love.

vocabulary.english_definition: Edible seeds or roots or stems or leaves or bulbs or tubers or nonsweet fruits of any of numerous herbaceous plant
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 多数の草本植物の食用の種、根、茎、葉、球根、塊茎、あるいは甘くない果実。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You wash the vegetables and I'll wash the fruit.

vocabulary.english_definition: A successful ending of a struggle or contest
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 戦いや競争が成功裏に終わること。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We paid a heavy price for this victory.

vocabulary.english_definition: The visual percept of a region
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: ある区域の視覚イメージ。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I built a house with a view of the mountain.

vocabulary.english_definition: Any specific behavior
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 特定の行動。
vocabulary.example_sentence: What activity do you spend most of your time doing?

vocabulary.english_definition: A fully developed person from maturity onward
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 進んで成熟からの十分に発達した人。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I talked about how I learned Berber as an adult.

vocabulary.english_definition: A public promotion of some product or service
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: ある製品あるいはサービスの一般宣伝。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We should have paid attention to the advertisement.

vocabulary.english_definition: The relative magnitude of something with reference to a criterion
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 評価に関する何かの相対振幅。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I don't know how to pay you this amount of money.

vocabulary.english_definition: The date on which an event occurred in some previous year (or the celebration of it)
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: ある出来事が前年に起きた日付（またはその祝い）。
vocabulary.example_sentence: What did your boyfriend give you for your anniversary?

vocabulary.english_definition: The process whereby a person concentrates on some features of the environment to the (relative) exclusion of others
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: ある人が（相対的に）他を除外して身の回りのある特徴にだけに集中する過程。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I always needed some attention.

vocabulary.english_definition: A wide street or thoroughfare
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 広い通りあるいは表通り。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I live at the end of the avenue.

vocabulary.english_definition: A statistic describing the location of a distribution
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 分布の位置を表す統計値。
vocabulary.example_sentence: What is the value of an average home in your area?

vocabulary.english_definition: In a regular manner
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 規則的な方法で。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I regularly start to fall asleep while watching a movie.

vocabulary.english_definition: two times
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 回数が二回であること。量の二倍も表せる。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I practice the piano twice a week.

vocabulary.english_definition: At or in the front
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 前面のまたは前面で。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I can see so much light ahead of me.

vocabulary.english_definition: To a complete degree or to the full or entire extent ('whole' is often used informally for 'wholly')
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 完全な程度、一杯になるまで、または全範囲。
vocabulary.example_sentence: What you're telling me is completely different from what he said.

vocabulary.english_definition: In a gradual manner
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 段階的な方法で。
vocabulary.example_sentence: My father is gradually getting better.

vocabulary.english_definition: during the time that; in contrast with
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 「〜している間に」や「一方で」を表す接続詞。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I listened to music while I cleaned my room.

vocabulary.english_definition: despite the fact that
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 「〜だけれども」と対比を示す。後ろに主語と動詞を置く。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Although it was cold, we enjoyed our walk.

vocabulary.english_definition: from one side or end to the other
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 物や場所の中を通り抜けることを表す。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We walked through the park on our way home.

vocabulary.english_definition: in opposition to; touching and supported by
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 「〜に反対して」「〜に接して」などを表す前置詞。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Our team is playing against theirs on Saturday.

vocabulary.english_definition: in a lower position than something
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 基準となる物より低い位置や数値を表す。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Please write your name below the title.

vocabulary.english_definition: at the back of something
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 物や人の後ろ側にあることを表す。
vocabulary.example_sentence: My bike is behind the school building.

vocabulary.english_definition: during the whole of a period; in every part of a place
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: ある期間の最初から最後まで、または場所の全体にわたること。
vocabulary.example_sentence: The library is open throughout the summer vacation.

vocabulary.english_definition: different from someone or something
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 「〜と違って」と違いを示す前置詞。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Unlike my brother, I enjoy getting up early.

vocabulary.english_definition: Give advice to
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: アドバイスする。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Please advise me whether I should do that or not.

vocabulary.english_definition: Put into a proper or systematic order
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 適切な、または規則正しい順番に並べる。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I want you to arrange a meeting.

vocabulary.japanese_meaning: 所属する、〜のものである
vocabulary.english_definition: Be owned by; be in the possession of
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 所有されている。所有状態にある。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I hope to belong to just one man.
vocabulary.raw_japanese_extraction: 所属する、〜のものである
vocabulary.source_japanese_meaning: 所属する、〜のものである

vocabulary.english_definition: Behave as expected during of holidays or rites
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 休日または儀式で予想通りに振舞う。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I want to celebrate Christmas with you.

vocabulary.japanese_meaning: 応援する、歓声を上げる
vocabulary.english_definition: Give encouragement to
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 励ましを与える。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We tried to cheer him up by taking him out.
vocabulary.raw_japanese_extraction: 応援する、歓声を上げる
vocabulary.source_japanese_meaning: 応援する、歓声を上げる

vocabulary.english_definition: Determine the number or amount of
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 数か量を測定する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I know I can count on every one of you.

vocabulary.english_definition: Cause to be slowed down or delayed
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 減速させられる、または遅延させられる。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I don't think we should delay doing that any longer.

vocabulary.english_definition: Have as a part, be made up out of
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 部分としてある、の中から作られた。
vocabulary.example_sentence: For some reason, they didn't include my name on the list.

vocabulary.english_definition: Give temporarily; let have for a limited time
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 一時的に与える。一定時間持たせる。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I will lend you what little money I have now.

vocabulary.english_definition: to put things into a bag or box for travel or storage
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 旅行や移動に備えて荷物をかばんなどに詰めること。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I need to pack my bag for tomorrow's trip.

vocabulary.english_definition: Cultivate by growing, often involving improvements by means of agricultural techniques
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 育成して栽培する、しばしは農業技術の方法の改良を含む。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We don't produce anything any more.

vocabulary.english_definition: Reach a destination, either real or abstract
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 目的地に着く、実際のまたは抽象のいずれかの。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I want to reach the hotel before it gets dark.

vocabulary.english_definition: Regain a former condition after a financial loss
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 財務上の損失の後で前の状態を取り戻す。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I cannot say for certain that the patient will recover.

vocabulary.english_definition: A person who exercises control over workers
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 労働者の管理をする人。
vocabulary.example_sentence: My boss would not let me leave work early.

vocabulary.english_definition: Artifact made by weaving or felting or knitting or crocheting natural or synthetic fibers
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 天然繊維あるいは合成繊維を織ること、フェルトにすること、編むこと、または鉤針編みすることによって作られる人工物。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We took our clothes off and played in the street.

vocabulary.english_definition: A place off to the side of an area
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: ある領域の外れの場所。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Our favorite place to eat is that small restaurant on the corner.

vocabulary.english_definition: The attire worn in a play or at a fancy dress ball
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 劇や仮装舞踏会で身につける服装。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I know I look like a gift box in this costume.

vocabulary.english_definition: Rural regions
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 田舎の地域。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I want to go for a walk in the countryside.

vocabulary.english_definition: Accepted or habitual practice
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 受け入れられることまたは慣習。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I looked up where this custom comes from.

vocabulary.english_definition: Someone who pays for goods or services
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 商品やサービスにお金を払う人。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I hope that we don't lose you as a customer.

vocabulary.english_definition: A position on a scale of intensity or amount or quality
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 強さまたは量または品質の階級の位置。
vocabulary.example_sentence: What would you like to do after you've got your degree?

vocabulary.english_definition: A person qualified to practice dentistry
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 歯科医を開業する資格を持つ人。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I have to go to the dentist after school today.

vocabulary.english_definition: A state of extreme (usually irremediable) ruin and misfortune
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 極度の（通常取り返しのつかない）崩壊と不運な状態。
vocabulary.example_sentence: What a disaster, my son has gone and never came back!

vocabulary.english_definition: A retail shop where medicine and other articles are sold
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 薬品やその他の商品が売られている小売り店。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I have a part-time job at a drugstore.

vocabulary.english_definition: Shaking and vibration at the surface of the earth resulting from underground movement along a fault plane of from volcanic activity
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 火山活動により断層面に沿った地下運動によって、地球の表面が揺れて震動すること。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I was playing a game when I felt an earthquake.

vocabulary.english_definition: Earnest and conscientious activity intended to do or accomplish something
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 何かをしよう、または達成しようとするまじめで良心的な行動。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Do you think reading this book is worth the effort?

vocabulary.english_definition: On the inside
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 内から。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Our school is within ten minutes' walk of my house.

vocabulary.english_definition: Very good;of the highest quality
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 非常によい。最高品質の。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I consider him to be an excellent teacher.

vocabulary.english_definition: Being in accord with established forms and conventions and requirements (as e.g. of formal dress)
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 公認様式、慣例、及び必要条件調和すること（礼服の例のように）。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You don't have to be so formal.

vocabulary.english_definition: Having or indicating good health in body or mind; free from infirmity or disease
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 体または心の健康を持つか、示すさま。虚弱または病気から解放されている。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We have to make sure that we stay healthy.
