vocabulary.english_definition: Any living or extinct member of the family Hominidae characterized by superior intelligence, articulate speech, and erect carriage
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 優れた知性、明晰に聞き取れる言葉と垂直の歩行で特徴づけられるヒト科の生きているか絶滅した一部のいずれか。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I want you to live more like a human being.

vocabulary.english_definition: Belonging to the modern era; since the Middle Ages
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 現代の時代に属するさま。中世以来。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I didn't think you were interested in modern art.

vocabulary.english_definition: Having few parts; not complex or complicated or involved
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: ほとんど部品を持たないさま。複雑でない、面倒でない、あるいは入り組んでいない。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We came up with a very simple solution to the problem.

vocabulary.english_definition: Of relatively small extent from one surface to the opposite or in cross section
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: ひとつの面から反対の面間でまたは断面において比較的小さな程度の。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I used to be thin when I was young.

vocabulary.english_definition: Consisting of or derived from tradition
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 伝統から成る、または、伝統に由来する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I live in a traditional Kabyle house.

vocabulary.english_definition: Occurring or encountered or experienced or observed frequently or in accordance with regular practice or procedure
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 通常の習慣または手順に従って起こる、遭遇する、経験する、あるいはしばしば観察されるさま。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I arrived late because I didn't get up at my usual time.

vocabulary.english_definition: In or near a center or constituting a center; the inner area
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 中心の中またはそれに近い、または中心をなす。内面積。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Can you point me in the direction of the central station?

vocabulary.english_definition: Having or marked by confidence or assurance
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 信頼または保証持つことあるいは、に特徴付けられる。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I started to feel more confident in my Berber.

vocabulary.english_definition: Direct in spatial dimensions; proceeding without deviation or interruption; straight and short
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 空間次元に向かっている。逸脱または中断なしで進行すること。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Can you direct me to the train station?

vocabulary.english_definition: Be left; of persons, questions, problems, results, evidence, etc.
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 残されている。人、質問、問題、結果、証拠、その他の。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I didn't tell you earlier only because the matter had to remain secret.

vocabulary.english_definition: Obtain or arrange (for oneself) in advance
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 前もって得る、または準備する（自分で）。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We would like to reserve a table for 6 o'clock.

vocabulary.english_definition: Help to some food; help with food or drink
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 食物を手にとる。食べモノと飲物をとる。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I used to serve food at the soup kitchen around the corner.

vocabulary.english_definition: Spread across or over
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 横切って、あるいはその上に広がる。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We need to spread the word.

vocabulary.english_definition: Be standing; be upright
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 立っている。直立する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We promised to stand by him in case of trouble.

vocabulary.english_definition: Turn in as payment or part payment for a purchase
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 購入のための支払いか部分支払いとして、交換する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I have something to trade.

vocabulary.english_definition: Transport commercially
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 営利目的で輸送する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: What means of transport did you use to get here?

vocabulary.english_definition: Disturb the balance or stability of
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: バランスまたは安定性を妨げる。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I hope I didn't do anything to upset you.

vocabulary.english_definition: Consider or hold as true
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 真実として考えるまたはとらえる。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I didn't want his help, but I had to accept it.

vocabulary.english_definition: Propose or intend
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 提案または意図する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I aim to be a doctor when I grow up.

vocabulary.english_definition: Get or gather together
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 集合する、または集まる。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I got up and went to the window to collect my ideas.

vocabulary.english_definition: Exercise authoritative control or power over
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 権威ある支配、または力を行使する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You shouldn't allow your boyfriend to control your life.

vocabulary.english_definition: Bring to a destination, make a delivery
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 目的地に持ってくる、引き渡す。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We will deliver up to the airport of the island.

vocabulary.english_definition: An activity that is diverting and that holds the attention
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 楽しくさせる活動。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I want to work in the entertainment industry as well.

vocabulary.english_definition: A feeling of favorable regard
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 好意を示す感情。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I gave him a present in return for his favor.

vocabulary.english_definition: A fixed charge for a privilege or for professional services
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 専門的な業務について請求される固定料金。
vocabulary.example_sentence: What kind of food do your feed your children?

vocabulary.english_definition: The successful completion of a program of study
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 学習課程を首尾よく修了すること。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I know it's my graduation.

vocabulary.english_definition: A parent of your father or mother
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 父あるいは母の親。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I live with my mother, brother and my grandparents.

vocabulary.english_definition: a stay in a local family's home, often while studying abroad
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 留学などで現地の家庭に滞在すること。
vocabulary.example_sentence: My homestay family helped me practice English every day.

vocabulary.english_definition: The organized action of making of goods and services for sale
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 販売用の商品やサービスを製造、提供する組織的な活動。
vocabulary.example_sentence: What do you like the most and least about working in this industry?

vocabulary.english_definition: An unknown and unpredictable phenomenon that leads to a favorable outcome
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 好ましい結果に導く、未知で予測できない現象。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I just want to say good luck.

vocabulary.english_definition: The tangible substance that goes into the makeup of a physical object
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 物の構成に費やされる、触れることのできる物質。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I want a suit made of this material.

vocabulary.english_definition: The head of a city government
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 市行政の長。
vocabulary.example_sentence: My uncle is the mayor of our city.

vocabulary.english_definition: An intermediate part or section
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: ある区分けの中間の部分。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Our car broke down in the middle of the street.

vocabulary.english_definition: a very small model or copy of something
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 実物よりずっと小さく作られた模型や複製。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We saw a miniature of the castle at the museum.

vocabulary.english_definition: A particular point in time
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 特定の時点。
vocabulary.example_sentence: What time is it at the moment in your country?

vocabulary.english_definition: twice as much or as many
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 量や数が二倍であること。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We need double the usual amount of food today.

vocabulary.english_definition: Affording satisfaction or pleasure
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 満足または喜びを与えるさま。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I wanted my life to be more enjoyable.

vocabulary.english_definition: Extraordinarily good or great ; used especially as intensifiers
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 非常に良い、または大きい。特に強意語として使用される。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I had a fantastic time at your party.

vocabulary.english_definition: Of concern to or concerning the affairs of other nations (other than your own)
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 他の国（自分の国以外で）の事柄に関するまたはそれの関心事。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I can't speak my own language very well, let alone foreign ones.

vocabulary.english_definition: Thrown into a state of intense fear or desperation
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 激しい恐れまたは自暴自棄の状態に陥る。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I am not such a person as to be frightened.

vocabulary.english_definition: Having or showing a kindly or tender nature
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 親切であるか、あるいは生まれながらの優しさを、持つかまたは見せる。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I miss Layla's gentle touch.

vocabulary.english_definition: Involving the entire earth; not limited or provincial in scope
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 地球全体を含むさま。制限のない、偏狭でない領域。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We are all part of the global economy.

vocabulary.english_definition: Causing or capable of causing harm
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 害を起こすことのできるまたは起こす。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Too much of anything is harmful.

vocabulary.english_definition: Unusually great in size or amount or degree or especially extent or scope
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 通常、サイズ、量、度数、特に程度または範囲において大きな。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We could be making a huge mistake here.

vocabulary.english_definition: Conforming to an ultimate standard of perfection or excellence; embodying an ideal
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 完璧さ、あるいは優秀さの最終的な標準に従うさま。理想を具体化する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We noticed that it was not really ideal for us.

vocabulary.english_definition: Characteristic of a man
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 男性の特性。
vocabulary.example_sentence: What would you say to sound like a male?

vocabulary.english_definition: Being or productive of something fresh and unusual; or being as first made or thought of
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 新しくて変わった何か、あるいは新しくて変わった何か生産的な。最初に作られたあるいは考えられたように。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I should've read the original work before watching the movie.

vocabulary.english_definition: Located, suited for, or taking place in the open air
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 戸外に位置し、適していて、起きる。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Do you prefer a desk job or outdoor job?

vocabulary.english_definition: Grow, progress, unfold, or evolve through a process of evolution, natural growth, differentiation, or a conducive environment
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 進化、自然の成長、分化、あるいは伝導性のある環境の過程を通じて、成長し、進歩し、展開し、または発展する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We want to develop and make progress.

vocabulary.english_definition: Get lost, as without warning or explanation
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 道に迷う、警告あるいは説明なしで。
vocabulary.example_sentence: My money seems to disappear by the end of the month.

vocabulary.english_definition: Fail to meet the hopes or expectations of
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 希望または期待に添うことができない。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I hope you're not going to disappoint me.

vocabulary.english_definition: Have or feel a dislike or distaste for
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 反感、または嫌悪を持つか、感じる。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I just came here to dislike.

vocabulary.english_definition: Make plain and comprehensible
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 平易で理解可能にする。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I found it impossible to explain what he is really like.

vocabulary.english_definition: Be engaged in a fight; carry on a fight
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 戦いに従事している。戦いを続ける。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You have to fight against this other woman.

vocabulary.english_definition: Make a film or photograph of something
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 何かの映画または写真を製作する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I wasn't the only one who didn't like that film.

vocabulary.english_definition: Collect in one place
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 1つの場所に集まる。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We need to gather everyone together.

vocabulary.english_definition: Cause to be hanging or suspended
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: つり下げる、またはぶら下げる。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I wonder where to hang the picture he gave me.

vocabulary.english_definition: Prevent from being seen or discovered
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 見られる、または発見されるのを防ぐ。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We need to find a place to hide this money.

vocabulary.english_definition: Cause to move by striking
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 打つことで動くようにする。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I tried to hit the ball, but I couldn't.

vocabulary.english_definition: Form a mental image of something that is not present or that is not the case
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 存在しない、あるいは、事実と異なる心像を形成する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I can imagine why you don't want to talk to her.

vocabulary.english_definition: Come up with (an idea, plan, explanation, theory, or principle) after a mental effort
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 思考錯誤の後で思いつく（考え、計画、説明理論または主義）。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We should invent a secret language.

vocabulary.english_definition: An interconnected system of things or people
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 物または人々が相互に関連し合う仕組み。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I hear that the network is very popular now.

vocabulary.english_definition: A group of people who work together
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: ともに働く人々のグループ。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Our organization is a large one.

vocabulary.english_definition: As much as necessary
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 必要なだけ。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I had plenty of time to talk to many friends.

vocabulary.english_definition: Undesirable state of the natural environment being contaminated with harmful substances as a consequence of human activities
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 人間の活動の結果として有害物質で汚染されている自然な環境の不適当な状態。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I don't go out when there's that much air pollution.

vocabulary.english_definition: The person who holds the office of head of state of the United States government
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 米国政府の国家元首の在職者。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I spoke with the president this morning.

vocabulary.english_definition: a planned piece of work with a particular purpose
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 目的を達成するために計画して進める仕事や課題。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Our class is working on a project about recycling.

vocabulary.english_definition: An essential and distinguishing attribute of something or someone
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 人や物の本質的で特徴的な属性。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We know by the flowers the quality of the fruit.

vocabulary.english_definition: Freedom from activity (work or strain or responsibility)
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: （仕事や緊張、責任など）行動からの解放。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You worked a lot, you need to take a rest.

vocabulary.english_definition: A principle or condition that customarily governs behavior
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 慣習的に行動を支配する原則あるいは条件。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I make it a rule to take a walk before breakfast.

vocabulary.english_definition: The unlimited expanse in which everything is located
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: すべての物が位置づけられる無限の広がり。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We need to make good use of this space.

vocabulary.english_definition: Someone who travels for pleasure
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 娯楽のために旅をする人。
vocabulary.example_sentence: How does it feel to live in a tourist town?

vocabulary.english_definition: A facility consisting of the means and equipment necessary for the movement of passengers or goods
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 乗客または荷物の移動に必要な手段と設備で成る施設。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We have no means of transportation.

vocabulary.english_definition: A meeting arranged in advance
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 前もって準備された面会。
vocabulary.example_sentence: How long did the appointment with the doctor last?

vocabulary.english_definition: Unique or specific to a person or thing or category
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 人、物またはカテゴリーに特有または限られた。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I don't think Tom is the right person for this particular job.

vocabulary.english_definition: Being complete of its kind and without defect or blemish
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: その種で完全な、または欠陥または傷のない。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You don't fall in love with somebody because he's perfect.

vocabulary.english_definition: Not elaborate or elaborated; simple
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 念入りに仕上げていない、または仕上げられていないさま。簡素なさま。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We are used to eating plain food.

vocabulary.english_definition: In accord with regular practice or procedure
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 通常の実践または過程に見合って。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I don't have a regular job.

vocabulary.english_definition: previously owned or used by someone else
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: ほかの人が以前に使っていた中古の物を表す。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I bought a secondhand bicycle from a friend.

vocabulary.english_definition: Of great consequence
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 非常に重大な。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You mean to say that doing that isn't a serious matter?

vocabulary.english_definition: Ludicrous, foolish
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 滑稽な、愚かな。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I drank some silly tea and now I'm silly.

vocabulary.english_definition: Used of flowers having usually only one row or whorl of petals
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 通常1列または1巻きの花弁しかない花に使用される。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I think married people have more problems than single people.

vocabulary.english_definition: Showing mental alertness and calculation and resourcefulness
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 精神的な機敏さと計算と臨機応変さを示すさま。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I thought that you were smart enough to know better.

vocabulary.english_definition: extra and available if needed
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 必要になったときに使える予備の物や空き時間。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Do you have a spare pen I could borrow?

vocabulary.english_definition: Having four equal sides and four right angles or forming a right angle
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 4つ等しい側と4つの直角または直角を形成している。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We need a square table, not a round one.

vocabulary.english_definition: Meant or adapted for an occasion or use
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 出来事または使用が意味される、または構成される。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Can you find suitable time for our meeting?

vocabulary.english_definition: Very small
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 非常に小さい。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We are on a small planet with little countries with tiny people.

vocabulary.english_definition: Restrict or confine, "I limit you to two visits to the pub a day"
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 制限、または限定する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I don't see why age should limit you.

vocabulary.english_definition: Reduce or cause to be reduced from a solid to a liquid state, usually by heating
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 通常熱することにより固体から液体の状態へ減少する、あるいは減少される原因となる。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I think that the snow will melt soon.

vocabulary.english_definition: Notice or perceive
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 気づく、または知覚する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I think she wants you to notice her.

vocabulary.english_definition: to arrange things or plan an event
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 物事を整理したり、行事を準備したりすること。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We need to organize the school festival together.

vocabulary.english_definition: to make a picture or cover a surface using paint
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 絵の具で絵を描くことや、塗料を塗ること。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We are going to paint the classroom walls blue.

vocabulary.english_definition: Make a promise or commitment
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 約束する、または、誓約する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Please promise me that you'll never lie to me again.

vocabulary.english_definition: Prepare and issue for public distribution or sale
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 一般への配布または販売に備える、発行する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I haven't had the time these days to publish it.

vocabulary.english_definition: Turn away from; give up
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 拒否する。やめる。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I made up my mind to quit smoking from now on.

vocabulary.english_definition: Detect with the senses
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 感覚で検出する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I wonder if she will recognize me after all those years.

vocabulary.english_definition: Have confidence or faith in
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 信用、または信頼する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I don't think we should rely on Tom too much.

vocabulary.english_definition: Free from harm or evil
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 危害または不正から開放する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I hope someone comes to rescue us.

vocabulary.english_definition: Traverse or travel on (a body of water)
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: （水域の上を）渡るまたは行く。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Do you know how to sail a boat?

vocabulary.english_definition: Shape or influence; give direction to
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 形または影響。指示を与える。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You have the power to shape the universe.

vocabulary.english_definition: A theatrical representation of a story that is performed to music by trained dancers
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 訓練されたダンサーによって音楽に合わせて演じられた演劇上演。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We tried out for the ballet team.

vocabulary.english_definition: A seat of government
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 政府の所在地。
vocabulary.example_sentence: What is the capital of her country?

vocabulary.english_definition: A formal event performed on a special occasion
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 特別な機会にとり行われる公式行事。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I don't want to take part in the ceremony.

vocabulary.english_definition: A professional cook
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: プロのコック。
vocabulary.example_sentence: How many years did you work as a chef?

vocabulary.english_definition: The weather in some location averaged over some long period of time
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: ある長い期間にわたってある場所で平均化された天気。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You can easily get sick in a climate like this.

vocabulary.english_definition: The shore of a sea or ocean
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 海や大洋の岸。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We went to the coast for our summer vacation.

vocabulary.english_definition: A commercially sponsored ad on radio or television
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: ラジオあるいはテレビでの商業的なスポンサーがついた広告。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I went to a commercial high school.

vocabulary.english_definition: An accounting entry acknowledging income or capital items
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 収入または主要な項目を認めている会計項目。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I don't have a credit card or a bank account.

vocabulary.english_definition: Something used to beautify
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 美しくするために用いられるもの。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I don't really give a damn about the decoration of our wedding.

vocabulary.english_definition: A college or university building containing living quarters for students
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 学生用の居住棟を含む、単科大学または大学の建物。
vocabulary.example_sentence: My university has a dormitory.

vocabulary.english_definition: A collection of things (goods or works of art etc.) for public display
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 公共に披露するための物（商品や芸術作品など）のコレクション。
vocabulary.example_sentence: How did you come up with the idea for this exhibition?

vocabulary.english_definition: The act of conducting a controlled test or investigation
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 管理された試験または調査を行う行為。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You can't be too careful when doing this experiment.

vocabulary.english_definition: A plant consisting of one or more buildings with facilities for manufacturing
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 製造のための施設のある1つかそれ以上の建物で成る工場。
vocabulary.example_sentence: My father and my older brother work in this factory.

vocabulary.english_definition: Very difficult; severely testing stamina or resolution
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 非常に難しい。非常に厳しい気力と決意。
vocabulary.example_sentence: What kind of things are tough in your job?

vocabulary.english_definition: Including all components without exception; being one unit or constituting the full amount or extent or duration; complete
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 例外なくすべての構成要素を含むさま。1つ全体または全ての量、程度または持続時間をなす。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I spent the whole weekend at home on the computer.

vocabulary.english_definition: not present where someone is expected to be
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: いるはずの場所にいないこと。学校では欠席を表す。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Two students were absent from class yesterday.

vocabulary.english_definition: Having the same or similar characteristics
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 同じものまたは類似した特徴を持つ。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We do look alike, but it's still not me.

vocabulary.english_definition: Characterized by or caused by allergy
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: アレルギーによって特徴付けられるか引き起こされる。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You aren't allergic to anything, are you?

vocabulary.english_definition: Obtainable or accessible and ready for use or service
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 入手または利用可能で、使用またはサービスの準備が整っている。
vocabulary.example_sentence: How much power do we have available?

vocabulary.english_definition: Exceptionally bad or displeasing
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 非常に悪いか、または不快である。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I never realized how awful living all alone could be.

vocabulary.english_definition: Pertaining to or constituting a base or basis
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 基礎または基盤に関連する、あるいは基礎または基盤となる。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I make use of Basic English.

vocabulary.english_definition: Pleasing or delighting
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 喜ばせるようなまたは好ましい。
vocabulary.example_sentence: What a charming little girl!

vocabulary.english_definition: Being full of or promoting cheer; having or showing good spirits
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 声援でいっぱいのまたは声援をすすめる。良い気分を持つまたは示す。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I had a cheerful morning because I could hear the songs of birds.

vocabulary.english_definition: A United States term for Blacks that is now considered offensive
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 現在では差別語とされる、米国で黒人を指す語。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I prefer black- and red-colored clothes.

vocabulary.english_definition: Unvarying in nature
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 本質的に不変の。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I got sick of the constant noise of the street traffic.

vocabulary.english_definition: no longer alive
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 生きていない状態を表す形容詞。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We removed the dead leaves from the garden.

vocabulary.english_definition: The relative prominence of a syllable or musical note (especially with regard to stress or pitch)
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 音節または音符の（特に強勢または音の高低に関する）相対的卓立。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I keep a stress ball on my desk.

vocabulary.english_definition: Be the physical support of; carry the weight of
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: の人的支援である。の重さを支える。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I don't need you to support me.

vocabulary.english_definition: Ride the waves of the sea with a surfboard
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: サーフボードで海の波に乗る。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I don't know how to surf very well.

vocabulary.english_definition: Cause to be surprised
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 驚くべき原因。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You really surprised me with that gift, thank you.

vocabulary.english_definition: Extend on all sides of simultaneously; encircle
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 同時に四方に広げる。取り囲む。
vocabulary.example_sentence: The children were sitting so as to surround the fire.

vocabulary.english_definition: Notify of danger, potential harm, or risk
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 危険、潜在的害または危険を通知する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I came here to warn you about what might happen.

vocabulary.japanese_meaning: 重さを量る、〜の重さがある
vocabulary.english_definition: Have a certain weight
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 一定の重さを持つ。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I have decided to weigh myself every day starting today.
vocabulary.raw_japanese_extraction: 重さを量る、〜の重さがある
vocabulary.source_japanese_meaning: 重さを量る、〜の重さがある

vocabulary.english_definition: Speak softly; in a low voice
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: そっと言う。小さな声で。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I will love you until I let my last whisper out.

vocabulary.japanese_meaning: 利用する、アクセスする
vocabulary.english_definition: Reach or gain access to
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: アクセスに達する、またはアクセスする。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I think art should be free for everyone to access.
vocabulary.raw_japanese_extraction: 利用する、アクセスする
vocabulary.source_japanese_meaning: 利用する、アクセスする

vocabulary.english_definition: To gain with effort
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 努力で得る。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I don't understand what you want to achieve with that.

vocabulary.english_definition: Attack someone physically or emotionally
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 物理的または感情的にだれかを攻撃する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We didn't intend to attack him.

vocabulary.english_definition: Be present at (meetings, church services, university), etc.
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: （ミーティング、礼拝、大学）等に出席する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I got up early in order to attend the meeting.

vocabulary.english_definition: Bring into balance or equilibrium
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: バランスまたは平衡をもたらす。
vocabulary.example_sentence: How do you balance work and travel while on the road?

vocabulary.english_definition: The condition of being free; the power to act or speak or think without externally imposed restraints
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 自由である状態。外部から抑制を課されない状態で行動する、話す、あるいは考える力。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I enjoy having the freedom to think for myself.

vocabulary.english_definition: The vertical dimension of extension; distance from the base of something to the top
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 長さの垂直の寸法。何かの底から一番上までの距離。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Could you please tell me your height and weight?

vocabulary.english_definition: A man distinguished by exceptional courage and nobility and strength
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 一際優れた勇気、高潔さ、強さで秀でた男性。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I don't want to be a hero.

vocabulary.english_definition: A visual representation (of an object or scene or person or abstraction) produced on a surface
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 表面に作成された視覚表現（物、場面、人または抽象概念の）。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Could you explain to me what this image means?

vocabulary.english_definition: Small air-breathing arthropod
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 小型の空気呼吸を行う節足動物。
vocabulary.example_sentence: What do you call this insect in English?

vocabulary.english_definition: Undertake a journey or trip
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 旅または旅行を経験する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You will certainly be tired, after such a long journey.

vocabulary.english_definition: The psychological result of perception and learning and reasoning
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 知覚、学習、論理的思考の心理的な結果。
vocabulary.example_sentence: My knowledge about Japanese is not that good yet.

vocabulary.english_definition: A position on a scale of intensity or amount or quality
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 強さまたは量または品質の階級の位置。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I don't know why people say this level is hard.

vocabulary.english_definition: (medicine) something that treats or prevents or alleviates the symptoms of disease
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 病気の症状を治療する、予防する、または緩和する物。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I don't feel well. Could you give me some medicine?

vocabulary.english_definition: Something that is remembered
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 覚えていること。
vocabulary.example_sentence: My memory failed me. I just couldn't remember his name.

vocabulary.english_definition: Sound of any kind (especially unintelligible or dissonant sound)
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: あらゆる種類の音（特に曖昧な音や不協和音）。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I heard a noise coming from the next room.

vocabulary.english_definition: Generic name for certain synthetic or semisynthetic materials that can be molded or extruded into objects or films or filaments or used for making e.g. coatings and adhesives
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 一定の形の物や皮膜や単繊維に成形したり、例えば被覆剤や接着剤を作るのに使われる合成または半合成物質の総称。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Do you want a plastic or paper bag?

vocabulary.english_definition: The force of policemen and officers
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 警察官と警官の力。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We finally decided to give him over to the police.

vocabulary.english_definition: Exquisitely fine and subtle and pleasing; susceptible to injury
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: この上なくすばらしくて、ほのかで、気持ちよい。けがをしやすい。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Please don't eat or drink near the computer, it's delicate.

vocabulary.english_definition: Greatly pleased
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 大喜びで。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I am delighted that it's all come to an end.

vocabulary.english_definition: needing someone or something for support
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 人や物の支えを必要とすること。dependent on で「〜に頼っている」。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Young children are dependent on adults for many things.

vocabulary.english_definition: Suitable to or characteristic of drama
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 劇に適した、または劇に特有の。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I think you're being a bit over-dramatic.

vocabulary.english_definition: Of or relating to electronics; concerned with or using devices that operate on principles governing the behavior of electrons
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 電子工学に関する、またはそれの。電子の活動を支配する理論に基づいて動く装置に関してまたはそれを使用する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I listen to a lot of electronic music.

vocabulary.english_definition: having a large amount of body fat
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 体の脂肪が多いこと。人への直接の呼びかけでは失礼になりやすい。
vocabulary.example_sentence: The vet said our cat was getting too fat.

vocabulary.english_definition: Characteristic of or peculiar to a woman
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 女性に特徴的な、または、女性に特有である。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I have a female dog and a female cat.

vocabulary.english_definition: Having a surface without slope, tilt in which no part is higher or lower than another
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 斜面のない表面を持つこと、一部分がもう一つより高くないまたは低くない傾斜。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I wouldn't want to live in a top-floor flat.

vocabulary.english_definition: Recently made, produced, or harvested
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 最近作られた、生産された、または収穫された。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I bought some fresh bread on the way home.

vocabulary.english_definition: Causing fear or dread or terror
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 恐れまたは不安または恐怖を引き起こすさま。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I find the idea of dying frightening.

vocabulary.english_definition: for the usual number of working or studying hours
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 通常の勤務時間や授業時間のすべてにわたること。
vocabulary.example_sentence: She is looking for a full-time job near home.

vocabulary.english_definition: Pleasing in appearance especially by reason of conformity to ideals of form and proportion
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 形体と比率の理想への調和による見かけ上の心地よさ。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I have never seen a man as handsome as him!

vocabulary.english_definition: Providing assistance or serving a useful function
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 援助を提供する、または、役に立つ機能を供給する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You can be pretty helpful when you want to be.

vocabulary.english_definition: Hinder or prevent the progress or accomplishment of
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 進歩か達成を妨げるか、または防ぐ。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I don't know how they were supposed to block that.

vocabulary.english_definition: Exhale hard
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 強く息を吐き出す。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I am waiting for the storm to blow over.

vocabulary.english_definition: Examine and note the similarities or differences of
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 類似点または相違点を検討し留意する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I don't think you should compare yourself to others.

vocabulary.japanese_meaning: デートする、日付を付ける
vocabulary.english_definition: Go on a date with
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: デートする。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I was dating a girl in high school who spoke Berber.
vocabulary.raw_japanese_extraction: デートする、日付を付ける
vocabulary.source_japanese_meaning: デートする、日付を付ける

vocabulary.english_definition: Make more attractive by adding ornament, colour, etc.
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 飾り、色などを追加することによってより魅力的にする。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Can you help us to decorate the party room?

vocabulary.english_definition: Make smaller
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 小さくする。
vocabulary.example_sentence: What should you do to decrease your debt?

vocabulary.english_definition: Do away with, cause the destruction or undoing of
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 処分する、破壊あるいは破滅を引き起こす。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Do you think that you need to destroy my things?

vocabulary.english_definition: Create by digging
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 地面を取り除くことによって作り出す。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We had to dig a pretty deep well to get water.

vocabulary.english_definition: Discover or determine the existence, presence, or fact of
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 生存、存在または、の事実を発見するまたは断定する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We had to discover that the hard way.

vocabulary.english_definition: To consider or examine in speech or writing
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: スピーチまたは文章で熟慮するまたは調査する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We used to discuss everything and now we can't talk about anything.

vocabulary.english_definition: to make a picture using a pencil or pen
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 鉛筆やペンなどで絵や図を描くこと。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Can you draw a map of your neighborhood?

vocabulary.english_definition: Earn on some commercial or business transaction; earn as salary or wages
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 商業またはビジネス取引で稼ぐ。給与または賃金で稼ぐ。
vocabulary.example_sentence: How much money do you expect to earn next year?

vocabulary.english_definition: Show an attribute, property, knowledge, or skill
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 属性、特性、知識、または技能を示す。
vocabulary.example_sentence: What is your favorite exhibit at the museum?

vocabulary.english_definition: The educator who has executive authority for a school
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 学校を管理する権限を持つ教育者。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I got sent to the principal’s office today.

vocabulary.english_definition: The ability to see; the visual faculty
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 見る能力。視覚の機能。
vocabulary.example_sentence: My sight isn't as good as it used to be.

vocabulary.english_definition: An event that accomplishes its intended purpose
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 意図されていた目的を達成するでき事。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I have no doubt that the event will be a success.

vocabulary.english_definition: The degree of hotness or coldness of a body or environment (corresponding to its molecular activity)
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: （分子活動に対応した）物体や環境の熱さや冷たさの度合い。
vocabulary.example_sentence: My mother called the doctor because I had a temperature.

vocabulary.english_definition: A sporting competition in which contestants play a series of games to decide the winner
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 競技者が勝者を決定するため一連の試合を行うスポーツ競争。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Our goal is to win the tournament this year.

vocabulary.english_definition: Noticeable heterogeneity
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 目立つ異種性。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You can catch a variety of fish while fishing.

vocabulary.english_definition: The quality of being able to perform; a quality that permits or facilitates achievement or accomplishment
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: やり遂げることができるという特質。達成または完成を可能にする、または助ける性質。
vocabulary.example_sentence: My boss has the ability to read books very fast.

vocabulary.english_definition: The statement (oral or written) of an exchange of promises
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 約束の交換の声明（口頭または書面の）。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I thought that we had an agreement.

vocabulary.english_definition: A person trained to compete in sports
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: スポーツ競技を行う訓練を受けた人。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You have the body of an athlete.

vocabulary.english_definition: Writes (books or stories or articles or the like) professionally (for pay)
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 職業的（報酬のため）に（本、物語、記事、または、そのようなものを）書く。
vocabulary.example_sentence: What was the author thinking while he was writing this book?

vocabulary.english_definition: The grounds in back of a house
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 家の裏手にある庭。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You should find a house with a backyard.

vocabulary.english_definition: (microbiology) single-celled or noncellular spherical or spiral or rod-shaped organisms lacking chlorophyll that reproduce by fission; important as pathogens and for biochemical properties; taxonomy is difficult; often considered to be plants
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 核分裂により生産される葉緑素のない単細胞、非細胞球形、渦巻き状の、あるいは棒状の有機体。病原菌として、および生化学の特性のために重要である。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You must make the bacteria inside you happy.

vocabulary.english_definition: The qualities that give pleasure to the senses
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 感覚に喜びを与える特性。
vocabulary.example_sentence: What does the beauty of a woman mean to you?

vocabulary.japanese_meaning: 歴史に関する、歴史上の
vocabulary.english_definition: Of or relating to the study of history
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 歴史の研究の、または、歴史の研究に関する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I wish Adriano could visit this historical place.
vocabulary.raw_japanese_extraction: 歴史に関する、歴史上の
vocabulary.source_japanese_meaning: 歴史に関する、歴史上の

vocabulary.english_definition: Used to indicate that a statement explains or supports a previous statement
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: ある声明が前言を説明または支持することを示すのに使用される。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I don't like it, but I will do it anyway.

vocabulary.english_definition: For the environment
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 環境のために。
vocabulary.example_sentence: How environmentally friendly are electric cars?

vocabulary.english_definition: To a distinctly greater extent or degree than is common
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 通常よりも目立って大きな程度にまたは範囲に。
vocabulary.example_sentence: My wife makes me happy, especially when she isn't home.

vocabulary.english_definition: To a moderately sufficient extent or degree
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 適度に十分な範囲、または程度。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I could do that fairly well when I was younger.

vocabulary.english_definition: By chance
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 偶然に。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I thought perhaps no one else would agree with me.

vocabulary.english_definition: To a great degree
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 大いに。
vocabulary.example_sentence: What is the most widely read newspaper in your country?

vocabulary.english_definition: After an unspecified period of time or an especially long delay
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 不特定の期間か特に長い遅れの後に。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I think we're going to eventually have to do that.

vocabulary.english_definition: Indicating exactness or preciseness
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 正確さまたは精密度を示すこと。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You are doing exactly what they want you to do.

vocabulary.english_definition: To or at a greater extent or degree or a more advanced stage ('further' is used more often than 'farther' in this abstract sense)
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: より大きな程度までに、またはより進んだ段階までに。
vocabulary.example_sentence: How about we discuss this situation further tomorrow morning, if you like?

vocabulary.english_definition: Usually; as a rule
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: いつもは。通例。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I don't like tea, so I generally drink coffee for breakfast.

vocabulary.english_definition: To an extraordinary extent or degree
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 並外れた範囲、または程度。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I love you greatly, not just a bit.

vocabulary.english_definition: According to nature; by natural means; without artificial help
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 自然に従って。自然な方法で。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I don't know how, but I just picked it up naturally.

vocabulary.japanese_meaning: 満たす、いっぱいにする
vocabulary.english_definition: Make full, also in a metaphorical sense
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 比喩的な感覚においても、いっぱいにする。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I am going to fill you up so full.
vocabulary.raw_japanese_extraction: 満たす、いっぱいにする
vocabulary.source_japanese_meaning: 満たす、いっぱいにする

vocabulary.english_definition: Move or progress freely as if in a stream
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 流れにいるかのように自由に動き前進する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Our conversation seemed to flow easily.

vocabulary.english_definition: Stop blaming or grant forgiveness
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 非難することをやめるまたは許しを与える。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I doubt I'll ever be able to forgive him.

vocabulary.english_definition: Change to ice
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 氷への変化。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Please freeze the fish and meat.

vocabulary.english_definition: Engage or hire for work
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 仕事のために雇用するあるいは、借りる。
vocabulary.example_sentence: How many more people do we need to hire?

vocabulary.english_definition: Pursue for food or sport (as of wild animals)
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 食物またはスポーツのために追求する（野生動物のような）。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I can teach you how to hunt.

vocabulary.japanese_meaning: 感動させる、印象づける
vocabulary.english_definition: Have an emotional or cognitive impact upon
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 感情的であるか認識影響を及ぼす。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You don't have to try so hard to impress me.
vocabulary.raw_japanese_extraction: 感動させる、印象づける
vocabulary.source_japanese_meaning: 感動させる、印象づける

vocabulary.english_definition: Cause injuries or bodily harm to
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 怪我または身体傷害を引き起こす。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You have to be careful so as not to injure yourself.

vocabulary.english_definition: Judge tentatively or form an estimate of (quantities or time)
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: とりあえず判断するまたは、の予想を立てる（量または時間）。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I think that it's too soon to judge.

vocabulary.english_definition: Raise from a lower to a higher position
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 低い位置から高い位置に上げる。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I wasn't strong enough to lift the box by myself.

vocabulary.japanese_meaning: 位置を特定する、見つける
vocabulary.english_definition: Discover the location of; determine the place of; find by searching or examining
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 位置を見つける。位置を決定する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Can you locate this place on the map for me?
vocabulary.raw_japanese_extraction: 位置を特定する、見つける
vocabulary.source_japanese_meaning: 位置を特定する、見つける

vocabulary.english_definition: Determine the measurements of something or somebody, take measurements of
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 何かまたは誰かの測定値を測定する、を測定する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I will measure the weight of the horse.

vocabulary.english_definition: Commit to memory; learn by heart
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 記憶する。暗記する、空で覚える。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You should memorize as many English words as possible.

vocabulary.english_definition: Manner of acting or controlling yourself
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 自分らしく振る舞う、または自分を管理する方法。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I can't put up with his behavior any longer.

vocabulary.english_definition: Reproductive organ of angiosperm plants especially one having showy or colorful parts
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 被子植物の生殖器官で特に目立ったり、あるいはカラフルな部分を持つもの。
vocabulary.example_sentence: My tree had some blossom, but no fruit.

vocabulary.english_definition: By bad luck
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: あいにく。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I would like to be there, but unfortunately I cannot.

vocabulary.japanese_meaning: そうでなければ、別の点では
vocabulary.english_definition: if not; in a different way
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 「そうでなければ」や「それ以外の点では」を表す。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Let's leave now. Otherwise, we will miss the train.
vocabulary.raw_japanese_extraction: そうでなければ、別の点では
vocabulary.source_japanese_meaning: そうでなければ、別の点では

vocabulary.english_definition: An activity or gift that benefits the public at large
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 社会全般のためになる活動もしくは贈り物。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I got these shoes from a charity shop for £2.

vocabulary.english_definition: The activity of communicating; the activity of conveying information
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 伝達する活動。情報を伝達する活動。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I think we get some communication problems here.

vocabulary.english_definition: A prearranged meeting for consultation or exchange of information or discussion (especially one with a formal agenda)
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 相談や情報交換、討論のための事前に取り決められた会議（特に公式の議事日程を持つもの）。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I want everyone in the conference room tomorrow morning by 8:00.

vocabulary.english_definition: Not often
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: めったにない。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We often have to start again, but seldom from the beginning.

vocabulary.english_definition: An effort that is inconvenient
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 面倒な努力。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I had a lot of difficulty getting in touch with her.

vocabulary.english_definition: A line leading to a place or point
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: ある場所や点へ向かう線。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I looked in the direction of the window, but didn't see anything.

vocabulary.english_definition: The act of reducing the selling price of merchandise
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 商品の販売価格を下げる行為。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I don't think they actually get much of a discount.

vocabulary.english_definition: Separated or at a distance in place or position or time
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 場所、位置、または時間的に切り離された、または隔てられた。
vocabulary.example_sentence: My brother and I are less than two years apart.

vocabulary.english_definition: From appearances alone
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 外観だけから。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I thought Tom had paid Mary, but apparently I was wrong.

vocabulary.english_definition: at the present time, compared with the past
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 過去と比べて「最近は」「今日では」を表す。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Many people use their phones to read the news nowadays.

vocabulary.english_definition: In an original manner
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: もともとのやり方で。
vocabulary.example_sentence: How did the idea for this originally come up?

vocabulary.english_definition: Money in the form of bills or coins
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 紙幣や硬貨の形態をした貨幣。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I need to get money out from the cash machine.

vocabulary.english_definition: With rapid movements
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 急速な動きで。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I learn new ideas rapidly.

vocabulary.english_definition: A cultivated plant that is grown commercially on a large scale
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 大規模に営利目的で成育される栽培植物。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We are the cream of the crop!

vocabulary.english_definition: In or at or to some place
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: どこかに、で、またはに向かって。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I must have dropped it somewhere around here.

vocabulary.english_definition: A woodworker who makes or repairs wooden objects
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 木工品を作ったり修理したりする大工。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I have a Canadian friend who is a carpenter.

vocabulary.english_definition: To or in a foreign country
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 外国の、または外国で。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I had never been abroad before, so everything seemed strange to me.

vocabulary.english_definition: An impairment of health or a condition of abnormal functioning
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 健康障害もしくは、機能異常の状態。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I can't remember the name of the disease my father has.

vocabulary.english_definition: The activities of educating or instructing; activities that impart knowledge or skill
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 教育または指導の活動。知識を授ける活動。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I am surprised at the education of these children.

vocabulary.english_definition: In addition
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: さらに。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I don't want to go, and besides it's too late.

vocabulary.english_definition: On a floor below
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 下の階に。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I know the man who lives downstairs.

vocabulary.english_definition: To the same degree (often followed by 'as')
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 同じ程度に。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We tried to share the little there was as equally as possible.

vocabulary.english_definition: to leave a vehicle in a particular place
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 車を決めた場所に止めておくこと。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You can park your car behind the building.

vocabulary.english_definition: Cause to run
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 走らせる。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Please pour me a glass of water.

vocabulary.english_definition: Exert pressure or force to or upon
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 圧迫を加える、強制する、あるいは力を加える。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I don't want to press you.

vocabulary.english_definition: Keep from happening or arising; make impossible
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 起きてしまうことまたは発生することを防ぐ。不可能にする。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We have to prevent such an accident from happening again.

vocabulary.english_definition: Give something useful or necessary to
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 何かを役に立つまたは必要であるものにする。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I will provide you all the necessary information.

vocabulary.english_definition: Cause to move by pulling
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 引くことにより動きを引き起こす。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I think she was trying to pull a fast one.

vocabulary.english_definition: Move with force, "He pushed the table into a corner"
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 力による動き、。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Please push the table over this way.

vocabulary.japanese_meaning: 再利用する、再資源化する
vocabulary.english_definition: Use again after processing
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 処理の後で再度使用する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I wish more people would recycle.
vocabulary.raw_japanese_extraction: 再利用する、再資源化する
vocabulary.source_japanese_meaning: 再利用する、再資源化する

vocabulary.english_definition: Cut down on; make a reduction in
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: カットして減らす。減少させる。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I think that we should reduce the price.

vocabulary.english_definition: Remove something concrete, as by lifting, pushing, or taking off, or remove something abstract
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 何か具体的なものを削除する、持ち上げる、押すこと、あるいは切り離すことなどにより、あるいは何か抽象的なものを削除する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I had to remove some of the things I had.

vocabulary.english_definition: To say, state, or perform again
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: かさねて言う、述べる、または行う。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Could you please repeat it once again?

vocabulary.english_definition: Substitute a person or thing for (another that is broken or inefficient or lost or no longer working or yielding what is expected)
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: の代わりに人またはものを代用する（壊れている、能率が悪い、紛失した、これ以上動かないあるいは期待されていることを産出できない別のもの）。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We won't be able to replace it.

vocabulary.english_definition: Have need of
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 必要性を有する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We know doing that will require a lot of money.

vocabulary.english_definition: A phenomenon that follows and is caused by some previous phenomenon
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: ある先行する現象に続く現象、またはある先行する現象を原因とする現象。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We were all surprised at the effect the news had on him.

vocabulary.english_definition: An opposing military force
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 敵対する軍隊。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We have to drive the enemy out of our land.

vocabulary.english_definition: (physics) a thermodynamic quantity equivalent to the capacity of a physical system to do work; the units of energy are joules or ergs
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 動作する物理的システムの容量と同等の熱力学量。エネルギーの単位はジュールとエルグである。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I don't think I have the energy to do that.

vocabulary.english_definition: Motor that converts thermal energy to mechanical work
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 熱のエネルギーを機械的な仕事に変換するモータ。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I got back in my car and started the engine.

vocabulary.english_definition: A person who uses scientific knowledge to solve practical problems
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 科学的知識を実用的な問題の解決に用いる人。
vocabulary.example_sentence: My father works for the company as an engineer.

vocabulary.english_definition: Something that provides access (to get in or get out)
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 出入りを提供するもの（入る、または、出る）。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Please wait for me at the entrance of the building.

vocabulary.english_definition: An instrumentality needed for an undertaking or to perform a service
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 課題あるいはサービスを実行するのに必要な物。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We had a little trouble with the equipment yesterday.

vocabulary.english_definition: The activity of exerting your muscles in various ways to keep fit
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 健康を維持するための様々な方法での筋肉の鍛錬。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I think you should stop watching TV and get some exercise.

vocabulary.english_definition: Someone who travels into little known regions (especially for some scientific purpose)
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: ほとんど知られていない地域を旅する人（特に科学的目的で）。
vocabulary.example_sentence: After playing outside, the first thing you should do is wash your hands, my little explorer.

vocabulary.english_definition: The latest and most admired style in clothes and cosmetics and behavior
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 服装、美容、行動における、最も新しく最も賞賛を浴びている様式。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I never want to hear you talking in this fashion again.

vocabulary.english_definition: One of the elements that collectively form a system of numeration
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 記数の体系を集合的に形作る要素の1つ。
vocabulary.example_sentence: How do you eat like that and keep your figure?

vocabulary.english_definition: A prediction about how something (as the weather) will develop
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: （天気のような）何かがどのようになるかについての予報。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Do you know what the weather forecast is for tomorrow?

vocabulary.english_definition: Furnishings that make a room or other area ready for occupancy
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 部屋または他のエリアを居住できるようにする道具。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I want to move the furniture in the room.

vocabulary.english_definition: For a very long or seemingly endless time
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 非常に長いか、一見終りのない時間のために。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We are not on the earth forever, but only for a time.

vocabulary.english_definition: By good fortune
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 幸運にも、運よく。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Fortunately, the weather was good and we were able to eat outside.

vocabulary.english_definition: (used as intensives reflecting the speaker's attitude) it is sincerely the case that
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: それは、誠実に本当である。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I quite frankly don't know.

vocabulary.english_definition: every time that; at any time that
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 「〜するときはいつでも」「〜するたびに」を表す。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You can ask me whenever you need help.

vocabulary.english_definition: except if
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 「もし〜でなければ」を表す。if ... not に近い意味。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We will play outside unless it rains.

vocabulary.english_definition: used to introduce two possibilities or uncertainty
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 「〜かどうか」を表し、二つの可能性を示す。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I don't know whether the shop is open today.

vocabulary.english_definition: in or to any place that
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 「〜する所ならどこでも」を表す。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You can sit wherever you feel comfortable.

vocabulary.english_definition: not including
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 全体から特定の人や物を除くこと。
vocabulary.example_sentence: The shop is open every day except Monday.

vocabulary.english_definition: until a particular time
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 「〜まで」を表し、until と同じように使う。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I'll wait here till you come back.

vocabulary.english_definition: farther than a place, limit, or ability
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: ある場所・限界・能力などを越えていること。
vocabulary.example_sentence: There is a small village beyond those hills.

vocabulary.english_definition: without being prevented by something
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 「〜にもかかわらず」を表す。後ろは名詞や動名詞。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We enjoyed our walk despite the cold weather.

vocabulary.english_definition: in the direction of
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 人や場所などに向かう方向を表す。towards とも書く。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We walked toward the station after lunch.

vocabulary.english_definition: A canonical hour that is the ninth hour of the day counting from sunrise
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 祈祷辞官は日の出からその日のうちで9時間目である。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I hope that none of them got into an accident.

vocabulary.english_definition: Go into retirement; stop performing one's work or withdraw from one's position
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 隠居する、退職する。その人の仕事を実行するのを止めるあるいは、その人の職務から撤退する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I hope to retire from work when I'm 60 years old.

vocabulary.english_definition: Sound loudly and sonorously
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 大きく朗々と鳴り響く。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I don't want you to ring me up all the time.

vocabulary.english_definition: Utter a sudden loud cry
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 突然、大きい泣き声を発する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I wanted to scream, but I couldn't find my voice at all.

vocabulary.english_definition: Utter in a loud voice; talk in a loud voice (usually denoting characteristic manner of speaking)
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 大声で話す。大きな声で話す（通常、特徴的な話し方を示して）。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You don't have to shout. I can hear you.

vocabulary.english_definition: Look at with fixed eyes
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 固定された視線で見る。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We stopped to stare at them.

vocabulary.english_definition: Make a proposal, declare a plan for something
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 提案する、計画を表明する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I was just going to suggest that you do that.

vocabulary.english_definition: Continue to live through hardship or adversity
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 苦難または逆境を通して生き続ける。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We can survive without food... just not for too long.

vocabulary.english_definition: Make physical contact with, come in contact with
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: と身体的に接触する、と接触する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I know that you still want to touch my hand.

vocabulary.english_definition: Give rise to; cause to happen or occur, not always intentionally

vocabulary.english_definition: Have ownership or possession of

vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 値段がつく。

vocabulary.english_definition: To make better
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: よりよくする。

vocabulary.english_definition: Fill or meet a want or need
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 欲望または必要性を満たす、あるいはこれらに合致する。

vocabulary.english_definition: Cut down on; make a reduction in

vocabulary.english_definition: Any malignant growth or tumor caused by abnormal and uncontrolled cell division; it may spread to other parts of the body through the lymphatic system or the blood stream

vocabulary.english_definition: A specific piece of work required to be done as a duty or for a specific fee

vocabulary.english_definition: A condition that accompanies or influences some event or activity

vocabulary.english_definition: An event that might have been arranged although it was really accidental
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 本当に偶然だったが、準備されていたかもしれない出来事。

vocabulary.english_definition: A special group delegated to consider some matter
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: ある問題について検討することを委ねられた特別のグループ。

vocabulary.english_definition: A friend who is frequently in the company of another
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: しばしば別の仲間の中にいる友人。

vocabulary.english_definition: A body serving in an administrative capacity
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 運営機関として働く団体。

vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 突然の思いがけない危機（通例危険を伴う）で緊急な行動をとる必要があること。

vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 広く称えられ、賞賛されている状態もしくは特質。

vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 公共の乗物の利用に対する請求額。

vocabulary.japanese_explanation: その時に正確に作用する、到着する、実行される、あるいは指定する。

vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 神性な事柄、宗教または教会に関する。

vocabulary.english_definition: Socially incorrect in behavior
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 社会的に誤った行動。

vocabulary.english_definition: Deficient in quantity or number compared with the demand
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 量や数が、需要に比べて不十分である。

vocabulary.english_definition: Occurring at or dependent on a particular season
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 特定の季節に発生すること、あるいは依存するさま。

vocabulary.english_definition: Concerned chiefly or only with yourself and your advantage to the exclusion of others

vocabulary.english_definition: Keep from happening or arising; make impossible

vocabulary.example_sentence: I was just going to suggest that you do that.

vocabulary.english_definition: Give moral or psychological support, aid, or courage to
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 精神的あるいは心理的な支援、援助、または勇気を与える。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I have a wife and three children to support.

vocabulary.english_definition: Connect, fasten, or put together two or more pieces
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 2つ、それ以上のものをつなげる、固める一緒にする。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Do you feel like you cannot connect with other people?

vocabulary.english_definition: Have as a part, be made up out of
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 部分としてある、の中から作られた。
vocabulary.example_sentence: For some reason, they didn't include my name on the list.

vocabulary.japanese_meaning: のままである・残っている
vocabulary.english_definition: Stay the same; remain in a certain state
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 同じでいる。ある状態に保つ。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You don't really want to remain here, do you?
vocabulary.raw_japanese_extraction: のままである・残っている
vocabulary.source_japanese_meaning: のままである・残っている

vocabulary.english_definition: Restore by replacing a part or putting together what is torn or broken
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 部分を取り替えるまたは裂けているか、壊れているものを組み立てることにより修復する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: What would it cost to repair this chair?

vocabulary.english_definition: Spend thoughtlessly; throw away
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 軽率に費やす。浪費する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You must be careful not to waste time.

vocabulary.english_definition: An imperfection in an object or machine
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 物または機械の欠陥。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You talk as if it's my fault.

vocabulary.english_definition: An act of gracious kindness
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 丁寧で親切な行為。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I gave him a present in return for his favor.

vocabulary.english_definition: A boy or man
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 少年または男。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I don't believe I've ever seen that fellow.

vocabulary.english_definition: A slender and greatly elongated substance capable of being spun into yarn
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 紡がれて紡績糸になることのできる細く、とても長くされた物質。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I love my country with every fiber of my being.

vocabulary.english_definition: A deliberately false or improbable account
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 故意に誤ったまたは本当とは思えない説明。
vocabulary.example_sentence: How can you tell fact from fiction?

vocabulary.english_definition: One of the elements that collectively form a system of numeration
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 記数の体系を集合的に形作る要素の1つ。
vocabulary.example_sentence: How do you eat like that and keep your figure?

vocabulary.english_definition: The soft tissue of the body of a vertebrate: mainly muscle tissue and fat
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 脊椎動物の身体の柔らかい組織：主として筋肉組織と脂肪。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I have seen him on TV but not in the flesh.

vocabulary.english_definition: Fine powdery foodstuff obtained by grinding and sifting the meal of a cereal grain
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: シリアル粒の食物をつぶすまたはふるうことで得られる細かい粉状の食料品。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We went to the market, and I bought some flour.

vocabulary.english_definition: An international boundary or the area (often fortified) immediately inside the boundary
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 国境線またはその境のすぐ内側の地帯（しばしば防壁のある）。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We crossed the frontier yesterday.

vocabulary.english_definition: A ceremony at which a dead person is buried or cremated
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 死者が埋められたり火葬にされる儀式。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I am going to attend a funeral tomorrow.

vocabulary.english_definition: (physics) the force of attraction between all masses in the universe; especially the attraction of the earth's mass for bodies near its surface
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 宇宙のすべての塊の間の引力。特に、地球の表面付近の物体に対する地球の質量の引力。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I am well aware of the gravity of the situation.

vocabulary.english_definition: The type of environment in which an organism or group normally lives or occurs
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 有機体またはグループが通常生活または発生する環境の種類。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I live in a space habitat.

vocabulary.english_definition: A state of misfortune or affliction
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 不幸なもしくは苦痛な状態。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You will have to go through hardship.

vocabulary.english_definition: Resistant to change of position or condition
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 位置または状態の変化に抵抗する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I put the horse back in the stable yesterday.

vocabulary.english_definition: Not subject to change or variation especially in behavior
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 特にふるまいにおける変更または変化への対象ではない。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You need to find yourself a steady job.

vocabulary.english_definition: Difficult to detect or grasp by the mind or analyze
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 心または分析により検出する、あるいは把握することが難しい。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I will pay him back later in a subtle way.

vocabulary.english_definition: Of high or superior quality or performance
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 高い、あるいは優れた品質か性能の。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You think you're superior to me in every way.

vocabulary.english_definition: Openly distrustful and unwilling to confide
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 明らかに不信で、委託をしたがらない。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I do believe that you are suspicious of me.

vocabulary.english_definition: Full of trivial conversation
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 些細な会話でいっぱいである。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I noticed straight away that he wasn't really very talkative.

vocabulary.english_definition: Of or relating to or caused by a toxin or poison
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 毒素または毒物の、毒素または毒物に関する、あるいは、毒素または毒物に引き起こされる。
vocabulary.example_sentence: How do you get over a toxic job?

vocabulary.english_definition: Difficult to deal with
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 対処するのが難しい。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We have to somehow come through this troublesome situation.

vocabulary.english_definition: Worthy of trust or belief
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 信用または信念に値する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: What is seen in movies and on TV is not trustworthy.

vocabulary.english_definition: empty and available for someone to use
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 人が使っておらず、空いていること。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Is there a vacant seat near the window?

vocabulary.english_definition: Not clearly understood or expressed
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 明確に理解されないか、または表現されない。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Do you have a vague idea about what's in the box?

vocabulary.english_definition: Sufficient for the purpose
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 目的のために十分な。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I don't consider that adequate.

vocabulary.english_definition: Having or displaying warmth or affection
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 暖かさまたは愛情を持つか、表すさま。
vocabulary.example_sentence: It's not possible for us to be very affectionate.

vocabulary.english_definition: Ask (for something)
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: （何かを）求める。
vocabulary.example_sentence: What kind of job do you want to apply for?

vocabulary.english_definition: Operate or control a vehicle
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 乗り物を操作するかコントロールする。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You yourself need to learn how to drive a car.

vocabulary.english_definition: Inspire with confidence; give hope or courage to
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 自信がわいてくる。望みや勇気を与える。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You have to encourage him to become a teacher!

vocabulary.english_definition: Express or raise an objection or protest or criticism or express dissent
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 異論、抗議または批評を示す、または異議を唱える。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Do you think anyone would object if we did that?

vocabulary.english_definition: Make ready or suitable or equip in advance for a particular purpose or for some use, event, etc
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 特定の目的、使用、あるいは出来事のためにあらかじめ準備しておく、整える、備える。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I have to prepare to go to school.

vocabulary.english_definition: To keep up and reserve for personal or special use
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 私的または特別の使用のために続けるまたは取っておく。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We had to smoke our meat to preserve it.

vocabulary.english_definition: Make a promise or commitment
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 約束する、または、誓約する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Please promise me that you'll never lie to me again.

vocabulary.english_definition: Substitute a person or thing for (another that is broken or inefficient or lost or no longer working or yielding what is expected)
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: の代わりに人またはものを代用する（壊れている、能率が悪い、紛失した、これ以上動かないあるいは期待されていることを産出できない別のもの）。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We won't be able to replace it.

vocabulary.english_definition: Give something useful or necessary to
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 何かを役に立つまたは必要であるものにする。
vocabulary.example_sentence: The store can supply us with anything we need.

vocabulary.english_definition: Notify of danger, potential harm, or risk
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 危険、潜在的害または危険を通知する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I came here to warn you about what might happen.

vocabulary.english_definition: Direct toward itself or oneself by means of some psychological power or physical attributes
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 心理学的力または物理的属性という手段でそのものまたはその人自身に直接向けられた。
vocabulary.example_sentence: How to attract and keep new customers for a small business?

vocabulary.english_definition: Examine and note the similarities or differences of
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 類似点または相違点を検討し留意する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I don't think you should compare yourself to others.

vocabulary.english_definition: Provide a cure for, make healthy again
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 再び健康にするよう、治療する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You think that you can cure yourself, don't you?

vocabulary.english_definition: The state of being honored
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 名誉を与えられていること。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I can't tell you what an honor this is.

vocabulary.english_definition: Inborn pattern of behavior often responsive to specific stimuli
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: しばしば特定の刺激に対して反応するときの持って生まれた行動パターン。
vocabulary.example_sentence: My instinct said I could trust you.

vocabulary.english_definition: Promise of reimbursement in the case of loss; paid to people or companies so concerned about hazards that they have made prepayments to an insurance company
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 損失の場合に償還する契約。危険を心配して保険会社に前納した人々または会社に支払われる。
vocabulary.example_sentence: My son-in-law works at an insurance company.

vocabulary.english_definition: An anticipated outcome that is intended or that guides your planned actions
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 意図している、または計画した行動を導く、予期された結果。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I didn't mean to make you angry, the intention was good.

vocabulary.english_definition: A mutual or reciprocal action; interacting
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 相互の、あるいは双方向の行為。交流すること。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I expect respect in every interaction I have.

vocabulary.english_definition: The act of investing; laying out money or capital in an enterprise with the expectation of profit
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 投資する行為。利益を期待して、事業に金銭や資本を投資すること。
vocabulary.example_sentence: How much of a return did you get on your investment?

vocabulary.english_definition: An important question that is in dispute and must be settled
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 論争の重要な論点で、解決しなければならないこと。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Could you share your honest opinion on this issue?

vocabulary.english_definition: The quality of being just or fair
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 公正または公平である性質。
vocabulary.example_sentence: My grandfather was a justice of the peace.

vocabulary.japanese_meaning: 目印・画期的な出来事
vocabulary.english_definition: The position of a prominent or well-known object in a particular landscape
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: ある特殊な土地で際立って、有名な物の位置。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Do you see a landmark?
vocabulary.raw_japanese_extraction: 目印・画期的な出来事
vocabulary.source_japanese_meaning: 目印・画期的な出来事

vocabulary.english_definition: An expanse of scenery that can be seen in a single view
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 一目で見られる景色の広がり。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I've never seen a landscape this big.

vocabulary.english_definition: A narrow way or road
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 細い道または道路。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I had a lane all to myself at the swimming pool today.

vocabulary.english_definition: A professional person authorized to practice law; conducts lawsuits or gives legal advice
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 弁護士の権限を与えられた専門家。訴訟を行ったり法律上の助言を与えたりする。
vocabulary.example_sentence: My father-in-law is a lawyer.

vocabulary.english_definition: The ability to lead
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 指導力。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We have a leadership problem.

vocabulary.english_definition: Exceptionally bad or displeasing
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 非常に悪いか、または不快である。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I never realized how awful living all alone could be.

vocabulary.english_definition: Marked by a tendency to find and call attention to errors and flaws
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 間違いや欠点を見つけ、それらに注視する傾向に特徴的な。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I can't understand why you are so critical of him.

vocabulary.english_definition: Not in accordance with the fact or reality or actuality
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 事実、現実または現実性に従ってではなく。
vocabulary.example_sentence: What he said turned out to be false.

vocabulary.english_definition: Marked by extreme anger
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 極端な怒りで、マークされる。
vocabulary.example_sentence: My dad is often furious because of his car.

vocabulary.english_definition: Parallel to or in the plane of the horizon or a base line
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 平行線または基線に対して平行または同じ面に属して。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I used a spirit level to make sure the shelf was perfectly horizontal.

vocabulary.english_definition: Of or characteristic of low rank or importance
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 下位または重要でないもの、あるいは、下位または重要でないもに特徴的な。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You think that your language is inferior.

vocabulary.english_definition: Free from evil or guilt
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 悪または罪とは無縁の。
vocabulary.example_sentence: How can you tell who's innocent and who's guilty?

vocabulary.english_definition: Clean or organized
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 健全である、または組織立っているさま。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I want to keep my room as neat as possible.

vocabulary.japanese_meaning: どちらの〜も・・・ない
vocabulary.english_definition: not one and not the other of two
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 二つのどちらも当てはまらないことを表す。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Neither of these shirts is the right size.
vocabulary.raw_japanese_extraction: どちらの〜も・・・ない
vocabulary.source_japanese_meaning: どちらの〜も・・・ない

vocabulary.english_definition: Not supporting or favoring either side in a war, dispute, or contest
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 論争、コンテストまたは戦争でどちらの側の援護もしない、支持しないさま。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Ziri tried to keep a neutral face as he spoke about that.
