vocabulary.english_definition: Having or showing or indicative of high or elevated character
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 高いか高尚な性質を持つ、示す、または暗示しているさま。
vocabulary.example_sentence: What a noble heart that good man has!

vocabulary.english_definition: Belonging to an early stage of technical development; characterized by simplicity and (often) crudeness
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 技術的な開発の初期の段階に属するさま。単純さと（しばしば）未熟さによって特徴づけられる。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You think that your language is more primitive.

vocabulary.english_definition: Far apart in relevance or relationship or kinship
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 関連性、関係または緊密性においてかけ離れた。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We can open the car using a remote control.

vocabulary.english_definition: Speak with others about (something); talk (something) over in detail; have a discussion
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: （何か）について他と話す。（何か）について詳細に議論する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We used to discuss everything and now we can't talk about anything.

vocabulary.english_definition: Travel to or penetrate into
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 旅行するか、侵入する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I want to explore the world. It’s my dream.

vocabulary.english_definition: Identify as in botany or biology, for example
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 例えば、植物学または生物学で特定する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I don't want to identify myself with that group.

vocabulary.english_definition: Give a performance (of something)
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: （何かの）公演をする。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I do not like to perform in front of others.

vocabulary.english_definition: Make a prediction about; tell in advance
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 予言をする。前もって予見する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I won't try to predict the future.

vocabulary.english_definition: Deem to be
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: そうであると考える。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Do you know what I think in this regard?

vocabulary.english_definition: Require as useful, just, or proper
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 有用、正当、または適切であるため欠かせない。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We know doing that will require a lot of money.

vocabulary.english_definition: Make an addition (to); join or combine or unite with others; increase the quality, quantity, size or scope of
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 追加する（に対して）。加わるか、組み合わさるか、または他と結合する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We didn't need to add flowers to the car to make it beautiful.

vocabulary.english_definition: Point or cause to go (blows, weapons, or objects such as photographic equipment) towards
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 何かをさし示したり、どこかへ行かせる（打撃、兵器、カメラの道具など）。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I aim to be a doctor when I grow up.

vocabulary.english_definition: to produce young animals; to raise animals for breeding
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 動物が子を産むことや、繁殖させること。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Some birds breed here during the summer months.

vocabulary.english_definition: Demand payment
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 支払いを要求する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I think you should charge $30 an hour.

vocabulary.english_definition: Give food to
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 食物を与える。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I don't think we have enough food to feed everyone.

vocabulary.japanese_meaning: 氾濫する・水浸しにする
vocabulary.english_definition: Cover with liquid, usually water
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 液体で覆う、通常水。
vocabulary.example_sentence: The heavy rains caused the river to flood.
vocabulary.raw_japanese_extraction: 氾濫する・水浸しにする
vocabulary.source_japanese_meaning: 氾濫する・水浸しにする

vocabulary.english_definition: A story about mythical or supernatural beings or events
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 神話上のまたは超自然の存在または出来事についての物語。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I can make you a legend.

vocabulary.english_definition: Time available for ease and relaxation
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: くつろぎとリラックスのための時間。
vocabulary.example_sentence: What do they do with all their leisure time?

vocabulary.english_definition: The branch of philosophy that analyzes inference
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 推論を分析する哲学の分野。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I cannot follow your logic.

vocabulary.english_definition: Cases used to carry belongings when traveling
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 旅行のとき持ち物を運ぶのに用いる箱。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I don't carry much luggage when I travel by plane.

vocabulary.english_definition: Something that is an indulgence rather than a necessity
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 必要性よりむしろ道楽を目的としたもの。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I told her that we couldn't afford such a luxury.

vocabulary.english_definition: Cosmetics applied to the face to improve or change your appearance
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 外見をよくしたり変えたりするために顔に塗る化粧品。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I wash my face every evening to get my makeup off.

vocabulary.english_definition: Any warm-blooded vertebrate having the skin more or less covered with hair; young are born alive except for the small subclass of monotremes and nourished with milk
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 皮膚がほぼ毛で覆われている、温血脊椎動物。単孔類の小亜綱を除いて子供は生きたまま生まれミルクで育てられる。
vocabulary.example_sentence: What is the largest mammal in the world?

vocabulary.english_definition: A small handbook
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 小さなハンドブック。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Do you know how to drive a manual car?

vocabulary.english_definition: The message that is intended or expressed or signified
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 意図されたまたは表現されたメッセージ。
vocabulary.example_sentence: What is the meaning of this sentence?

vocabulary.english_definition: Any admirable quality or attribute
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 賞賛すべき特質や属性。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I don't know that there's any great merit in that.

vocabulary.english_definition: A person whose material wealth is valued at more than a million dollars
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 物質的な富が100万ドル以上と評価される人。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I wonder what it would be like to be a millionaire.

vocabulary.english_definition: Solid homogeneous inorganic substances occurring in nature having a definite chemical composition
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 個々の化学組成を持つ、自然界において見出される固体で均質な無機物。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I always carry a bottle of mineral water with me.

vocabulary.english_definition: a very small model or copy of something
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 実物よりずっと小さく作られた模型や複製。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We saw a miniature of the castle at the museum.

vocabulary.english_definition: Relating to or concerned with a city or densely populated area
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 都市または人口稠密な地域に関連があるか、に関する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We live in an urban area.

vocabulary.english_definition: Continuing forever without end
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 果てしなく永遠に続くこと。
vocabulary.example_sentence: My dream man is endlessly playing hide-and-seek with me.

vocabulary.english_definition: At a previous time
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 前回に。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I didn't study Berber formerly.

vocabulary.english_definition: (used as intensives reflecting the speaker's attitude) it is sincerely the case that
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: それは、誠実に本当である。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I quite frankly don't know.

vocabulary.english_definition: Not easy to believe
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 容易には信じられない。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I just had something incredibly strange happen to me.

vocabulary.english_definition: At the beginning
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 初めのところで。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I initially had trouble understanding what he was saying.

vocabulary.english_definition: With pride; in a proud manner
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 誇りを持って。誇り高い態度で。
vocabulary.example_sentence: He proudly wore the green star.

vocabulary.english_definition: Several time
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 数回。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I can't believe you are eating something the doctor has told you repeatedly you shouldn't eat.

vocabulary.english_definition: Not often
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: めったにない。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We often have to start again, but seldom from the beginning.

vocabulary.english_definition: To a small degree or extent
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 小さい程度か範囲に。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I speak French only slightly better than I speak English.

vocabulary.english_definition: For some unspecified reason
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: ある明細化されていない理由で。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I don't have much money, but I can get along somehow.

vocabulary.english_definition: With regard to technique
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 技術に関して。
vocabulary.example_sentence: My answer was not technically a lie.

vocabulary.english_definition: For a limited time only; not permanently
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 限られた期間だけ。永続しない。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I was only hired temporarily.

vocabulary.english_definition: Determine the result of (a competition)
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: （競争）の結果を決定する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You can judge people by the company they keep.

vocabulary.english_definition: Like better; value more highly
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: より好む。より高く評価する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I would prefer to stay home rather than go out.

vocabulary.english_definition: Examine minutely or intensely
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 緻密にまた強烈に調べる。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I want you to scan this book.

vocabulary.english_definition: Undergo or be subjected to
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 耐える、またはさらされる。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I don't see why we should have to suffer.

vocabulary.english_definition: Have an effect upon
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 影響を及ぼす。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We must not allow these problems to affect the project.

vocabulary.english_definition: Present reasons and arguments
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 理由と論拠を提示する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I don't want to argue in front of the children.

vocabulary.english_definition: Express complaints, discontent, displeasure, or unhappiness
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 苦情、不満、不快または不幸を表現する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I actually have a lot to complain about in my life.

vocabulary.english_definition: Find fault with; express criticism of; point out real or perceived flaws
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 非難する。批評を表す。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I am free to criticize the US.

vocabulary.english_definition: Cause to be slowed down or delayed
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 減速させられる、または遅延させられる。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I don't think we should delay doing that any longer.

vocabulary.english_definition: Bring to a destination, make a delivery
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 目的地に持ってくる、引き渡す。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We will deliver up to the airport of the island.

vocabulary.english_definition: Request urgently and forcefully
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 緊急に、そして、力強く要請する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I demand to see the manager.

vocabulary.english_definition: Oppose, as in hostility or a competition
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 戦争行為または競争などにおいて敵対する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I couldn't leave you alone to face the danger by yourself.

vocabulary.english_definition: Win something through one's efforts
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 努力で何かに勝つ。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I want to gain a better understanding of myself.

vocabulary.english_definition: A person appointed to a high office in the government
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 政府の高い地位に任命される人。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I spoke to the minister himself.

vocabulary.english_definition: A group of representatives or delegates
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 代表者や使節のグループ。
vocabulary.example_sentence: How dangerous do you think this mission is going to be?

vocabulary.japanese_meaning: 動機・モチベーション
vocabulary.english_definition: The psychological feature that arouses an organism to action toward a desired goal; the reason for the action; that which gives purpose and direction to behavior
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 有機体が望む目的に向かって行動を起こすように仕向ける心理学的特性。行動の理由。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You give me the motivation to keep going when things become tough.
vocabulary.raw_japanese_extraction: 動機・モチベーション
vocabulary.source_japanese_meaning: 動機・モチベーション

vocabulary.english_definition: A politically organized body of people under a single government
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 単一の政府の下に政治的に組織された人々の集まり。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We need a strong person to lead our nation.

vocabulary.english_definition: Anything indispensable
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 不可欠な何でも。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We understand the necessity of studying.

vocabulary.english_definition: A discussion intended to produce an agreement
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 合意を目指した議論。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We want to break off this negotiation.

vocabulary.english_definition: A source of materials to nourish the body
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 身体を養うための材料の源。
vocabulary.example_sentence: In your opinion, what does good nutrition look like?

vocabulary.english_definition: A contestant that you are matched against
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 対抗している競争相手。
vocabulary.example_sentence: My opponent was stronger than I was.

vocabulary.english_definition: The place where something begins, where it springs into being
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 何かが生まれて、始まる場所。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I would like to know your origin.

vocabulary.english_definition: An established line of travel or access
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 往来や出入りのために作られた進路。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Please show me the path to the bus stop.

vocabulary.english_definition: The period of greatest prosperity or productivity
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 最大に繁栄、もしくは生産をあげている時期。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Can you see that mountain with the snow-covered peak?

vocabulary.english_definition: Any state or process known through the senses rather than by intuition or reasoning
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 直感や推理よりも感覚を通じて知る状態や過程。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We have never managed to explain that phenomenon.

vocabulary.english_definition: A belief (or system of beliefs) accepted as authoritative by some group or school
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 一部のグループまたは流派によって権威があると認められている信念（または信念の体系）。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I agree with that philosophy.

vocabulary.english_definition: And nothing more
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: そして、多くは何もない。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You should never look down on a person merely because he is poor.

vocabulary.english_definition: Not the same one or ones already mentioned or implied
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 既に述べた、または示したのと同じものではない。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I still haven't eaten the chocolate that you gave me the other day.

vocabulary.english_definition: Relating to or used in chemistry
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 化学で使用されるまたはそれに関係する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Everyone knows that new chemical is bad for you.

vocabulary.english_definition: Contrived by art rather than nature
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 自然ではなくむしろ人為的に考案された。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I don't like artificial flowers.

vocabulary.english_definition: Relating to or derived from the sun or utilizing the energies of the sun
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 太陽あるいは太陽のエネルギーを利用するものに関する、またはから生じた。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We must make the best use of solar energy.

vocabulary.english_definition: Enduring trying circumstances with even temper or characterized by such endurance
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 穏やかな気持ちで辛い境遇に耐える、もしくはそのような我慢強さが特徴の。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Please be patient with me today.

vocabulary.english_definition: Not private; open to or concerning the people as a whole
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 個人的でない。全体の人に対してまたはそれに関して。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I went to a public garden to rest.

vocabulary.english_definition: Obtainable or accessible and ready for use or service
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 入手または利用可能で、使用またはサービスの準備が整っている。
vocabulary.example_sentence: How much power do we have available?

vocabulary.english_definition: With considerable certainty; without much doubt
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: かなりの確信を持って。あまり疑いなく。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We all hope that's true, but we think it likely isn't.

vocabulary.english_definition: Having the same or similar characteristics
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 同じものまたは類似した特徴を持つ。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We are so similar and so different at the same time.

vocabulary.english_definition: Having or feeling no doubt or uncertainty; confident and assured
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 疑いまたは不確実性を持たないか感じないさま。自信があって確実な。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I feel better now, I could no longer keep certain things inside.

vocabulary.english_definition: Having no special distinction or quality; widely known or commonly encountered; average or ordinary or usual
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 特殊の区別または性質を持たない。広く知られたまたは一般に知られた。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I had no idea we had so much in common.

vocabulary.english_definition: Unusually great in size or amount or degree or especially extent or scope
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 通常、サイズ、量、度数、特に程度または範囲において大きな。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We could be making a huge mistake here.

vocabulary.english_definition: Win something through one's efforts
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 努力で何かに勝つ。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I want to gain a better understanding of myself.

vocabulary.english_definition: Refuse to acknowledge
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 認めることを拒む。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I don't think that you can ignore this problem anymore.

vocabulary.english_definition: Originate (in)
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: （に）起源する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I want you to lie still for a few hours.

vocabulary.english_definition: Be successful; achieve a goal
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 成功している。目的を達成する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I think we can manage that.

vocabulary.english_definition: Be equal or harmonize
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 等しくなる、または調和する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Please help me choose a hat to match my new dress.

vocabulary.english_definition: Undergo a chemical reaction; react with another substance under certain conditions
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 化学反応が起こる。一定の条件下で別の物質と反応する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I didn't know how to react to that.

vocabulary.english_definition: Be fully aware or cognizant of
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 十分に認知しているまたは認識している。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I think it's important to realize that may not happen.

vocabulary.english_definition: Be able to spare or give up
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 容赦するか、やめることができない。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I wish I'd been able to afford a better car.

vocabulary.english_definition: Have an existence, be extant
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 存在を持つ、存在する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You will exist but you will never know what it is to live.

vocabulary.english_definition: Restore by replacing a part or putting together what is torn or broken
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 部分を取り替えるまたは裂けているか、壊れているものを組み立てることにより修復する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I don't think I'll be able to fix your broken phone.

vocabulary.english_definition: Make reference to
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 言及を行う。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I am not going to mention the name of the teacher.

vocabulary.english_definition: Act against or in opposition to
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: それに対して、あるいは反対して行う。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I hope you're not going to oppose me.

vocabulary.english_definition: Win a victory over
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 勝利を収める。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You can overcome your problems.

vocabulary.english_definition: An expression consisting of one or more words forming a grammatical constituent of a sentence
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 文の文法的な構成要素を形成する、1つ以上の単語から成る表現。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Could you read this phrase and translate it into your languages?

vocabulary.english_definition: A licensed medical practitioner
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 認可された医者。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I want to be a physician in the future.

vocabulary.english_definition: The science of matter and energy and their interactions
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 物質とエネルギーとその相互作用の科学。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I cannot understand the physics teacher. I am completely lost!

vocabulary.english_definition: Extensive tract of level open land
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 平らで開けた土地の広範囲に及ぶ地帯。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You can talk to him in plain English and he still won't get it.

vocabulary.english_definition: A leader engaged in civil administration
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 行政の指導的立場にある人。
vocabulary.example_sentence: What that politician said is not at all true.

vocabulary.english_definition: The allotment of some amount by dividing something
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 何かを分割することでいくらかの量を割り当てること。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Our portion has been eaten.

vocabulary.english_definition: A dense crowd of people
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 人のひどい混雑。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We asked him to face the press but he refused to.

vocabulary.english_definition: A basic or essential attribute shared by all members of a class
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: ある種類のメンバー全てによって共有される基本的、あるいは不可欠な属性。
vocabulary.example_sentence: How many of the trees on your property are fruit trees?

vocabulary.english_definition: The quotient obtained when the magnitude of a part is divided by the magnitude of the whole
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 部分の大きさを全体の大きさで割った時に得られる商。
vocabulary.example_sentence: The proportion of girls to boys in our class is three to two.

vocabulary.english_definition: One of four equal parts
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 4等分の1つ。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Do you have a quarter I could borrow?

vocabulary.english_definition: The act of receiving
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 受け取る行為。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Please wait a moment while I write out your receipt.

vocabulary.english_definition: An authoritative rule
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 権威のある規則。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We should do away with this regulation.

vocabulary.english_definition: The state of being held in high esteem and honor
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 非常に尊敬され称えられていること。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You have something of a reputation.

vocabulary.english_definition: Having succeeded or being marked by a favorable outcome
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 成功したか、または良好な結果によって特徴づけられる。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I hope that your business trip to France was successful.

vocabulary.english_definition: Financially secure and safe
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 金融的に堅実で安全な。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I just want to get home safe and sound.

vocabulary.english_definition: Characterized by unity; being or joined into a single entity
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 統一で特徴づけられる。単一体であるまたはそれに加わる。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You must be more united than ever.

vocabulary.english_definition: Of many different kinds purposefully arranged but lacking any uniformity
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 意図的に整列しているが統一性に欠ける多くの異なった種類。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I really like studying various languages at the same time.

vocabulary.english_definition: Occurring in or belonging to the present time
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 今現在に起こるか、属しているさま。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I can’t take time off for a trip with my current pay.

vocabulary.english_definition: Involving the entire earth; not limited or provincial in scope
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 地球全体を含むさま。制限のない、偏狭でない領域。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We are all part of the global economy.

vocabulary.english_definition: Being or characteristic of a single thing or person
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 一つのものまたは人であること、の特徴。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We must respect the will of the individual.

vocabulary.english_definition: Characterized by or displaying negation or denial or opposition or resistance; having no positive features
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 否定、否認、反対または抵抗により特徴付けられるか、または示すさま。肯定的な特性を持たないこと。
vocabulary.example_sentence: What is one negative thing your last boss say about you?

vocabulary.english_definition: Temporal sense; intermediate between past and future; now existing or happening or in consideration
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 時間的な感覚。過去と未来の中間で。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You must live in the present, not in the past.

vocabulary.english_definition: The single one of its kind
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: その種類の唯一のもの。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I didn't realize how unique that was until I grew up.

vocabulary.english_definition: Suited to your comfort or purpose or needs
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 快適さまたは目的またはニーズに適している。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Please come to meet me some time when it's convenient.

vocabulary.english_definition: (of a church) given official status as a national or state institution
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: （教会について）国家または州の機関として公式の地位を与えられた。
vocabulary.example_sentence: What is the official language of your country?

vocabulary.english_definition: Causing or capable of causing harm
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 害を起こすことのできるまたは起こす。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Too much of anything is harmful.

vocabulary.english_definition: Win approval or support for
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 承認か支持を勝ち取る。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You won't be able to persuade me to support you.

vocabulary.english_definition: Put into print
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 印刷に入れる。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I haven't had the time these days to publish it.

vocabulary.english_definition: Cultivate by growing, often involving improvements by means of agricultural techniques
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 育成して栽培する、しばしは農業技術の方法の改良を含む。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Do you know how hard we worked to raise you?

vocabulary.english_definition: Do duty or hold offices; serve in a specific function
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 職務を遂行する、または在職する。具体的な機能に奉仕する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I do not want you to serve me.

vocabulary.english_definition: Have in common
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 共通に持つ。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I would like to share a short story with you.

vocabulary.english_definition: Tolerate or accommodate oneself to
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 許容するか、順応する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I didn't want his help, but I had to accept it.

vocabulary.english_definition: Announce publicly or officially
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 公に、または公式に発表する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We plan to announce details about our plan tomorrow.

vocabulary.english_definition: Come into sight or view
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 見えてくるかあるいは見える。
vocabulary.example_sentence: My father is to appear on TV tonight.

vocabulary.english_definition: Be present at (meetings, church services, university), etc.
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: （ミーティング、礼拝、大学）等に出席する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I got up early in order to attend the meeting.

vocabulary.english_definition: Knock against with force or violence
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 力や暴力にぶつかる。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I happened to bump into her on the train.

vocabulary.english_definition: Feel concern or interest
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 気遣う、あるいは興味を示す。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You don't seem to care about anything.

vocabulary.english_definition: Come or bring to a finish or an end
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 仕上げるあるうは終わりにくるあるいはそれをもたらす。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I will complete what he started.

vocabulary.english_definition: Direct one's attention on something
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 何かに注意を向ける。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You must concentrate your attention on what you are doing.

vocabulary.english_definition: A drastic and far-reaching change in ways of thinking and behaving
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 考え方や行動の仕方が急激に広範囲に変わること。
vocabulary.example_sentence: How do you think that this revolution got under way?

vocabulary.english_definition: A person employed to represent a business and to sell its merchandise (as to customers in a store or to customers who are visited)
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: ビジネスを意味して、その商品（店の顧客対する、または、訪ねられた顧客に）を売るために雇用される人。
vocabulary.example_sentence: My wife is a salesperson, but she's not working at the moment.

vocabulary.english_definition: A mark left (usually on the skin) by the healing of injured tissue
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 傷を負った組織の癒えによって残されたマーク（通常、皮膚で）。
vocabulary.example_sentence: How did you get that scar on your left hand?

vocabulary.english_definition: The appearance of a place
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: ある場所の外観。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I feel like I've seen this scenery somewhere before.

vocabulary.english_definition: A distinctive odor that is pleasant
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: はっきりとした快いにおい。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I can't forget the scent of his hair.

vocabulary.english_definition: Financial aid provided to a student on the basis of academic merit
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 学問をしやすいように学生に与えられる経済的援助。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I was thinking I'd get a scholarship somewhere.

vocabulary.english_definition: An unelaborated elementary awareness of stimulation
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 刺激に対する直接的で基本的な認知。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I could never have imagined such a sensation.

vocabulary.english_definition: Meat of edible aquatic invertebrate with a shell (especially a mollusk or crustacean)
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 殻をもつ食用水棲無脊椎動物の肉（特に軟体動物や甲殻類）。
vocabulary.example_sentence: What's your favorite kind of shellfish?

vocabulary.english_definition: The ability to see; the visual faculty
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 見る能力。視覚の機能。
vocabulary.example_sentence: My sight isn't as good as it used to be.

vocabulary.english_definition: Something reduced to its minimal form
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: その最小の形になる何か。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Do you have the skeleton key?

vocabulary.english_definition: Something that causes great unhappiness
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 大きな不幸を引き起こすもの。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I know my sorrow won’t set me free.

vocabulary.english_definition: A reminder of past events
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 過去の出来事を思い出させるもの。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I bought you a souvenir, but I ate it.

vocabulary.english_definition: (geometry) a plane rectangle with four equal sides and four right angles; a four-sided regular polygon
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 4つの等しい辺と4つの直角がある平面長方形。4面の正多角形。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Can you find the area of this square?

vocabulary.english_definition: Unique or specific to a person or thing or category
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 人、物またはカテゴリーに特有または限られた。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I don't think Tom is the right person for this particular job.

vocabulary.english_definition: Concerned with actual use or practice
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 実際の使用または実行に関心を持つ。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I have no practical reason for learning this language.

vocabulary.english_definition: Easily perceived by the senses or grasped by the mind
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 感覚によって容易に知覚される、または心によって理解される。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I think that it's very obvious what's going to happen.

vocabulary.english_definition: Not exceptional in any way especially in quality or ability or size or degree
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 特に質、能力、大きさまたは度合において例外的ではない。
vocabulary.example_sentence: How many times do you laugh in an ordinary day?

vocabulary.english_definition: Associated with academia or an academy
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 学究的な世界かアカデミーと関連付けられる。
vocabulary.example_sentence: How can I improve my academic writing?

vocabulary.english_definition: Conforming exactly or almost exactly to fact or to a standard or performing with total accuracy
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 正確に、または、ほぼ正確に事実あるいは規格に従うか、完全な正確さで実行するさま。
vocabulary.example_sentence: How accurate do you think this report is?

vocabulary.english_definition: Belonging to times long past especially of the historical period before the fall of the Western Roman Empire
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 特に西のローマ帝国の没落の前の歴史の期間の遠い過去時間に属するさま。
vocabulary.example_sentence: What was life like for children back in ancient history?

vocabulary.english_definition: (of a surface) not written or printed on
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: （表面について）書かれていない、または印刷されていない。
vocabulary.example_sentence: My mind went blank when I saw her.

vocabulary.english_definition: expected or scheduled to happen at a particular time
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 到着や出来事などが予定されていること。
vocabulary.example_sentence: The next train is due in five minutes.

vocabulary.english_definition: Being effective without wasting time or effort or expense
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 時間または努力または実費を浪費することなく効果的であるさま。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I am not so efficient as I used to be.

vocabulary.english_definition: Applying to all or most members of a category or group
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: カテゴリやグループのすべてかほとんどの構成要素に適用するさま。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I love all animals in general.

vocabulary.english_definition: Having substance or material existence; perceptible to the senses
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 実質または具体的な存在があるさま。感覚で認識できる。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We cannot ask anything about age or physical problems.

vocabulary.english_definition: Affording pleasure; being in harmony with your taste or likings
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 喜びを与えるさま。あなたの趣味または好みと調和してあること。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We went to the party and had a pleasant time.

vocabulary.english_definition: Use up (resources or materials)
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: （資源または材料）使い果たす。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I am not allowed to consume sugar.

vocabulary.english_definition: Determine the number or amount of
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 数か量を測定する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I know I can count on every one of you.

vocabulary.english_definition: Give a description of
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 描写を行う。
vocabulary.example_sentence: How do you think that your friends would describe you?

vocabulary.english_definition: to reduce the usual price of something
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 商品などの通常の価格を下げること。
vocabulary.example_sentence: The shop will discount these shoes next week.

vocabulary.english_definition: Give to a charity or good cause
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 慈善団体または立派な大義名分に与える。
vocabulary.example_sentence: What do I need to do to donate my blood?

vocabulary.english_definition: Consider unlikely or have doubts about
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: ありそうもないと思うか、疑いがある。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I know you have reason to doubt me.

vocabulary.english_definition: Engage or hire for work
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 仕事のために雇用するあるいは、借りる。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I will employ the girl, because she can speak French.

vocabulary.english_definition: Extend in scope or range or area
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 範囲、幅または領域が広がる。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I want to extend my stay here for a few more days.

vocabulary.english_definition: To cause to do through pressure or necessity, by physical, moral or intellectual means :"She forced him to take a job in the city"
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 圧力または必要性を通じてさせることで、身体的、道徳的、または、知的な手段によって行う：。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I could force you to do that, but I won't.

vocabulary.english_definition: Assemble or get together
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 集まるか、集合する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We need to gather everyone together.

vocabulary.english_definition: Heal or recover
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 癒す、または回復する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: What should I do to heal my broken leg?

vocabulary.english_definition: Have as a necessary feature
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 必要な特徴として有する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We need to involve the family in this decision.

vocabulary.english_definition: to cause a living thing to die
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 生き物の命を奪うこと。植物や細菌にも使う。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Too much water can kill some indoor plants.

vocabulary.english_definition: Workplace for the teaching or practice of an art
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 技芸を教えたり練習したりする場所。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I found you a studio.

vocabulary.english_definition: A residential district located on the outskirts of a city
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 都市のはずれにある住宅地。
vocabulary.example_sentence: He lives in a suburb, in a quiet suburb.

vocabulary.english_definition: A quantity obtained by the addition of a group of numbers
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 一群の数の加算によって得られる量。
vocabulary.example_sentence: How large a sum did they raise?

vocabulary.english_definition: A meeting of heads of governments
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 政府の首脳たちの会談。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I reached the summit of the mountain in exactly five hours.

vocabulary.japanese_meaning: 周囲の（名詞「周囲の状況・環境」は通常 surroundings）
vocabulary.english_definition: located around a particular place or thing
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 形容詞では「周囲の」。名詞で「周囲の状況・環境」を表す場合は通常 surroundings を使う。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We explored the surrounding countryside during our trip.

vocabulary.english_definition: An arbitrary sign (written or printed) that has acquired a conventional significance
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 慣習的な意味を獲得した任意の（書かれたまたは印刷された）記号。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I give you this ring as a symbol of my love.

vocabulary.english_definition: The posterior part of the body of a vertebrate especially when elongated and extending beyond the trunk or main part of the body
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 特に、胴体または体の中心を超えたところまで延び、広がっているの脊椎動物の体の後部分。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We need to move, I have the police on my tail.

vocabulary.english_definition: Someone whose occupation involves training in a specific technical process
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 特定の技術工程における訓練を伴う職業の人。
vocabulary.example_sentence: What time does the technician arrive?

vocabulary.english_definition: Place of worship consisting of an edifice for the worship of a deity
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 神聖な礼拝のための建築物からなる崇拝の場所。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I don't know what the name of that temple is.

vocabulary.english_definition: (psychology) a state of mental or emotional strain or suspense
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 精神的または感情的な緊張または不安の状態。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You could feel the tension in the air.

vocabulary.english_definition: The geographical area under the jurisdiction of a sovereign state
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 主権国家の管轄下の地理的な領域。
vocabulary.example_sentence: It goes with the territory.

vocabulary.english_definition: The act of moving something from one location to another
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: ある場所から別の場所へ何かを運ぶ行為。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Do you know how to get there by public transportation?

vocabulary.english_definition: A general tendency to change (as of opinion)
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 一般的に変化する傾向の（意見などで）。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I don't think that it's a trend.

vocabulary.english_definition: Characterized by or displaying affirmation or acceptance or certainty etc.
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 肯定、容認、または確信などが特徴の、またはそれらを見せるさま。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I try to be positive all the time.

vocabulary.english_definition: (used especially of persons) of the immediate past
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: （特に人々に使用される）すぐ前の過去の。
vocabulary.example_sentence: What did you like the most about your previous job?

vocabulary.english_definition: Worthy of reliance or trust
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 信頼または信用にふさわしい。
vocabulary.example_sentence: How reliable do you think this information is?

vocabulary.english_definition: Not quite exact or correct
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: あまり正確でないか正しくない。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I was going through a rough time.

vocabulary.english_definition: previously owned or used by someone else
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: ほかの人が以前に使っていた中古の物を表す。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I bought a secondhand bicycle from a friend.

vocabulary.english_definition: Intensely or extremely bad or unpleasant in degree or quality
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 度合いまたは質において、極度にまたは非常に悪いまたは不快な。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I have a severe pain here.

vocabulary.english_definition: Very small
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 非常に小さい。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We are on a small planet with little countries with tiny people.

vocabulary.english_definition: Having great material or monetary value especially for use or exchange
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 特に使用または交換にとって優れた物的価値または金銭的価値を持っているさま。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I am sorry to have taken up your valuable time.

vocabulary.english_definition: Having an abundant supply of money or possessions of value
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: お金あるいは価値のある財産の潤沢な供給があるさま。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I was born into a wealthy family.

vocabulary.english_definition: Serving or used in place of another
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 他の物の代わりとして役立つ、または使用される。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Can you give me another alternative?

vocabulary.english_definition: (sometimes followed by 'of') having or showing knowledge or understanding or realization or perception
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 知識、理解、実感または知覚を持つ、あるいは示す。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I wasn't aware that I had to do that.

vocabulary.english_definition: Most important element
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 最も重要な要素。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Our chief want in life is somebody who shall make us do what we can.

vocabulary.english_definition: Applying to ordinary citizens as contrasted with the military
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 軍隊とは対照的に普通の市民に適用するさま。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I will write him a civil answer.

vocabulary.english_definition: to arrange things or plan an event
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 物事を整理したり、行事を準備したりすること。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We need to organize the school festival together.

vocabulary.english_definition: Establish the validity of something, as by an example, explanation or experiment
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 例、説明または実験によって、何かの妥当性を確立する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I don't know how to prove that I love you.

vocabulary.english_definition: Turn away from; give up
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 拒否する。やめる。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I made up my mind to quit smoking from now on.

vocabulary.english_definition: Refuse entrance or membership
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 入ることまたは一員であることを拒否する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I do not know whether to accept or to refuse.

vocabulary.english_definition: Have confidence or faith in
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 信用、または信頼する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I don't think we should rely on Tom too much.

vocabulary.english_definition: Force, take, or pull apart
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 強制的に分ける、分解する、あるいは引き離す。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I don't want to separate myself from the team.

vocabulary.english_definition: Change from one vehicle or transportation line to another
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: ある乗り物または輸送機関から他の物へ乗り換える。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I haven't got any money on me, but I can transfer.

vocabulary.english_definition: Forsake, leave behind
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 見放す、置き去りにする。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We had to abandon the car.

vocabulary.english_definition: Make publicity for; try to sell (a product)
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 宣伝する。売ろうとする（製品を）。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I think I will advertise in the paper.

vocabulary.english_definition: Move towards
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: そこに向かって動く。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I told him never to approach my son again.

vocabulary.english_definition: to organize and carry out an activity
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 調査や実験などを計画して実行すること。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Our class will conduct a survey about school lunches.

vocabulary.english_definition: Give careful consideration to
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: よく考える、慎重審議する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Please give me a little more time to consider that.

vocabulary.english_definition: Fall or come down violently
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 落ちる、あるいは激しく下降する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: What caused the plane to crash?

vocabulary.english_definition: Trying something to find out about it
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 何かを試みて、そのことに関する情報を得る。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You have 30 days left in your 30-day free trial.

vocabulary.english_definition: An orderly crowd
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 整然とした群衆。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We saw a troop of monkeys moving from tree to tree.

vocabulary.english_definition: A succession of notes forming a distinctive sequence
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 特徴的な配列を形成する音符の継承。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I know the tune, but I don't know the words.

vocabulary.english_definition: An unfortunate person who suffers from some adverse circumstance
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 何らかの不利な状況に悩む不幸な人。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You don't have to be a victim.

vocabulary.english_definition: (virology) ultramicroscopic infectious agent that replicates itself only within cells of living hosts; many are pathogenic; a piece of nucleic acid (DNA or RNA) wrapped in a thin coat of protein
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 生きている宿主の細胞内のみでそれ自身を複製する極微の感染性の病原菌。多くは病原性である。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I think I have a virus on my computer.

vocabulary.english_definition: A listing of the words used in some enterprise
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: ある仕事で使われる単語のリスト。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You can create a vocabulary list to learn new words.

vocabulary.english_definition: The amount of 3-dimensional space occupied by an object
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 物体によって占められている立体空間の量。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Please turn down the volume a little bit more.

vocabulary.english_definition: Something that remunerates
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 報いるもの。
vocabulary.example_sentence: My wife helps me to spend my wage.

vocabulary.english_definition: Annual or biennial grass having erect flower spikes and light brown grains
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 直立する穂状花序と明るい褐色の穀粒を持つ、一年生または二年生の草。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I have not eaten wheat in two months.

vocabulary.english_definition: An injury to living tissue (especially an injury involving a cut or break in the skin)
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 生体組織の損傷（特に皮膚の切り傷、ひび割れなどの怪我）。
vocabulary.example_sentence: My friend died from a wound.

vocabulary.english_definition: Someone from whom you are descended (but usually more remote than a grandparent)
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 自分が系統を引く（通常、祖父母よりも遠い）人。
vocabulary.example_sentence: How do you know your ancestors even lived where you do now?

vocabulary.english_definition: A feeling of craving something
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 何かを切望する気持ち。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I built up an appetite while watching him make dinner.

vocabulary.english_definition: A demonstration of approval by clapping the hands together
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 両手を叩くことによる承認の表明。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I do it for the applause.

vocabulary.english_definition: Difficult to analyze or understand
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 分析または理解が難しい。
vocabulary.example_sentence: My brother could not solve the complicated problem.

vocabulary.japanese_meaning: どちらでも、どちらかの
vocabulary.english_definition: the one or the other of two
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 二つのうちのどちらか、またはどちらでもよいことを表す。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You can use either pen for the test.
vocabulary.raw_japanese_extraction: どちらでも、どちらかの
vocabulary.source_japanese_meaning: どちらでも、どちらかの

vocabulary.english_definition: (of flora or fauna) in imminent danger of extinction
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: （植物相または動物相について）絶滅の差し迫った危険な状態である。
vocabulary.example_sentence: What makes you think that your language is endangered?
vocabulary.raw_japanese_extraction: かの 絶滅の危機にある
vocabulary.source_japanese_meaning: かの 絶滅の危機にある

vocabulary.english_definition: Of the greatest possible degree or extent or intensity
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 可能な限りの程度、範囲、強度の。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I hear you've done some pretty extreme stuff.

vocabulary.english_definition: Involving financial matters
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 財政問題にかかわるさま。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I am once again asking for your financial support.

vocabulary.english_definition: Easily agitated
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 興奮しやすい。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I didn't know that you were going to be nervous.

vocabulary.english_definition: Not commercially motivated
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 商業的に動機づけられない。
vocabulary.example_sentence: My nonprofit has a hands on approach to problem solving.

vocabulary.english_definition: Moving or facing away from each other
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: お互いから避け、離れる。
vocabulary.example_sentence: What they told you is the opposite of what they told me yesterday.

vocabulary.english_definition: In the recent past
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 最近において。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I get the feeling I'm sleeping too much recently.

vocabulary.english_definition: Used to imply that one would expect the fact to be the opposite of that stated; surprisingly
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 人が述べられた事実に対してその正反対であると予想するのを含意するために用いられる。意外にも。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Do you have any idea who actually wrote this letter?

vocabulary.english_definition: In addition
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 加えて。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I woke up next to an unknown girl again. Moreover, she isn't ugly at all this time.

vocabulary.english_definition: To some (great or small) extent
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: ある（多い、または、少ない）程度において。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I don't feel good or rather, I feel terrible.

vocabulary.english_definition: By bad luck
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: あいにく。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I would like to be there, but unfortunately I cannot.

vocabulary.english_definition: Be on the defensive; act against an attack
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 守勢に立っている。攻撃に対する行為。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I looked for something I could use to defend myself.

vocabulary.english_definition: Separate into parts or portions
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 部分や部分に分かれる。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I thought you were going to divide up work.

vocabulary.english_definition: Run away from confinement
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 監禁から逃げる。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You won't be able to escape from this prison.

vocabulary.english_definition: Observe, check out, and look over carefully or inspect
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 観察、確かめる、入念に調べるまたは検査する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I want to examine you again tomorrow.

vocabulary.english_definition: Exchange or replace with another, usually of the same kind or category
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 別のものと交換する、取り替える、通常同じ種類またはカテゴリーのものと。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Could you please exchange some small change with me?

vocabulary.english_definition: Bring into existence
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 生まれ出る。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We're trying to generate business.

vocabulary.english_definition: Fix or set securely or deeply
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 確実に、または、深く固定するあるいは設置する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Tom is considering a tooth implant after losing one of his front teeth in an accident.

vocabulary.english_definition: Put together out of artificial or natural components or parts
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 人工または自然の構成要素あるいは部品から組立てられる。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We don't manufacture anything any more.

vocabulary.english_definition: Make believe with the intent to deceive
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: だます意図でふりをする。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You don't need to pretend that you still like me.

vocabulary.english_definition: Let for money
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 金のために貸す。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We want to rent an apartment in the city.

vocabulary.english_definition: Express the need or desire for; ask for
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 必要性かは欲求を表わす。要求する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I have a serious request to make of you.

vocabulary.english_definition: Return to life; get or give new life or energy
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 生き返る。新しい生命またはエネルギーを得るか、与える。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Do you know an artist who can restore this old picture for me?

vocabulary.japanese_meaning: 生き残る、存在し続ける
vocabulary.english_definition: Continue to live through hardship or adversity
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 苦難または逆境を通して生き続ける。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We can survive without food... just not for too long.
vocabulary.raw_japanese_extraction: 生き残る、存在し続ける
vocabulary.source_japanese_meaning: 生き残る、存在し続ける

vocabulary.english_definition: An itemized statement of money owed for goods shipped or services rendered
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 商品またはサービスに対して支払いの義務があるお金の明細書。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I don't think I have enough money to pay the bill.

vocabulary.english_definition: A document attesting to the truth of certain stated facts
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 述べられている事実が真実であることを証明する文書。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I wonder where I can use this gift certificate.

vocabulary.english_definition: An assembly (including one or more judges) to conduct judicial business
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 司法業務を行うための集まり（1人以上の裁判官を含む）。
vocabulary.example_sentence: My friends stood by me during the court case.

vocabulary.english_definition: The metal or paper medium of exchange that is presently used
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 現在使われている金属ないしは紙でできた交換媒介物。
vocabulary.example_sentence: What is the currency of your country?

vocabulary.english_definition: A concise explanation of the meaning of a word or phrase or symbol
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 単語、句、記号の意味の簡潔な説明。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You can see that definition here, under sense three.

vocabulary.english_definition: A discrimination between things as different and distinct
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 異なって違ったものとしての、物事の間の区別。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I can make a distinction between good and bad.

vocabulary.english_definition: Players buy (or are given) chances and prizes are distributed by casting lots
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: プレーヤーは、チャンスを買い（または与えられ）、賞は、くじを引いて分配される。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I finally finished a drawing that I started about a month ago.

vocabulary.english_definition: A violent release of energy caused by a chemical or nuclear reaction
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 化学や核反応によるエネルギーの激しい放出。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I want to know what caused the explosion.

vocabulary.english_definition: An erroneous mental representation
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 誤った心的表象。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I think it's an illusion.

vocabulary.english_definition: Something that results
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 結果として生じる何か。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I am not planning to tell you the outcome at all.

vocabulary.english_definition: A person who travels by foot
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 徒歩で旅行する人。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I try to use the pedestrian bridge in order to exercise.

vocabulary.english_definition: A distinctive odor that is pleasant
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: はっきりとした快いにおい。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I decided not to buy the perfume anymore.

vocabulary.english_definition: A basic generalization that is accepted as true and that can be used as a basis for reasoning or conduct
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 真実であると受け入れられ、理論や行動の基本とすることができる、基礎的な概念。
vocabulary.example_sentence: What is the principle reason for going to school?

vocabulary.english_definition: Advancing in amount or intensity
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 量または強さが進歩すること。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I increasingly need your help.

vocabulary.english_definition: With sincerity; without pretense
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 誠実さをもって。見せかけなしで。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I sincerely hope that never happens to him.

vocabulary.english_definition: After an unspecified period of time or an especially long delay
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 不特定の期間か特に長い遅れの後に。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I think we're going to eventually have to do that.

vocabulary.english_definition: Indicating exactness or preciseness
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 正確さまたは精密度を示すこと。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You are doing exactly what they want you to do.

vocabulary.english_definition: (of actions or states) slightly short of or not quite accomplished; all but
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: （行動または状態について）少し足りない、または、完全に終わっていない。ほとんど。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I was nearly run over by a car.

vocabulary.english_definition: For the most part
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 大部分。
vocabulary.example_sentence: My success was mainly due to your help.

vocabulary.english_definition: And nothing more
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: そして、多くは何もない。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I asked him several times, but he simply didn't reply.

vocabulary.english_definition: In truth (often tends to intensify)
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 実は（しばしば強調につながる）。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You believe he is a good doctor, and he is indeed.

vocabulary.english_definition: With rapid movements
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 急速な動きで。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I learn new ideas rapidly.

vocabulary.english_definition: To a distinctly greater extent or degree than is common
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 通常よりも目立って大きな程度にまたは範囲に。
vocabulary.example_sentence: My wife makes me happy, especially when she isn't home.

vocabulary.english_definition: To or at a greater extent or degree or a more advanced stage ('further' is used more often than 'farther' in this abstract sense)
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: より大きな程度までに、またはより進んだ段階までに。
vocabulary.example_sentence: How about we discuss this situation further tomorrow morning, if you like?

vocabulary.english_definition: Almost not
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: ほとんどない。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I don't like fish very much and hardly ever eat it.

vocabulary.english_definition: Despite anything to the contrary (usually following a concession)
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: それと反対（通常、譲歩に続く）な何にもかかわらずでも。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I slept for ten hours, nevertheless I'm still tired.

vocabulary.english_definition: Disturb the balance or stability of
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: バランスまたは安定性を妨げる。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I hope I didn't do anything to upset you.

vocabulary.english_definition: Alter or regulate so as to achieve accuracy or conform to a standard
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 正確性を得るため、または基準に従うため変える、あるいは調節する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Please adjust the seat to fit you.

vocabulary.english_definition: Consider in detail and subject to an analysis in order to discover essential features or meaning
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 本質的な特徴か意味を発見するために、詳細に検討し分析する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I want you to analyze this.

vocabulary.english_definition: Put into a proper or systematic order
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 適切な、または規則正しい順番に並べる。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I want you to arrange a meeting.

vocabulary.english_definition: Give help or assistance; be of service
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 助けたり援助する。役立つ。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I wonder if you can assist me.

vocabulary.english_definition: Prohibit especially by legal means or social pressure
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 特に法的手段または社会的圧力によって禁止する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I have good reason to ban him from using the computer.

vocabulary.english_definition: Put up with something or somebody unpleasant
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 不快な何かまたは誰かを我慢する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I don't think I can bear this pain much longer.

vocabulary.english_definition: Make a mathematical calculation or computation
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 数学的演算や計算をする。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I must calculate how much money I'll spend next week.

vocabulary.english_definition: Hold back, as of a danger or an enemy; check the expansion or influence of
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 制止する、の危険のようなあるいは敵のように。それの拡張または影響を確認する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I decided to go back to check whether I'd locked the door.

vocabulary.english_definition: Make by combining materials and parts
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 材料および部品を合成して作る。
vocabulary.example_sentence: After reading his books I feel I can construct a house.

vocabulary.english_definition: Work together on a common enterprise of project
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 計画の共同作業を一緒にする。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We are working hard to cooperate more.

vocabulary.japanese_meaning: 次第である、当てにする
vocabulary.english_definition: Be contingent upon (something that is elided)
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: （削除されたもの）次第である。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I need to know that I can depend on you.
vocabulary.raw_japanese_extraction: 次第である、当てにする
vocabulary.source_japanese_meaning: 次第である、当てにする

vocabulary.english_definition: Discover or determine the existence, presence, or fact of
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 生存、存在または、の事実を発見するまたは断定する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Our eyes can detect light.

vocabulary.english_definition: An unvarying or habitual method or procedure
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 変わらないか習慣的方法または手順。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You have a routine on Monday, don't you?

vocabulary.english_definition: Gossip (usually a mixture of truth and untruth) passed around by word of mouth
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: （通例真実とうそを取り混ぜた）ゴシップが口コミで広まっていくこと。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I know better than to be believe such a rumor.

vocabulary.english_definition: A specific form of evildoing
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 悪行の特定の形式。
vocabulary.example_sentence: He would leave the job to his vice president.

vocabulary.english_definition: An energetic style
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 活力にあふれた態度。
vocabulary.example_sentence: My brother had a great deal of vitality for his age.

vocabulary.english_definition: Someone who pays for goods or services
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 商品やサービスにお金を払う人。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I hope that we don't lose you as a customer.

vocabulary.english_definition: A physical phenomenon associated with stationary or moving electrons and protons
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 静止したあるいは動いている電子と陽子に関連した物理的現象。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You didn't forget to pay the electricity bill, did you?

vocabulary.english_definition: A piece of information about circumstances that exist or events that have occurred
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 実存する状況、または発生した出来事についての情報。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You must state the fact as it is.

vocabulary.english_definition: The totality of surrounding conditions
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 総体的な周囲の状況。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We do not respect the environment as much as we should.

vocabulary.english_definition: A quantity of money
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 貨幣量。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I don't know how to pay you this amount of money.

vocabulary.english_definition: space available for someone or something
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 人や物を入れられる空間や余裕。この意味では不可算名詞。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Is there room in your bag for this book?

vocabulary.english_definition: an explanation or set of ideas about how something works
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 物事の仕組みを説明する考え方や理論。科学では証拠に支えられた体系的な説明。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We discussed a theory about how children learn languages.

vocabulary.english_definition: A search for knowledge
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 知識を得るための調査。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Our company wants to take part in that research project.

vocabulary.english_definition: A phenomenon that follows and is caused by some previous phenomenon
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: ある先行する現象に続く現象、またはある先行する現象を原因とする現象。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Can you tell me when I can have the results of the test?

vocabulary.english_definition: By chance
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 偶然に。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I thought perhaps no one else would agree with me.

vocabulary.english_definition: With considerable certainty; without much doubt
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: かなりの確信を持って。あまり疑いなく。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We probably won't be able to move this without some help.

vocabulary.english_definition: although; despite the fact that
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 「〜だけれども」と、予想と違う事実をつなぐ。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Though it was raining, we still enjoyed the trip.

vocabulary.english_definition: during the time that; in contrast with
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 「〜している間に」や「一方で」を表す接続詞。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I listened to music while I cleaned my room.

vocabulary.english_definition: except if
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 「もし〜でなければ」を表す。if ... not に近い意味。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We will play outside unless it rains.

vocabulary.english_definition: every time that; at any time that
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 「〜するときはいつでも」「〜するたびに」を表す。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You can ask me whenever you need help.

vocabulary.english_definition: on the condition that
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: provided that で「〜という条件で」。条件を示すやや硬い表現。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You can borrow my bike provided you return it today.

vocabulary.english_definition: in or to any place that
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 「〜する所ならどこでも」を表す。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You can sit wherever you feel comfortable.

vocabulary.english_definition: used to show a contrast between two facts
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 二つの事実を「一方では」と対比する接続詞。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I prefer tea, whereas my brother likes coffee.

vocabulary.english_definition: during the whole of a period; in every part of a place
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: ある期間の最初から最後まで、または場所の全体にわたること。
vocabulary.example_sentence: The library is open throughout the summer vacation.

vocabulary.english_definition: about or relating to
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 「〜について」「〜に関して」を表すやや硬い前置詞。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I have a question concerning tomorrow's meeting.

vocabulary.english_definition: without being prevented by something
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 「〜にもかかわらず」を表す。後ろは名詞や動名詞。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We enjoyed our walk despite the cold weather.

vocabulary.english_definition: (medicine) any sensation or change in bodily function that is experienced by a patient and is associated with a particular disease
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 患者により経験され、特定の疾患に関連する身体の機能における感覚または変化。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Do you have this symptom often?

vocabulary.english_definition: Fix in scope; fix the boundaries of
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 範囲において確定する。境界を決定する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We should determine what is to be done first.

vocabulary.english_definition: To show, make visible or apparent
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 見せるために、可視化する、またはか明らかにする。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You all display similar behavior.

vocabulary.english_definition: Institute, enact, or establish
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 設ける、制定するあるいは設立する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I will establish myself as a lawyer.

vocabulary.english_definition: Extend in one or more directions
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 1つまたはそれ以上の方向に伸ばす。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Our company wants to expand into a new market.
vocabulary.raw_japanese_extraction: る拡大する、膨張させる
vocabulary.source_japanese_meaning: る拡大する、膨張させる

vocabulary.english_definition: Make full, also in a metaphorical sense
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 比喩的な感覚においても、いっぱいにする。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I am going to fill you up so full.

vocabulary.english_definition: Predict in advance
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 前もって予言する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Do you know what the weather forecast is for tomorrow?

vocabulary.english_definition: Change to ice
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 氷への変化。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Please freeze the fish and meat.

vocabulary.english_definition: Prevent from being seen or discovered
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 見られる、または発見されるのを防ぐ。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We need to find a place to hide this money.

vocabulary.english_definition: Come up with (an idea, plan, explanation, theory, or principle) after a mental effort
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 思考錯誤の後で思いつく（考え、計画、説明理論または主義）。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We should invent a secret language.

vocabulary.english_definition: to kill a person intentionally and unlawfully
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 故意に違法に人の命を奪うことを表す動詞。
vocabulary.example_sentence: In the story, the detective discovers who murdered the victim.

vocabulary.japanese_meaning: に注意する、書き留める
vocabulary.english_definition: Observe with care or pay close attention to
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 慎重に観測するか、または細心の注意を払う。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Please note that the price is subject to change.
vocabulary.raw_japanese_extraction: に注意する、書き留める
vocabulary.source_japanese_meaning: に注意する、書き留める

vocabulary.english_definition: Share in something
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 何かにおいて共有する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I hope you will participate in many of them.

vocabulary.english_definition: Make impure
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 不潔にする。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We ought to do our best not to pollute our environment.

vocabulary.english_definition: A worker who is hired to perform a job
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 仕事をするために雇われた労働者。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I am an employee at a company.

vocabulary.english_definition: The piece of land on which something is located (or is to be located)
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 何かがある（予定の）土地の区画。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I just started using this site a little while ago.

vocabulary.english_definition: The aggregation of things (pedestrians or vehicles) coming and going in a particular locality during a specified period of time
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: ある特殊の時間内に特殊の場所で物が行き来する寄り合い状態。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We made good time since the traffic was light.

vocabulary.english_definition: How a result is obtained or an end is achieved
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: いかにして、ある結果が得られたり、ある目的が達成されたりするかということ。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I can't tell you how much this means to me.

vocabulary.english_definition: Logical or comprehensible arrangement of separate elements
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: グループの個々の要素を論理的にわかりやすくい配列したもの。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We received the order yesterday, but haven't filled it yet.

vocabulary.english_definition: An activity or gift that benefits the public at large
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 社会全般のためになる活動もしくは贈り物。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I got these shoes from a charity shop for £2.

vocabulary.english_definition: Something that aids or promotes well-being
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 幸福を助け、推進する何か。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I want to give you the benefit of the doubt.

vocabulary.english_definition: A medical establishment run by a group of medical specialists
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 医療専門家のグループによって運営される医療機関。
vocabulary.example_sentence: How often do you go to a hospital or a clinic?

vocabulary.english_definition: A person with special knowledge or ability who performs skillfully
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 特別な知識や能力を持ち、巧みに遂行する人。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I don't need to be an expert. I just know.

vocabulary.english_definition: a planned piece of work with a particular purpose
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 目的を達成するために計画して進める仕事や課題。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Our class is working on a project about recycling.

vocabulary.english_definition: A way of doing something, especially a systematic way; implies an orderly logical arrangement (usually in steps)
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 何かを行う方法、特に体系的なもの。秩序だって理論的な（通常、段階を進んでいく）方法を意味する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I can say from experience that this method works.

vocabulary.english_definition: An instrumentality needed for an undertaking or to perform a service
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 課題あるいはサービスを実行するのに必要な物。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We had a little trouble with the equipment yesterday.

vocabulary.english_definition: A plan of action adopted by an individual or social group
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 個人あるいは社会的グループによって採用されている計画あるいは活動。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I think we need to change our policy on that.

vocabulary.english_definition: Involving only main features
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 主要な特徴だけを伴うさま。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I think that overall we're in good shape.

vocabulary.english_definition: In accordance with fixed order or procedure or principle
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 一定の命令または手順または原則に従って。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I don't have a regular job.

vocabulary.english_definition: Living in or characteristic of farming or country life
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 農業や田園の生活を送る、またはそれらに特有の。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You will soon be used to rural life.

vocabulary.english_definition: Concerned with work or important matters rather than play or trivialities
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 遊びまたはつまらないことよりも仕事または重要な事柄に関心のある。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You don't seem to realize how serious this is.

vocabulary.english_definition: Happening without warning or in a short space of time
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 何の前触れもなく、または短い時間に起こるさま。
vocabulary.example_sentence: What made you change your mind all of a sudden?

vocabulary.english_definition: Meant or adapted for an occasion or use
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 出来事または使用が意味される、または構成される。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Can you find suitable time for our meeting?

vocabulary.english_definition: Exhibiting the qualities or characteristics that identify a group or kind or category
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: グループまたは種類またはカテゴリーを確認する特性または特徴を示すさま。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I find that it's typical for him to come too late.

vocabulary.english_definition: having a particular value or being useful enough
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 価値があること。worth doing で「〜する価値がある」。
vocabulary.example_sentence: This museum is definitely worth a visit.

vocabulary.english_definition: Suitable for a particular person or place or condition etc
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 特定の人か場所、条件などにふさわしい。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We did not think her loud dress was appropriate for the time and place.

vocabulary.english_definition: Typical or distinctive
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 典型的であるか特徴的な。
vocabulary.example_sentence: A green color is a characteristic of that type of apple.

vocabulary.english_definition: Of or relating to the most highly developed stage of an earlier civilisation and its culture
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 早期の文明とその文化で最も高度な発達段階の、または、早期の文明とその文化で最も高度な発達段階に関する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We love classical music the most.

vocabulary.english_definition: Of or relating to commercialism
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 商業主義に関する、またはそれの。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I went to a commercial high school.

vocabulary.english_definition: (of persons or their actions) able or disposed to inflict pain or suffering
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: （人または人の動作について）苦痛や苦しみを与えることのできる。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I think it's cruel to keep a cat inside.

vocabulary.english_definition: Hold back to a later time
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: しばらく隠しておく。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We had to postpone the game because of rain.

vocabulary.english_definition: Express approval of
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 好意的な感情を表す。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You cannot praise a child enough for doing something well.

vocabulary.english_definition: Contribute to the progress or growth of
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 進歩か成長に貢献する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I am not going to promote any religion.

vocabulary.english_definition: Utter words of protest
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 抗議の言葉を吐く。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We have to protest against it.

vocabulary.japanese_meaning: 関連づける、関連がある
vocabulary.english_definition: Be relevant to
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 関連している。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You find it hard to relate to women.
vocabulary.raw_japanese_extraction: 関連づける、関連がある
vocabulary.source_japanese_meaning: 関連づける、関連がある

vocabulary.english_definition: Release, as from one's grip
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 掴んでいるものなどを、解放する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I told him not to release the rope, but he let it go.

vocabulary.english_definition: Free from harm or evil
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 危害または不正から開放する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I hope someone comes to rescue us.

vocabulary.japanese_meaning: 予約する、を取っておく
vocabulary.english_definition: Hold back or set aside, especially for future use or contingency
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 特に将来使うために、または不足の事態に備えて隠しておく、または蓄えておく。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We would like to reserve a table for 6 o'clock.
vocabulary.raw_japanese_extraction: 予約する、を取っておく
vocabulary.source_japanese_meaning: 予約する、を取っておく

vocabulary.english_definition: Flow, run or fall out and become lost
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 流れる、抜け落ちてそしてなくなる。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I am afraid he is going to spill the beans.

vocabulary.english_definition: Treat with excessive indulgence
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 過度の甘さで扱う。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Do you want to spoil the best moment in my life?

vocabulary.english_definition: Stick to firmly
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: しっかり執着。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We three will stick together.

vocabulary.english_definition: Extend one's limbs or muscles, or the entire body
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 自分の手足または筋肉または体の全体を伸ばす。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We got out of the car to stretch our legs.

vocabulary.japanese_meaning: 成功する、を成し遂げる
vocabulary.english_definition: Attain success or reach a desired goal
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 成功を収めるか、または望んでいる目標に達する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We had expected that you would succeed this time.
vocabulary.raw_japanese_extraction: 成功する、を成し遂げる
vocabulary.source_japanese_meaning: 成功する、を成し遂げる

vocabulary.english_definition: A conveyance that transports people or objects
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 人や物を運ぶ乗物。
vocabulary.example_sentence: How did that vehicle end up here?

vocabulary.english_definition: The essential qualities or characteristics by which something is recognized
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: それによって何かが認められる必須の特性または特徴。
vocabulary.example_sentence: What is the nature of time?

vocabulary.english_definition: A message that is stated or declared; a communication (oral or written) setting forth particulars or facts etc
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 述べられたまたは言い切られたメッセージ。詳細や事実などについて述べる（口頭、または書面の）コミュニケーション。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I don't think that anyone would agree with that statement.

vocabulary.english_definition: An occurrence of something
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 何かの発生。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I thought they were the same, but it looks like that's not the case.

vocabulary.english_definition: The accumulation of knowledge or skill that results from direct participation in events or activities
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 行事や活動に直接かかわることで得た技術や知識の蓄積。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I have some experience in that area as well.

vocabulary.english_definition: A change of position that does not entail a change of location
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 場所の変化を伴わない体勢の変化。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Does he have something in common with this movement?

vocabulary.english_definition: (biology) taxonomic group whose members can interbreed
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 異種交配できる分類群。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I had never before seen this species of fish.

vocabulary.english_definition: The quality of having a superior or more favorable position
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: より優った、あるいはより好ましい位置を保つという特質。
