vocabulary.example_sentence: You have an advantage over him.

vocabulary.english_definition: Food that is discarded (as from a kitchen)
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: （台所などから）捨てられる食べ物。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I saw a man yesterday eating from a garbage can.

vocabulary.english_definition: A decorative or artistic work
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 装飾的芸術的作品。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Do you see a pattern here?

vocabulary.english_definition: The force applied to a unit area of surface; measured in pascals (SI unit) or in dynes (cgs unit)
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 表面の単位面積に働く力。パスカル（国際表示単位）またはダイン（CGS単位）で測定される。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I couldn't handle the pressure anymore and I gave up.

vocabulary.english_definition: Elevation especially above sea level or above the earth's surface
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 特に海水面または地表からの高さ。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I don't feel well at such a high altitude.

vocabulary.english_definition: A specialized division of a large organization
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 大きな組織の専門化された部門。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I got a new hat at the department store.

vocabulary.english_definition: having a disability that may affect everyday activities
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 障害のある状態を表す。施設や社会の対応について話すときにも使う。
vocabulary.example_sentence: The new ramp improves access for disabled visitors.

vocabulary.english_definition: Suitable to or characteristic of drama
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 劇に適した、または劇に特有の。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I think you're being a bit over-dramatic.

vocabulary.english_definition: Using the minimum of time or resources necessary for effectiveness
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 効果を得るために必要な最小限の時間または資源を使用する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Bread with oil is a very healthy and economical food.

vocabulary.english_definition: Extraordinarily large in size or extent or amount or power or degree
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 大きさ、範囲、量、力、または程度が異常に大きい。
vocabulary.example_sentence: The work took an enormous amount of time to finish.

vocabulary.english_definition: Constituting the full quantity or extent; complete
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 全数量か範囲を構成するさま。完全なさま。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I can't pay attention to the entire world at once!

vocabulary.english_definition: Absolutely necessary; vitally necessary
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 絶対に必要なさま。きわめて必要であるさま。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I think that it's absolutely essential.

vocabulary.english_definition: no longer existing as a living species
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: その種の生き物が一頭も残っていないこと。
vocabulary.example_sentence: The dodo became extinct hundreds of years ago.

vocabulary.english_definition: Fraudulent; having a misleading appearance
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: いかさまの。紛らわしい外観をした。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You don't need to be perfect, just don't be fake.

vocabulary.english_definition: Capable of being changed
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 変わることができる。
vocabulary.example_sentence: My body isn't as flexible as it used to be.

vocabulary.english_definition: Not fake or counterfeit
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: まやかしや偽物ではない。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I think William is one of the most genuine people I've ever met.

vocabulary.english_definition: Uneducated in general; lacking knowledge or sophistication
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 一般に無学の。知識あるいは高い教養が不足していること。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I just realized that I'm quite ignorant about the world.

vocabulary.english_definition: Free from external control and constraint
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 外部の支配と制約がない。
vocabulary.example_sentence: How many independent countries are there in the world?

vocabulary.english_definition: Disposed or inclined toward
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 気が向いた、または傾向がある。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I can't pay you. Are you still willing to help?

vocabulary.english_definition: to look at different pages on the internet
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: インターネットのページを次々に見て回ること。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I sometimes surf the internet for new recipe ideas.

vocabulary.english_definition: to occupy someone's attention completely
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: be absorbed in で「〜に夢中になっている」。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I was so absorbed in my book that I missed lunch.

vocabulary.japanese_meaning: 達成する、を成し遂げる
vocabulary.english_definition: To gain with effort
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 努力で得る。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I don't understand what you want to achieve with that.
vocabulary.raw_japanese_extraction: 達成する、を成し遂げる
vocabulary.source_japanese_meaning: 達成する、を成し遂げる

vocabulary.english_definition: Declare to be true or admit the existence or reality or truth of
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 真実であることを宣言するあるいは存在、現実あるいは真実を認める。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I have to admit that he is right.

vocabulary.english_definition: Contribute to the progress or growth of
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 進歩か成長に貢献する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I wanted to advance, but the job really went nowhere.

vocabulary.english_definition: Cause annoyance in; disturb, especially by minor irritations
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 不快感にさせる。特に小さな苛立ちによって、妨げる。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I never allow what can't be changed to annoy me.

vocabulary.english_definition: to ask strongly for help or a decision
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 援助などを強く求めること。appeal to someone for help の形で使う。
vocabulary.example_sentence: The school appealed to parents for help with the event.

vocabulary.english_definition: Make an effort or attempt
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 努力する、または試みる。
vocabulary.example_sentence: What would life be if we had no courage to attempt anything?

vocabulary.english_definition: Give, especially as an honor or reward
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 特に名誉または報酬として、与える。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I would like to thank many people for helping me win this award, but I won't.

vocabulary.english_definition: Broadcast over the airwaves, as in radio or television
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 放送波に乗せて放送する、ラジオまたはテレビのように。
vocabulary.example_sentence: What language does this radio station broadcast in?

vocabulary.english_definition: Postpone indefinitely or annul something that was scheduled
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 予定されていたものを、無期限に延期する、または取り消す。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We had to cancel the meeting.

vocabulary.english_definition: Put or add together
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: まとめる、あるいは足し合わせる。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I know a lot of French words, but it's difficult for me to combine them into sentences.

vocabulary.japanese_meaning: (芸術・音楽など)を創作する
vocabulary.english_definition: Produce a literary work
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 文学作品を作り出す。
vocabulary.example_sentence: He took a moment to compose himself.
vocabulary.raw_japanese_extraction: (芸術・音楽など)を創作する
vocabulary.source_japanese_meaning: (芸術・音楽など)を創作する

vocabulary.english_definition: Writing that provides information (especially information of an official nature)
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 情報を提供する文書（特に公式自然の情報）。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Please send this document before the end of the month.

vocabulary.english_definition: A phenomenon that follows and is caused by some previous phenomenon
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: ある先行する現象に続く現象、またはある先行する現象を原因とする現象。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We were all surprised at the effect the news had on him.

vocabulary.english_definition: A distinct part that can be specified separately in a group of things that could be enumerated on a list
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: リスト上で列挙される物も集団で別々に特定できる独立した部分。
vocabulary.example_sentence: How long have you and your girlfriend been an item?

vocabulary.english_definition: The number of inhabitants (either the total number or the number of a particular race or class) in a given place (country or city etc.)
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: ある土地（国または町など）の住人（総計または特定の民族、階級の数）の数。
vocabulary.example_sentence: How large is the population of this city?

vocabulary.english_definition: The particular portion of space occupied by something
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: ある物質によって占められている空間的な部分。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Do you think he is good for the position?

vocabulary.english_definition: (criminal law) an act punishable by law; usually considered an evil act
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 法律で罰せられる行為。通常悪い行為と見なされる。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I just said what I thought. Is that a crime?

vocabulary.english_definition: An isolated fact that is considered separately from the whole
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 全体から分離して考えられる独立した事実。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I guess we should go over the details at some point.

vocabulary.english_definition: The organized action of making of goods and services for sale
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 販売用の商品やサービスを製造、提供する組織的な活動。
vocabulary.example_sentence: What do you like the most and least about working in this industry?

vocabulary.english_definition: Someone who lives at a particular place for a prolonged period or who was born there
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 長い期間特定の場所に、または生まれた場所に住んでいる人。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I'm a resident of Boston.

vocabulary.english_definition: The outer boundary of an artifact or a material layer constituting or resembling such a boundary
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 物体の外側の境界、または境界となるあるいはそれに似た物質の層。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I saw several fish swimming near the surface of the water.

vocabulary.english_definition: A doctor who practices veterinary medicine
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 家畜診療を行う医師。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We had to go to the veterinarian with our dog.

vocabulary.english_definition: (microbiology) single-celled or noncellular spherical or spiral or rod-shaped organisms lacking chlorophyll that reproduce by fission; important as pathogens and for biochemical properties; taxonomy is difficult; often considered to be plants
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 核分裂により生産される葉緑素のない単細胞、非細胞球形、渦巻き状の、あるいは棒状の有機体。病原菌として、および生化学の特性のために重要である。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You must make the bacteria inside you happy.

vocabulary.english_definition: The act of working out the form of something (as by making a sketch or outline or plan)
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: （たとえばスケッチや略図を描いたり、プランを立てたりすることによって）何かの形を案出する行為。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I like this design more than the other one.

vocabulary.english_definition: Impossible or nearly impossible to see; imperceptible by the eye
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 見ることが不可能、またはほぼ不可能。目で感知できない。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I am an invisible man.

vocabulary.english_definition: Having reached full natural growth or development
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 完全な自然の成長または発達に達したさま。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I think our son is mature enough to understand it.

vocabulary.english_definition: Of or relating to the study of the principles of warfare
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 戦争の原則の研究の、または、戦争の原則の研究に関する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I cannot train with the military.

vocabulary.english_definition: The least possible
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 最も可能性の低い。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I can barely pay the minimum every month.

vocabulary.english_definition: Being within reasonable or average limits; not excessive or extreme
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 妥当な、または標準的な範囲内にある。過剰でないか極端でない。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I thought you were a moderate.

vocabulary.english_definition: Having an import not apparent to the senses nor obvious to the intelligence; beyond ordinary understanding
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 感覚または知性に明確でない意味を持つ。普通の理解を越えて。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I have never seen such a mysterious book.

vocabulary.english_definition: Existing in possibility
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 可能性の中で存在する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I think that there's some real potential here.

vocabulary.english_definition: Estimated by comparison; not absolute or complete
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 比較により査定される。絶対でないか完全でない。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I have a relative who lives around here.

vocabulary.english_definition: Serving to represent or typify
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 代表する、または典型となる。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I am the legal representative for the company.

vocabulary.english_definition: continuing for or considering a short period
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 短い期間に限られることや、短期的な視点を表す。
vocabulary.example_sentence: This is only a short-term solution to the problem.

vocabulary.english_definition: Important in effect or meaning
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 影響あるいは意味において重要な。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I desire to make a significant change in my life.

vocabulary.japanese_meaning: ストレスの原因となる
vocabulary.english_definition: Extremely irritating to the nerves
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 非常に神経に障る。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We have a stressful day ahead of us.
vocabulary.raw_japanese_extraction: ストレスの原因となる
vocabulary.source_japanese_meaning: ストレスの原因となる

vocabulary.english_definition: having length, width, and height
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 長さ・幅・高さがある立体的なこと。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We made a three-dimensional model of our classroom.

vocabulary.english_definition: Assemble without order or sense
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 順序または分別なく集まる。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I want to be understood. I don't want to confuse anyone.

vocabulary.english_definition: to be made up of particular things
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: consist of で、何から構成されているかを表す。
vocabulary.example_sentence: The course consists of ten weekly lessons.

vocabulary.english_definition: Change from one system to another or to a new plan or policy
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: あるシステムからもう一つのまたは新らしい計画または制作へ変化する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: My parents tried to convert me to their way of thinking.

vocabulary.english_definition: Argue with one another
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: お互いに議論する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We will debate this subject at the meeting.

vocabulary.japanese_meaning: 衰える、傾く、丁重に断る
vocabulary.english_definition: Grow smaller
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 小さくなる。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I intend to decline his offer to help me.
vocabulary.raw_japanese_extraction: 衰える、傾く、丁重に断る
vocabulary.source_japanese_meaning: 衰える、傾く、丁重に断る

vocabulary.japanese_meaning: に断る 失望させる、がっかりする
vocabulary.english_definition: Fail to meet the hopes or expectations of
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 希望または期待に添うことができない。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I hope you're not going to disappoint me.
vocabulary.raw_japanese_extraction: に断る 失望させる、がっかりする
vocabulary.source_japanese_meaning: に断る 失望させる、がっかりする

vocabulary.japanese_meaning: りする迷惑をかける、邪魔をする
vocabulary.english_definition: Destroy the peace or tranquility of
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 平和または静けさを破壊する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Please don't disturb me while I'm reading.
vocabulary.raw_japanese_extraction: りする迷惑をかける、邪魔をする
vocabulary.source_japanese_meaning: りする迷惑をかける、邪魔をする

vocabulary.japanese_meaning: をするもてなす、楽しませる
vocabulary.english_definition: Provide entertainment for
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: エンターテイメントを提供する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I need to entertain myself with something.
vocabulary.raw_japanese_extraction: をするもてなす、楽しませる
vocabulary.source_japanese_meaning: をするもてなす、楽しませる

vocabulary.english_definition: Judge tentatively or form an estimate of (quantities or time)
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: とりあえず判断するまたは、の予想を立てる（量または時間）。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I estimate that the work will cost more than $10,000.

vocabulary.english_definition: Give expression to
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 表現をする。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I can't find the word to express what I feel.

vocabulary.english_definition: Be in motion due to some air or water current
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 微風または水流によって動いている。

vocabulary.english_definition: In a gentle manner
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 柔らかい態度で。
vocabulary.example_sentence: He loves to touch his wife gently.

vocabulary.english_definition: In a gradual manner
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 段階的な方法で。
vocabulary.example_sentence: My father is gradually getting better.

vocabulary.english_definition: During the intervening time
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 介在する時間内で。
vocabulary.example_sentence: What will you do meanwhile?

vocabulary.english_definition: if not; in a different way
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 「そうでなければ」や「それ以外の点では」を表す。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Let's leave now. Otherwise, we will miss the train.

vocabulary.english_definition: In a polite manner
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 丁寧な物腰で。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You should have talked more politely.

vocabulary.english_definition: In the right manner
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 正しい方法で。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I can't hear you properly. Please speak more slowly.

vocabulary.japanese_meaning: それに応じて、したがって
vocabulary.english_definition: (sentence connectors) because of the reason given
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: あげられた理由のため。
vocabulary.example_sentence: While I understand what you are saying, I cannot do accordingly.
vocabulary.raw_japanese_extraction: それに応じて、したがって
vocabulary.source_japanese_meaning: それに応じて、したがって

vocabulary.english_definition: In a mechanical manner; by a mechanism
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 機械的な方法で。メカニズムで。
vocabulary.example_sentence: When you open the door, the light comes on automatically.

vocabulary.english_definition: To a severe or serious degree
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 深刻でまたは重大な程度に。
vocabulary.example_sentence: How badly do they want it?

vocabulary.english_definition: Without question and beyond doubt
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 確かにそして紛れもなく。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You should definitely ask him out.

vocabulary.english_definition: To the same degree (often followed by 'as')
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 同じ程度に。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We tried to share the little there was as equally as possible.

vocabulary.japanese_meaning: 感謝する、正しく評価する
vocabulary.english_definition: Recognize with gratitude; be grateful for
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 感謝を表彰する。感謝する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I would appreciate any information you can send to us.
vocabulary.raw_japanese_extraction: 感謝する、正しく評価する
vocabulary.source_japanese_meaning: 感謝する、正しく評価する

vocabulary.japanese_meaning: 価する割り当てる、配属する
vocabulary.english_definition: Give an assignment to (a person) to a post, or assign a task to (a person)
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: （人）を職に配置する、あるいは（人）に仕事を割り当てる。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I don't know if the teacher plans to assign homework.
vocabulary.raw_japanese_extraction: 価する割り当てる、配属する
vocabulary.source_japanese_meaning: 価する割り当てる、配属する

vocabulary.japanese_meaning: 振る舞う、行儀よくする
vocabulary.english_definition: Behave in a certain manner; show a certain behavior; conduct or comport oneself
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 特定の方法で振る舞う。特定の振舞いを示す。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I don't need you telling me how to behave.
vocabulary.raw_japanese_extraction: る振る舞う、行儀よくする
vocabulary.source_japanese_meaning: る振る舞う、行儀よくする

vocabulary.english_definition: Cause to be bored
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 退屈させる。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I could go on, but I don't want to bore you.

vocabulary.english_definition: Force out or release suddenly and often violently something pent up
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 突然にそして抑圧された何かをしばしば激しく強制的に外に出す、あるいは放出する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I want to burst into tears.

vocabulary.english_definition: Go after with the intent to catch
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 捕らえる目的で追いかける。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We knew that the dog would chase the cat.

vocabulary.english_definition: Break down, literally or metaphorically
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 文字通り、または、比喩的に壊れる。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I feel like I'm about to collapse.

vocabulary.english_definition: Perform an act, usually with a negative connotation
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 通常否定的な意味合いで、行為を行う。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You don't need to commit right now.

vocabulary.japanese_meaning: わせる競争する、匹敵する
vocabulary.english_definition: Compete for something; engage in a contest; measure oneself against others
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 何かのために競う。競技に参加する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We used to compete against each other in college.
vocabulary.raw_japanese_extraction: わせる競争する、匹敵する
vocabulary.source_japanese_meaning: わせる競争する、匹敵する

vocabulary.english_definition: Decide by reasoning; draw or come to a conclusion
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 推論によって決定する。結論を引き出す、または結論にたどり着く。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I had to conclude he was right.

vocabulary.english_definition: Establish or strengthen as with new evidence or facts
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 新しい証拠または事実などで立証する、または補強する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Could you please confirm that for me in writing?

vocabulary.japanese_meaning: 契約する、 (協定等を)結ぶ
vocabulary.english_definition: Reduce in scope while retaining essential elements
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 必須の要素を保持している間、範囲が減少する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We would like to sign another contract with you.
vocabulary.raw_japanese_extraction: 契約する、 (協定等を)結ぶ
vocabulary.source_japanese_meaning: 契約する、 (協定等を)結ぶ

vocabulary.japanese_meaning: )結ぶ一因となる、寄付(貢献)する
vocabulary.english_definition: Contribute to some cause
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 何かの原因に貢献する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I just wish I could contribute more money.
vocabulary.raw_japanese_extraction: )結ぶ一因となる、寄付(貢献)する
vocabulary.source_japanese_meaning: )結ぶ一因となる、寄付(貢献)する

vocabulary.english_definition: A distant region
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 遠くの場所。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We could see the lights of the town in the distance.

vocabulary.english_definition: The system of production and distribution and consumption
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 生産、流通、消費の制度。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I can't afford much because of the economy we are in.

vocabulary.english_definition: Earnest and conscientious activity intended to do or accomplish something
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 何かをしよう、または達成しようとするまじめで良心的な行動。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Do you think reading this book is worth the effort?

vocabulary.english_definition: Motor that converts thermal energy to mechanical work
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 熱のエネルギーを機械的な仕事に変換するモータ。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I got back in my car and started the engine.

vocabulary.english_definition: A process in which something passes by degrees to a different stage (especially a more advanced or mature stage)
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: ある物が異なる段階（特により発達した、または成熟した段階）に次第に移行する過程。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Do you believe in evolution?

vocabulary.english_definition: (medicine) something that treats or prevents or alleviates the symptoms of disease
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 病気の症状を治療する、予防する、または緩和する物。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I don't feel well. Could you give me some medicine?

vocabulary.english_definition: Approval to do something
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 何かをすることの承認。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You are not to leave this room without my permission.

vocabulary.english_definition: Something left after other parts have been taken away
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 他の部分が取り去られた後に残った物。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We took a rest one after the other.

vocabulary.english_definition: Any specific behavior
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 特定の行動。
vocabulary.example_sentence: What activity do you spend most of your time doing?

vocabulary.english_definition: A component that is added to something to improve it
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 何かを改善するためにそれに加えられる要素。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You forgot to put the addition sign here.

vocabulary.english_definition: A complex mental state involving beliefs and feelings and values and dispositions to act in certain ways
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 特定のさまでこうどうするための信条、感情、価値および気質を含む複雑な精神状態。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I hope to improve my attitude to work.

vocabulary.english_definition: A statistic describing the location of a distribution
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 分布の位置を表す統計値。
vocabulary.example_sentence: What is the value of an average home in your area?

vocabulary.english_definition: A cultivated plant that is grown commercially on a large scale
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 大規模に営利目的で成育される栽培植物。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We are the cream of the crop!

vocabulary.japanese_meaning: まあまあ、かなり、公正に
vocabulary.english_definition: To a moderately sufficient extent or degree
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 適度に十分な範囲、または程度。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I could do that fairly well when I was younger.
vocabulary.raw_japanese_extraction: まあまあ、かなり、公正に
vocabulary.source_japanese_meaning: まあまあ、かなり、公正に

vocabulary.english_definition: In the recent past
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 最近において。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I haven't been feeling well lately.

vocabulary.english_definition: In your mind
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 心の中。
vocabulary.example_sentence: How does a mentally ill person get that kind of job?

vocabulary.english_definition: In large part; mainly or chiefly
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 大部分において。主に、または大方。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I mostly do not want to think about anything anymore.

vocabulary.english_definition: Now and then or here and there
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 時々、あちこち。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We will visit you occasionally.

vocabulary.english_definition: By chance
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 偶然に。
vocabulary.example_sentence: What can we possibly give them?

vocabulary.english_definition: Indicating exactness or preciseness
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 正確さまたは精密度を示すこと。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I can't understand what precisely she wants.

vocabulary.english_definition: In a stringent manner
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 厳格に。
vocabulary.example_sentence: What I'm about to say is strictly between you and me.

vocabulary.japanese_meaning: したがって、このように
vocabulary.english_definition: as a result; in this way
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 「したがって」「このように」を表すやや硬い副詞。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We missed the last bus and thus had to walk home.
vocabulary.raw_japanese_extraction: したがって、このように
vocabulary.source_japanese_meaning: したがって、このように

vocabulary.english_definition: In a close manner
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 緊密なさまの。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We look forward to working more closely with you in the future.

vocabulary.english_definition: Without variation or change, in every case
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: いずれの場合にも変化または変更のない。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I can't live without your love. I think of you constantly.

vocabulary.english_definition: With eagerness; in an eager manner
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 熱意をもって。熱心なようすで。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I am well aware that many will eagerly argue against my view.

vocabulary.japanese_meaning: 観察する、 (法などを)守る
vocabulary.english_definition: Stick to correctly or closely
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 正しく、またはきっちりと貼りつく。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I like to observe people.
vocabulary.raw_japanese_extraction: 観察する、 (法などを)守る
vocabulary.source_japanese_meaning: 観察する、 (法などを)守る

vocabulary.english_definition: Make (someone) agree, understand, or realize the truth or validity of something
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: （誰かに）真実または何かの有効性を、同意させる、自覚させる、あるいは理解させる。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I tried to convince myself that he was doing the right thing.

vocabulary.english_definition: Make smaller
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 小さくする。
vocabulary.example_sentence: What should you do to decrease your debt?

vocabulary.english_definition: Give entirely to a specific person, activity, or cause
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 特定の人、行動または理由に完全に貢献する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I want to dedicate my life to language learning.

vocabulary.english_definition: Establish the validity of something, as by an example, explanation or experiment
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 例、説明または実験によって、何かの妥当性を確立する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I don't know how to demonstrate it, since it's too obvious!

vocabulary.japanese_meaning: 金などを)預ける、置いておく
vocabulary.english_definition: Put into a bank account
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 銀行口座に入れる。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We should deposit this money in a bank.
vocabulary.raw_japanese_extraction: 金などを)預ける、置いておく
vocabulary.source_japanese_meaning: 金などを)預ける、置いておく

vocabulary.english_definition: Be worthy or deserving
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: それにふさわしい、あるいはそれに値する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You deserve a break after all your hard work.

vocabulary.english_definition: Intend (something) to move towards a certain goal
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: （何か）を特定のゴールの方へ進めさせることを狙いとする。
vocabulary.example_sentence: What movies did he direct?

vocabulary.english_definition: Mark as different
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 異なっていると強調される。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We need to distinguish right from wrong.

vocabulary.english_definition: Distribute or disperse widely
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 広く配布するか、分散させる。
vocabulary.example_sentence: These he used to distribute to his friends.

vocabulary.english_definition: Earn on some commercial or business transaction; earn as salary or wages
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 商業またはビジネス取引で稼ぐ。給与または賃金で稼ぐ。
vocabulary.example_sentence: How much money do you expect to earn next year?

vocabulary.english_definition: Prepare for publication or presentation by correcting, revising, or adapting
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 訂正、改訂、あるいは適応により、出版またはプレゼンテーションに備える。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I need three hours to edit it.

vocabulary.english_definition: To stress, single out as important
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 強調するために、重要であるとして選び出す。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I was born to emphasize out my difference from most other people.

vocabulary.english_definition: Come together
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 団結する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: What kind of animals are you most afraid to encounter?

vocabulary.english_definition: The act of conducting a controlled test or investigation
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 管理された試験または調査を行う行為。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You can't be too careful when doing this experiment.

vocabulary.english_definition: An instance of traveling by air
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 飛行機で旅をすること。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I had to book a flight for him.

vocabulary.english_definition: Causing something without any direct or apparent effort
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: いかなる直接的または明白な努力なしに、何かを引き起こすこと。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I believe in the influence of the stars on our lives.

vocabulary.english_definition: The social force that binds you to the courses of action demanded by that force
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: あなたをその力によって要求された行動方針に結びつける社会的勢力。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You need to take some responsibility for the problem.

vocabulary.english_definition: The actions and activities assigned to or required or expected of a person or group
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 個人あるいはグループに割り当てられたり、必要とされたり、期待されたりする行動や活動。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I think that we have a role to play.

vocabulary.english_definition: A statement that solves a problem or explains how to solve the problem
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 問題を解く、またはその問題の解き方を説明する言明。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We spent hours trying to find a solution to the problem.

vocabulary.english_definition: A practical method or art applied to some particular task
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 特定の仕事に応用する、実践的な方法または技巧。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I wonder what the advantage of this technique is.

vocabulary.english_definition: The wood of trees cut and prepared for use as building material
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 伐られて、建築資材として使用の準備ができている木。
vocabulary.example_sentence: The timber is still green.

vocabulary.english_definition: A long depression in the surface of the land that usually contains a river
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 地表の細長いくぼみで、ふつう川になっている。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We went down to the valley where the village is.

vocabulary.english_definition: The quality (positive or negative) that renders something desirable or valuable
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 何かを望ましいもの、重要なものにする（よい意味でも悪い意味でも）特質。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We need to be aware of the value of time.

vocabulary.english_definition: The space between two lines or planes that intersect; the inclination of one line to another; measured in degrees or radians
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 交差する2本の線または平面の間の空間。1本の線から別の線の傾斜。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You can't see the TV from your angle.

vocabulary.english_definition: A gathering of spectators or listeners at a (usually public) performance
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: （通常は公共の場で）公演を観たり聴いたりする人々の集まり。
vocabulary.example_sentence: How many people do you think are in the audience?

vocabulary.english_definition: A person's social heritage: previous experience or training
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 人の生まれつきの社会的境遇：以前の経験や訓練。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I like to read with music playing in the background.

vocabulary.english_definition: Receive a specified treatment (abstract)
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 指定された処置（抽象的な）を受ける。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I did everything I could to obtain this price.

vocabulary.english_definition: Come to pass
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 起こる。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I don't expect that to occur.

vocabulary.english_definition: Perform as expected when applied
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 適用される際に、予想通りに実行する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I can't figure out how to operate this machine.

vocabulary.english_definition: Interrupt temporarily an activity before continuing
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 継続前に活動を一時的に中断する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You need to pause between each sentence.

vocabulary.english_definition: to display a notice where people can see it
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: お知らせなどを人が見られる場所に掲示すること。
vocabulary.example_sentence: They will post the results on the notice board tomorrow.

vocabulary.japanese_meaning: 資格を与える、適任とする
vocabulary.english_definition: Prove capable or fit; meet requirements
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 能力がある、または適切であることを証明する。要求に適う。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You need at least three members to qualify.
vocabulary.raw_japanese_extraction: 資格を与える、適任とする
vocabulary.source_japanese_meaning: 資格を与える、適任とする

vocabulary.english_definition: To throw or bend back (from a surface)
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 背中（表面から）を放り投げるあるいは、曲げる。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I need a little time to reflect upon it.

vocabulary.english_definition: Become loose or looser or less tight
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 緩くする、より緩くする、またはきつくなくなる。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I just want to relax and listen to some music.

vocabulary.english_definition: Pay back
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 返金する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I only wish there was some way I could repay you.

vocabulary.english_definition: Make a copy or equivalent of
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: コピーまたは等価物を作る。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Try to reproduce the music in your mind.

vocabulary.english_definition: Stand up or offer resistance to somebody or something
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 誰かまたは何かに対して立ち上がりまたは抵抗する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I don't know if I can resist anymore.

vocabulary.english_definition: Go into retirement; stop performing one's work or withdraw from one's position
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 隠居する、退職する。その人の仕事を実行するのを止めるあるいは、その人の職務から撤退する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I hope to retire from work when I'm 60 years old.

vocabulary.english_definition: Reverse the position, order, relation, or condition of
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 位置、順序、関係または状態を逆にする。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We are unable to reverse the process.

vocabulary.english_definition: Regard something as probable or likely
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 何かに対して、起こり得る、または見込まれると見なす。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You can expect me tomorrow.

vocabulary.english_definition: Become fixed or fastened
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 固定された、固定される。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Please fasten your seat belt.

vocabulary.english_definition: Bend or lay so that one part covers the other
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 一つの部分が他の部分を覆うように曲げるあるいは置く。
vocabulary.example_sentence: How many times have I told you to fold your clothes?

vocabulary.english_definition: Give surety or assume responsibility
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 確証するまたは責任を引き受ける。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I can guarantee you that Sami is no longer a problem.

vocabulary.english_definition: Express or state indirectly
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 表現するか、間接的に述べる。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I didn't mean to imply what you did was wrong.

vocabulary.english_definition: Bring in from abroad
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 外国から持ち込む。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Do you think we should import rice from the U.S.?

vocabulary.english_definition: Indicate a place, direction, person, or thing; either spatially or figuratively
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 場所、方向、人、または物事を指す。空間的または比喩的に。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I took his not coming to indicate that he wasn't interested.

vocabulary.english_definition: Impart knowledge of some fact, state or affairs, or event to
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: いくつかの事実、状態、情勢、事象についての知識を授ける。

vocabulary.english_definition: Make lower or quieter
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: より下げる、または、より静かにする。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Could you please lower the radio a bit?

vocabulary.english_definition: Be obedient to
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 従順である。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We should obey the law no matter what happens.

vocabulary.english_definition: to fill or use a space or period of time
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 場所や時間を占めたり使ったりすること。
vocabulary.example_sentence: The new desks occupy most of the classroom.

vocabulary.english_definition: Do something to an excessive degree
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 何かを過度の度合いにする。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You have to be very careful not to overdo things.

vocabulary.japanese_meaning: ひっくり返す、打倒する
vocabulary.english_definition: Cause to overturn from an upright or normal position
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 直立したか通常の位置からひっくり返えさせる。
vocabulary.example_sentence: The vase on my desk overturned when I jumped up in surprise.
vocabulary.raw_japanese_extraction: ひっくり返す、打倒する
vocabulary.source_japanese_meaning: ひっくり返す、打倒する

vocabulary.japanese_meaning: 借りている、負っている
vocabulary.english_definition: Be indebted to, in an abstract or intellectual sense
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 抽象的または知的な意味で、負っている。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I never want to owe money to anyone.
vocabulary.raw_japanese_extraction: 借りている、負っている
vocabulary.source_japanese_meaning: 借りている、負っている

vocabulary.english_definition: to put things into a bag or box for travel or storage
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 旅行や移動に備えて荷物をかばんなどに詰めること。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I need to pack my bag for tomorrow's trip.

vocabulary.english_definition: Arrange in stacks
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 堆積で配置する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: How is it that dishes pile up so quickly?

vocabulary.english_definition: Make (a surface) shine
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: （表面を）輝かせる。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You should polish your shoes before you go to the party.

vocabulary.english_definition: Command against
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 反対する命令を出す。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You can't prohibit me from doing that.

vocabulary.english_definition: Impose a penalty on; inflict punishment on
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 処罰を加える。処罰を課す。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We thought it wrong that you should punish him.

vocabulary.japanese_meaning: がたがた音がする、ならす
vocabulary.english_definition: Make short successive sounds
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 短い連続した音を出す。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You can't let things rattle you.
vocabulary.raw_japanese_extraction: がたがた音がする、ならす
vocabulary.source_japanese_meaning: がたがた音がする、ならす

vocabulary.english_definition: Nonfictional prose forming an independent part of a publication
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 出版物の独立した部分を成すノンフィクションの散文。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You didn't tell them what you wrote in that article.

vocabulary.english_definition: A distinct feature or element in a problem
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: はっきりとした特徴あるいは問題の要素。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We must consider every aspect of the problem.

vocabulary.english_definition: A bag carried by a strap on your back or shoulder
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 紐で背や肩に負うカバン。
vocabulary.example_sentence: What do you have in your backpack?

vocabulary.english_definition: The lowermost portion of a structure partly or wholly below ground level; often used for storage
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 部分的にまたは全体が地下にある構造物の最も低い部分。格納用にしばしば使用される。
vocabulary.example_sentence: How much money does a basement window like that cost?

vocabulary.english_definition: The flat part of a tool or weapon that (usually) has a cutting edge
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: （通例）切る刃のついた道具または武器の平たい部分。
vocabulary.example_sentence: How long is this blade?

vocabulary.english_definition: A line that indicates a boundary
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 境界を示す線。
vocabulary.example_sentence: How long will it be before we cross the border?

vocabulary.english_definition: a meal where people serve themselves from several dishes
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 並んだ料理から自分で取り分ける形式の食事。
vocabulary.example_sentence: The hotel serves a breakfast buffet every morning.

vocabulary.english_definition: A car driven by a person whose job is to take passengers where they want to go in exchange for money
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 乗客を望む場所に連れて行き金を受けとるのを仕事にしている人が運転する車。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I don't want to walk. Let's take a cab.

vocabulary.english_definition: A politician who is running for public office
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 公職に立候補する政治家。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We promised our support to the candidate.

vocabulary.english_definition: The overhead upper surface of a covered space
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 部屋の内側の頭上の裏張り。
vocabulary.example_sentence: How long would it take you to paint the ceiling?

vocabulary.english_definition: A slight indication
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: わずかな暗示。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You don't have a clue what you're talking about.

vocabulary.english_definition: An associate that one works with
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 一緒に仕事をする仲間。
vocabulary.example_sentence: My colleague filled in for me while I was sick.

vocabulary.english_definition: Freedom from doubt; belief in yourself and your abilities
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 疑いがないこと。自分と自分の能力への信頼。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You don't seem to have the confidence to do that by yourself.

vocabulary.english_definition: The means of connection between things linked in series
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 連続した物事同士の結びつき。
vocabulary.example_sentence: My friend sent me a link to this video.

vocabulary.english_definition: Creative writing of recognized artistic value
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 芸術的価値を認められた創作文書。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Could you lend me the literature homework?

vocabulary.english_definition: ways of sharing news and information with the public
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 新聞、テレビ、インターネットなど情報を伝える媒体。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Social media helps me keep in touch with friends.

vocabulary.english_definition: Being or relating to the smaller in number of two parts
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 2つの部分のうち数の少ない方であること、またはそれに関連していること。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I think you're in the minority there.

vocabulary.english_definition: A structure erected to commemorate persons or events
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 人物や出来事を記念するために建てられた構築物。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Do you want to visit this monument?

vocabulary.english_definition: A characteristic (habitual or relatively temporary) state of feeling
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 感情の特徴的な状態（常習的または比較的一時的な）。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You should learn how to control that mood of yours.

vocabulary.english_definition: A natural event that involves a change in the position or location of something
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 何かの位置または場所の変化関連した自然の出来事。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I didn't vote on the motion.

vocabulary.english_definition: A motor vehicle with two wheels and a strong frame
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 2輪と強いフレームを持つ自動車。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I want to learn how to ride a motorcycle.

vocabulary.english_definition: The time of a particular event
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 特別な出来事のあるとき。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Please allow me to say a few words on this occasion.

vocabulary.english_definition: A personal belief or judgment that is not founded on proof or certainty
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 証拠または確証の基づかない個人的信条または判断。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You may be right, but I am against your opinion.

vocabulary.english_definition: One of a number of things from which only one can be chosen
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 多くの物のうちで、ただ一つだけが選択される1つ。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I think that's an option we need to look into.

vocabulary.english_definition: Sudden mass fear and anxiety over anticipated events
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 予期していた事態に対し、突然大衆がおそれ、心配すること。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I was in a panic because I couldn't find my keys.

vocabulary.english_definition: A piece of cloth used as decoration or to mend or cover a hole
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 装飾、穴を繕ったり塞ぐものとして使用される布の断片。
vocabulary.example_sentence: My people are working on a patch.

vocabulary.japanese_meaning: 思い出す、思い出させる
vocabulary.english_definition: Recall knowledge from memory; have a recollection
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 記憶から知識を思い浮かべる。回顧する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Do you recall what happened last year on your birthday?
vocabulary.raw_japanese_extraction: 思い出す、思い出させる
vocabulary.source_japanese_meaning: 思い出す、思い出させる

vocabulary.english_definition: Get or find back; recover the use of
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 得るまたは見直す。使用を回復する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I hope he will recover quickly.

vocabulary.english_definition: Use again after processing
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 処理の後で再度使用する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I wish more people would recycle.

vocabulary.japanese_meaning: 元気にする、新たにする
vocabulary.english_definition: to make someone feel less tired or renew something
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 疲れを和らげたり、新しい状態にしたりすること。
vocabulary.example_sentence: A short walk outside helps refresh my mind.
vocabulary.raw_japanese_extraction: 元気にする、新たにする
vocabulary.source_japanese_meaning: 元気にする、新たにする

vocabulary.english_definition: Feel remorse for; feel sorry for; be contrite about
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 悔恨を感じる。遺憾に感じる。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I have a feeling I'm going to regret this later.

vocabulary.english_definition: Appear like; be similar or bear a likeness to
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: ように見える。類似しているか、類似点をもたらす。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I think that you resemble your mother.

vocabulary.english_definition: Reach a decision
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 決断に到る。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I hope that you are able to resolve the situation soon.

vocabulary.english_definition: React verbally
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 言葉で反応する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I didn't know how to respond to that question.

vocabulary.english_definition: Place under restrictions; limit access to
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 制限の下に置く。アクセスを制限する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You have no right to restrict Tom.

vocabulary.english_definition: Appraise critically
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 批判的に、評価する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We need to review the case.

vocabulary.english_definition: Make revisions in
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: で改訂を行う。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I am not going out because I have to revise.

vocabulary.english_definition: Cook with dry heat, usually in an oven
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 乾式加熱で調理する、通常オーブンで。
vocabulary.example_sentence: My mom is going to roast a chicken for dinner tonight.

vocabulary.english_definition: Turn on or around an axis or a center
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 軸または中心で、あるいは軸または中心の周りで回転する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: How long does it usually take to rotate tires?

vocabulary.english_definition: Accepted or habitual practice
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 受け入れられることまたは慣習。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I looked up where this custom comes from.

vocabulary.english_definition: The act of departing
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 出発する行為。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Could you change the departure date for this ticket?

vocabulary.english_definition: The extent downward or backward or inward
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 下方、後方、または、内部への範囲。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I have no doubt about the depth of his feelings.

vocabulary.english_definition: Something that is desired
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 望まれているもの。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I don't have the desire to tell him the truth.

vocabulary.english_definition: The act of restricting your food intake (or your intake of particular foods)
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 食物の摂取（もしくは特定の食物の摂取）を制限する行為。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I have to lose weight, so I'm on a diet.

vocabulary.english_definition: Member of a board of directors
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 理事会の一員。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I want to see the director of the company.

vocabulary.english_definition: A system formed by the interaction of a community of organisms with their physical environment
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 生物の群集の物理的環境の相互作用によって形成された体系。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Snakes are an extremely important part of our ecosystem.

vocabulary.english_definition: Any strong feeling
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 強い気持ちの総称。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Her emotion was too strong for words.

vocabulary.english_definition: An opposing military force
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 敵対する軍隊。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We have to drive the enemy out of our land.

vocabulary.english_definition: the act of entering a place or joining an organization
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 場所に入ることや、組織などに加入すること。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Entry to the museum is free on Sundays.

vocabulary.english_definition: Response to an inquiry or experiment
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 質問または実験に対する反応。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I was hoping to get some feedback.

vocabulary.english_definition: A member of a fire department who tries to extinguish fires
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 火事を消そうとする消防署の一員。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I have a son who's used to be a firefighter.

vocabulary.english_definition: The hard structure (bones and cartilages) that provides a frame for the body of an animal
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 動物の身体の枠組みを提供する堅い構造物（骨と軟骨）。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We need a frame for this picture.

vocabulary.english_definition: A proportion in relation to a whole (which is usually the amount per hundred)
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 全体に対する比率（通常、百分率）。
vocabulary.example_sentence: How much is that as a percentage?

vocabulary.english_definition: A long (usually round) rod of wood or metal or plastic
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 木、金属、プラスチックの長い（普通は円みのある）棒。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I ran into a pole.

vocabulary.english_definition: A correctional institution where persons are confined while on trial or for punishment
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 裁判中にまたは罰として監禁される矯正施設。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I didn't know there was a prison so close to your house.

vocabulary.english_definition: A mechanical device that moves fluid or gas by pressure or suction
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 圧力や吸引力で流体やガスを移動させる機械装置。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Could you show me how to use this pump?

vocabulary.english_definition: How much there is or how many there are of something that you can quantify
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 定量化できるものがいくらあるか、またはいくつあるか。
vocabulary.example_sentence: What quantity of paper do you need?

vocabulary.english_definition: A forest with heavy annual rainfall
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 年間降水量が多い森林。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We must protect the rainforest.

vocabulary.english_definition: A storm with rain
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 雨を伴う嵐。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We have all been caught outside in a rainstorm.

vocabulary.english_definition: A practice session in preparation for a public performance (as of a play or speech or concert)
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: （演劇、演説、または、コンサートなどの）公演のための準備としての練習の集り。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We were busy talking about the rehearsal.

vocabulary.english_definition: The basic rhythmic unit in a piece of music
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 音楽の基本的なリズムユニット。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I find peace in the rhythm of life.

vocabulary.english_definition: The contestant you hope to defeat
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 打ち負かしたいと願う競争相手。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We lost against our rival on price.

vocabulary.english_definition: An established line of travel or access
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 往来や出入りのために作られた進路。
vocabulary.example_sentence: How long did it take you to do the route?

vocabulary.english_definition: Something that remunerates
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 報いるもの。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I don't deserve the salary they pay me.

vocabulary.english_definition: A learned person (especially in the humanities); someone who by long study has gained mastery in one or more disciplines
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 博識な人（特に人文科学で）。長期にわたる研究によって1つ以上の分野の専門知識を得た人。
vocabulary.example_sentence: A sign is enough for a scholar to understand us.

vocabulary.english_definition: Personnel that are sacrificed (e.g., surrendered or lost in order to gain an objective)
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 犠牲となった人（例えば、降伏したり目的の遂行のために亡くなるなど）。
vocabulary.example_sentence: What is the meaning of fighting without a sacrifice?

vocabulary.japanese_meaning: 満足させる、 (欲望・条件)を満たす
vocabulary.english_definition: Make happy or satisfied
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 幸せにする、または満足させる。
vocabulary.example_sentence: What else should I do to satisfy her?
vocabulary.raw_japanese_extraction: 満足させる、 (欲望・条件)を満たす
vocabulary.source_japanese_meaning: 満足させる、 (欲望・条件)を満たす

vocabulary.english_definition: Make tight; secure against leakage
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: きつくする。漏出に対して安全な。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I think that we're ready to seal the deal.
vocabulary.raw_japanese_extraction: ・条件)を満たす封をする、密封する
vocabulary.source_japanese_meaning: ・条件)を満たす封をする、密封する

vocabulary.english_definition: Settle conclusively; come to terms
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 決定的に解決する。同意に達する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We were able to settle the matter finally.

vocabulary.english_definition: Hit hard
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 強烈に打つ。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You make me want to smash your face in.

vocabulary.english_definition: Examine in order to test suitability
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 適性を判断するための検査。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I want to sort this out once and for all.

vocabulary.english_definition: Separate into parts or portions
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 部分や部分に分かれる。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I fear they're going to split up.

vocabulary.english_definition: The state of being free from danger or injury
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 危険または危害がない状態。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I didn't know that you worked for a security company.

vocabulary.english_definition: One of two divisions of an academic year
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 学年を2つに分けたうちの1つ。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I was was driving home for the semester break.

vocabulary.english_definition: Similar things placed in order or happening one after another
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 類似した事柄が、順番に置かれる、または、次々と起こること。
vocabulary.example_sentence: What happens in this series?

vocabulary.japanese_meaning: ーズ活動のための集まり
vocabulary.english_definition: A meeting devoted to a particular activity
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 特定の活動のためにもたれたミーティング。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Can you meet me after school for a study session?
vocabulary.raw_japanese_extraction: ーズ活動のための集まり
vocabulary.source_japanese_meaning: ーズ活動のための集まり

vocabulary.english_definition: The merchandise that a shop has on hand
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 店の手元にある商品。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We will help you order the stock.

vocabulary.english_definition: The act of storing something
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 何かを格納する行為。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Do you have the keys to the storage room?

vocabulary.english_definition: A brief statement that presents the main points in a concise form
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 完結な形態で要点を表現する短い言葉。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Could you please make a summary of the main points?

vocabulary.english_definition: That part of the central nervous system that includes all the higher nervous centers; enclosed within the skull; continuous with the spinal cord
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: すべての高度神経中枢を含む中枢神経系のその部分。頭蓋に包まれている。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I think that part of my brain died a long time ago.

vocabulary.english_definition: The business given to a commercial establishment by its customers
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: その顧客によって商社とされるビジネス。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I wish I had gone to a trade school.

vocabulary.english_definition: A federation (as of American Indians)
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: （アメリカインディアンの連盟のような）連盟。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We can't marry outside our tribe.

vocabulary.english_definition: A movable chair mounted on large wheels; for invalids or those who cannot walk; frequently propelled by the occupant
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 大きな車輪に乗った移動可能な椅子。病人または歩くことのできない人のための。
vocabulary.example_sentence: Can you help get me out my wheelchair?

vocabulary.english_definition: Special importance or significance
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 特別な重要性や意義。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I can tell by his accent that he is German.

vocabulary.english_definition: Move about aimlessly or without any destination, often in search of food or employment
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: しばしば食物や雇用を求めて目的地なしに、あるいは目的なしに動きまわる。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I had some free time, so I decided to wander around town.

vocabulary.english_definition: Hand over formally
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 正式に譲り渡す。
vocabulary.example_sentence: We need to submit the report before the end of the month.

vocabulary.english_definition: Be a substitute
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 代用品にする。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I want you all to meet your new substitute teacher.

vocabulary.english_definition: Come down on or keep down by unjust use of one's authority
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 権威を不当に使用して咎める、または抑圧する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: I wonder how I can suppress this feeling.

vocabulary.english_definition: Relinquish possession or control over
vocabulary.japanese_explanation: 所有物、または管理を放棄する。
vocabulary.example_sentence: You have three minutes to surrender.

vocabulary.english_definition: Pass through the esophagus as part of eating or drinking
